We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President’s right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering & Design operating model and cadence. 

This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President’s leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.

The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work. 

AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic-initiative delivery.

This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters.

  • Run the President's operating cadence. Own end-to-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.
  • Drive decision quality. Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.
  • Improve execution velocity. Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better-informed.
  • Evolve the operating model. Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.
  • Lead high-priority strategic initiatives. Drive complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.

Senior Bookkeeper / Accountant – Real Estate

About the Position

A real estate investment and property management company in the Los Angeles Mid-Wilshire area is seeking an experienced **Senior Bookkeeper / Accountant** to join our team.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping responsibilities for multiple properties and business entities. This position requires strong accounting knowledge, excellent organizational skills, and hands-on experience with QuickBooks and Microsoft Excel.

Responsibilities

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
* Perform bank, credit card, and general ledger reconciliations
* Process and record deposits

* Prepare periodic financial reports and supporting schedules

* Perform account analysis and resolve discrepancies

* Prepare financial and accounting documents as needed
* Maintain and monitor tenant lease-related financial information

* Support month-end and year-end accounting processes

* Advanced proficiency with **QuickBooks** and **Microsoft Excel**
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and other standard office applications
* Strong experience with account analysis and reconciliations
* Experience managing accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll-related functions
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills
* Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines
* Dependable, self-motivated, and professional
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience with real estate investment, property management, or multi-entity accounting is strongly preferred
* CPA license is preferred but **not required**
* Bilingual English/Tagalog is preferred but **not required**

The Senior Accounts Payable professional is responsible for managing high-volume accounts payable activities and ensuring invoices and related transactions are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies and accounting procedures. This position performs invoice processing, three-way matching, account reconciliations, month-end accruals, journal entries, vendor maintenance, and variance analysis. The role works closely with Accounting, Procurement, Operations, and vendors to research and resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

Education

* Associate or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred.

Experience

* 5–7 years of hands-on Accounts Payable experience.
* Experience processing high volumes of invoices, including hundreds of invoices per week.
* Experience with three-way matching of purchase orders, invoices, and goods receipts.
* Experience with account reconciliations, month-end accruals, and month-end close activities.
* Experience preparing and posting manual journal entries and accounting adjustments.
* Experience researching and resolving vendor and invoice discrepancies.
* Experience working with ERP or accounting systems.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and data analysis.

* Ability to review monthly expense and AP activity and identify unusual transactions or variances.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines in a high-volume environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling financial information.

Physical Requirements

* Ability to use a computer, telephone, calculator, and other standard office equipment.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and electronically.

* Process a high volume of invoices accurately and efficiently.

The Sr. Accounts Payable Specialist is primarily responsible for ensuring all aspects of accounts payable processing is completed timely and accurately. This role will complete billing and the processing of payment, maintenance of the vendor database as well as facilitate the secure vendor portal process for the organization in NetSuite. The ideal candidate will be highly organized in order to manage all incoming correspondence to ensure timely payment of invoices and resolution of issues.

#### **Responsibilities:**

1. Review bills, invoices, and requisitions in NetSuite for accuracy and ensure proper supporting documentation is complete.

2. Process on a biweekly basis, payment runs, including ACH, wire, and checks.

3. Help to train new employees and provide guidance to the AP team.

4. Utilize Banking platform to enter and maintain foreign wire payment details for payees and initiate international wire payment transactions.

5. Serve as the primary point of contact for vendors.

6. Research returned payments, complete necessary steps to resolve including, updating payment details, executing bill credit, void bill payment and reissuance process.

7. Quarterly review of open Purchase Orders to determine if closure is appropriate.

8. Ensure W9 or W9 documentation is obtained and validated for all vendors.

9. Maintain vendor files in NetSuite

10. Monitor and maintain the Accounts Payable e-mail account to ensure the timely processing of invoices and resolve any discrepancies.

13. Serve as a resource for staff regarding proper entry procedures, audits documents to ensure work quality and compliance, and provides professional customer service.

14. Preparation and submission of annual 1099 forms to recipients and remain in compliance with IRS rules and regulations.

15. Review and reconcile monthly vendor statements by matching payments to amounts due, verify accuracy of vendor statements, and researches and resolves outstanding invoices with a focus on protecting the organization’s interests while maintaining positive working relationships with vendors.

16. Prepare for the annual audit by preparing assigned reports or providing documentation.

#### **Qualifications:**

1. 4+ years of full cycle accounts payable experience, not-for-profit accounting preferred.

2. Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance preferred.

3. Experience working with a general ledger accounting system required.

4. Strong Excel skills required along with NetSuite required. Concur and/or Salesforce a plus.

5. 2+ years’ experience working with a large volume of transactions.

6. Excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication, time management, organizational and analytical skills.

8. Ability to apply logic, work effectively with all staff and management, attention to detail, deadline driven and ability to work independently are essential characteristics of this position.

Description:

The Senior Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of multi-state payroll for the Duncan-Parnell portfolio of companies. This role serves as the subject matter expert for the Paylocity payroll and HRIS platform, ensuring payroll data integrity, proper tax withholding and reporting, and seamless integration between payroll and HR systems. Reporting to the Director, the Senior Payroll Specialist works closely with HR, Accounting, and department leaders to ensure employees are paid accurately and that the company remains compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local payroll regulations. This job is located in Charlotte, NC.

**Essential Functions and Duties**

***Payroll Processing***

* Process accurate and timely multi-state, bi-weekly (or applicable cycle) payroll for all employees using Paylocity, including hourly, salaried, and multi-location staff.
* Review and validate timekeeping data, new hires, terminations, status changes, garnishments, and other payroll inputs prior to each payroll run.
* Calculate and process off-cycle payments, retroactive pay, bonuses, commissions, and final paychecks in accordance with state-specific requirements.
* Reconcile payroll registers, general ledger postings, and payroll-related accounts prior to and after each payroll cycle.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll inquiries, resolving discrepancies promptly and professionally.

***Multi-State Compliance and Tax Withholding***

* Ensure accurate setup, calculation, and remittance of federal, state, and local tax withholdings across all states in which the company operates.
* Monitor and apply changes in multi-state payroll tax laws, wage and hour regulations, and reciprocity agreements; register new state and local tax jurisdictions as needed.
* Prepare and review quarterly and annual payroll tax filings (941, state unemployment, state withholding, W-2s, etc.) and partner with Paylocity's tax service on filing accuracy and notice resolution.
* Maintain compliance with wage garnishment orders, child support withholding, and other legally mandated deductions.
* Support internal and external payroll audits by providing documentation and analysis as requested.

***HRIS System Management***

* Serve as the Paylocity system administrator, maintaining employee records, pay codes, tax profiles, benefit deductions, and organizational structures.
* Partner with HR, Finance and IT to configure, test, and implement HRIS updates, new modules, and process improvements or automation opportunities.
* Ensure data integrity between Paylocity and other HR, benefits, and financial systems through regular audits and reconciliations.
* Build and maintain payroll and HRIS reports, dashboards, and metrics to support HR, Finance, and executive decision-making.
* Work with Director to build and maintain performance management systems within Paylocity; train users as needed.
* Maintain up-to-date process documentation and provide training to HR and management users on payroll and HRIS functionality.

***Other***

* Assist management with overtime management and reporting
* Assist with confirming funding for 401(k), HSA, FSA and other benefits in the ERP system, enter payment vouchers as needed
* Assist with year-end payroll processes, including W-2 preparation, benefit reconciliations, and annual limit updates (401(k), FSA, etc.).
* Support open enrollment and benefits administration as it relates to payroll deductions and system setup.
* Responsible for compiling the data and reports for compliance with AAP and VETS reporting requirements
* Assist Director with payroll and worker’s compensation audits as needed
* Perform additional duties as requested by Management.
* Serve as backup for onboarding new employees

Requirements:

* Extensive working knowledge of Paylocity payroll and HRIS software; system administration experience strongly preferred.

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentia

jobs.desc:
Chubby Cattle International is seeking an experienced Senior Accounts Payable & Finance Operations Specialist to join our growing Finance team in Los Angeles.

As our restaurant group continues to expand across the U.S., this position will support accounts payable, inventory management, month-end close, restaurant finance operations, and financial systems across 50+ locations.

We are especially interested in candidates who have experience with Craftable, Restaurant365 (R365), MarginEdge, MarketMan, or other restaurant inventory/AP management systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

Accounts Payable & Invoice Processing

* Manage high-volume invoice processing across multiple restaurant locations and entities
* Manage invoice mapping, bill approvals, invoice processing, and payment reconciliation within Craftable
* Review invoice coding, approvals, supporting documentation, and payment status
* Reconcile vendor statements and resolve missing invoices, credits, duplicate charges, and payment discrepancies
* Maintain vendor records and support new vendor setup

Month-End Close

* Support the AP-side month-end close process, including invoice completeness checks, expense review, and reconciliations
* Coordinate with restaurant managers to ensure invoices and month-end documentation are submitted accurately and on time

Banking & Payment Operations

* Process vendor payments and assist with internal transfers and wire submissions
* Support account monitoring, banking administration, and account information updates
* Support reconciliation and documentation related to banking and payment activity

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of Accounts Payable or Accounting experience preferred
* Restaurant, hospitality, multi-unit retail, or other high-volume multi-location experience strongly preferred
* Experience with Craftable preferred. Experience with Restaurant365, MarginEdge, MarketMan, or similar platforms is also highly valued
* Strong understanding of AP workflows, invoice coding, vendor reconciliation, and month-end close
* Experience supporting multiple locations or legal entities preferred
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions and deadlines
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly growing restaurant organization

**About Chubby Cattle International**  
Chubby Cattle International is a fast-growing multi-brand restaurant group with locations across the United States. As we continue expanding our restaurant portfolio, we are building a strong centralized Finance and Operations infrastructure to support our growing teams and locations.

Overview:

**About us:**

Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Since inception, LS Power has developed or acquired 50,000 MW of power generation, including utility-scale solar, wind, hydro, battery energy storage, and natural gas-fired facilities. Through its transmission business, LS Power Grid, the company built and operates 780+ miles of high-voltage transmission and 7 transmission utilities and has another 375+ miles currently in construction or development. LS Power actively invests in and scales businesses that are meeting the growing needs of the energy expansion, including electric vehicle charging, demand response, microgrids, renewable fuels and waste-to-energy platforms. Over the years, LS Power has raised more than $89 billion in debt and equity capital to support North American infrastructure.

Our Purpose is to solve complex energy problems that improve the world

Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem

Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership

* Manage vendor relationships, office supplies, and facilities support.
* Support leadership with projects, communications, and administrative initiatives.

* Are proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and office management systems.

**Ideally, You Have**

* Hold a college degree or equivalent.
* 5–7 years of relevant administrative or office management experience.
* Includes supervisory or team leadership experience (managing a small team, e.g., 2–4 staff).

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Cycle and Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.desc:
Description:

At Terra Fertility, we are reimagining fertility care. Our mission is to make reproductive health more accessible and equitable through transparent pricing, innovative technology, and comprehensive patient education. We believe that everyone—regardless of background, language, or identity—should feel informed, empowered, and supported on their fertility journey.

**Position Overview**

Terra Fertility is seeking a highly experienced Senior Revenue Cycle & Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our growing team.

This is not a traditional billing position. We are looking for an individual with deep healthcare revenue cycle experience who can independently manage complex claims, resolve denials, analyze reimbursement trends, identify operational improvements, and help optimize the financial performance of the practice.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare billing expertise, exceptional analytical skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced specialty medical environment.

This position reports to the Revenue Cycle Lead and works closely with patient financial coordinators, practice leadership, clinical staff, and insurance payers.

**Key Responsibilities**

### **Accounts Receivable & Collections**

* Manage complex and high-value accounts receivable balances.
* Perform detailed payer follow-up on unpaid, denied, and underpaid claims.
* Drive timely resolution of aging accounts and reimbursement delays.
* Monitor collection performance and identify opportunities to improve cash flow.

### **Denials Management & Appeals**

* Lead investigation and resolution of denied and underpaid claims.
* Prepare and submit appeals with supporting documentation.
* Conduct root-cause analysis to identify recurring denial trends.
* Collaborate with clinical, authorization, and registration teams to reduce preventable denials.

### **Revenue Cycle Analytics**

* Monitor key performance indicators including days in AR, denial rates, first-pass claim acceptance, payer turnaround times, and collection yield.
* Develop reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve reimbursement performance.
* Identify payer-specific trends and escalation opportunities.

### **Claims & Payer Strategy**

* Manage claims through the full reimbursement lifecycle.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on payer policies, reimbursement issues, and claim resolution.
* Partner with leadership to address systemic payer challenges and optimize reimbursement processes.

### **Process Improvement**

* Recommend and implement workflow improvements to increase efficiency and collections.
* Assist with development of SOPs and staff training.
* Support ongoing scaling and optimization of Terra's revenue cycle operations.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $35–$45 per hour depending on experience and qualifications
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Professional development opportunities

**Employment Details**

* Full-time (40 hours per week)
* Hybrid following training on-site in Dedham, Massachusetts

Requirements:

* Minimum 5 years of healthcare billing and accounts receivable experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in denials management, appeals, and payer follow-up.
* Strong understanding of revenue cycle metrics and reimbursement analysis.
* Experience working with EOBs, ERAs, clearinghouses, and payer portals.
* Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets proficiency.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in fertility, reproductive health, surgical, oncology, infusion, or other specialty medical billing environments.
* Experience working with high-dollar claims and complex insurance benefits.
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and operational analyses.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Analytics, or a related field.

**Senior Office Manager**

***Marco Island, FL | Full-Time | On-Site, Monday–Friday | $70-80K Base + Bonus***

**About the Company**

Ridge Valley Exteriors is a national roofing contractor based in Florida with more than 17 years of experience. Our teams work together to deliver quality projects and dependable customer service, and strong office operations are essential to making that happen. We’re looking for an experienced leader to help our Southwest Florida office run smoothly as the business continues to grow.

The Senior Office Manager will lead day-to-day office operations and keep people, processes, and priorities moving across departments. This person will work closely with senior leadership, take ownership of office workflows, and help the team stay organized and accountable.

**What You’ll Do**

Lead daily office operations and keep work moving when senior leadership is supporting other markets.  

Coordinate priorities and communication across customer service, production administration, and financial administration.  
Set clear expectations, follow up on deadlines, and help team members stay accountable for their work.  
Oversee office workflows, records, incoming mail, check processing, and other administrative functions.  
Provide oversight of billing deadlines, financial documentation, and reporting in partnership with the team member responsible for bookkeeping.  
Ensure insurance records and subcontractor compliance documents are accurate and up to date.  
Identify gaps in processes, resolve day-to-day issues, and put practical improvements in place.  

**What We’re Looking For**

Experience leading an office, business operations, or multiple administrative functions.  

Confidence making decisions, setting priorities, and addressing issues directly.  
Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines.  
A track record of improving processes and following through on results.  
The ability to work independently and serve as a trusted partner to senior leadership.  

Experience in roofing, construction, restoration, or home services is preferred. Familiarity with production scheduling, customer service workflows, financial administration, or subcontractor compliance is also helpful.

***If you’re an experienced operations leader who enjoys bringing structure to a busy office and helping a growing business run smoothly, we’d like to hear from you.***

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
NOTE: this position can be remote anywhere within the United States.

As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders.

What you will do:

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, with a focus on cloud-native database capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, and schema evolution.

  • Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements to the core database engine, storage layer, and query optimizer, ensuring the Cloud offering keeps pace with open-source and enterprise use cases.

  • Engage directly with customers, gathering insights through interactions, feedback, and market research to guide product decisions.

  • Work alongside design, marketing, operations, and sales teams to support feature launches, contribute to blog posts, and help shape product positioning and messaging.

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related communications, effectively managing expectations and keeping stakeholders informed.

About You:

  • Minimum 8+ years of product management experience with a strong background in cloud-based SaaS products. Deep familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, or real-time analytics platforms is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning.

  • Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other columnar databases.

  • Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design.

  • Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working and scaling open source technologies

  • Prior experience at a startup

 
 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

One position will support the Chief Operating/Financial Officer and Vice President of Investor Relations. Experience supporting Finance, Investor Relations, or Corporate Development teams is preferred.

In this role, you will ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payroll processing across a high‑volume, multi‑state employee population. **Responsibilities**

* Processes weekly or bi‑weekly multi‑state payrolls accurately and on time using ADP Workforce Now (WFN).

* Investigates and resolves payroll discrepancies and implements corrective actions.
* Maintains payroll system data integrity and supports process improvements, audits, acquisitions, and special projects.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive U.S. payroll experience in multi‑state, high‑volume environments.
* Experience with ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
* Familiarity with Sarbanes‑Oxley (SOX) compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, PivotTables, and related data‑analysis functions.
* Strong knowledge of FLSA compliance and payroll tax regulations.
* Proven experience processing high‑volume payrolls accurately and on time.
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and reconciliation skills.
* Familiarity with garnishment processing and priority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a changing environment.
* Customer‑service orientation with a collaborative approach.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to confidentiality.
* Experience supporting benefits and retirement plan administration.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum 5–7 years of payroll experience.

jobs.desc:
\*\*Senior Service Dispatcher / Coordinator – Commercial Service \*\*

Beacon Mechanical Services is hiring an experienced Senior Service Dispatcher / Operations Coordinator in Stoughton, MA to support the daily coordination and execution of our growing commercial service operation.

This is a highly active operational role supporting multiple service divisions, including Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, Facility Services, and Fire Life Safety. Each division typically operates 3–4 field crews, creating a dynamic service environment with multiple jobs, technicians, customer requests, and changing priorities moving simultaneously throughout the day.

The Senior Service Dispatcher / Operations Coordinator serves as the central connection between our field technicians, customers, vendors, division managers, and internal operations team.

The ideal candidate has substantial experience in service dispatching or field-service coordination and is comfortable independently managing a busy service board, proactively following up with technicians, communicating with customers, and keeping work moving from initial request through completion.

This position is well suited for someone who enjoys a fast-moving environment, takes pride in staying ahead of open items, and naturally becomes the person field teams rely on to keep their day organized.

----------------------------

\*\*

* Coordinate daily field operations across Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, Facility Services, and Fire Life Safety, typically supporting 3–4 crews per division

* Support field technicians as a primary operational resource for scheduling, scope clarification, site information, and customer requirements

--------------------------------

\*\*

* Maintain strong visibility into the service board and the next action required on active work
* Keep schedules organized and planned ahead whenever possible
* Maintain consistent communication with field crews and customers
* Identify incomplete or stalled work and proactively move it forward
* Independently resolve routine scheduling and service issues while appropriately escalating larger concerns
* Operate with urgency, organization, accountability, and strong follow-through

**About EMS Unlimited**

EMS Unlimited is a paramedic-owned ambulance and medical transport company providing Advanced Life Support, Basic Life Support, and Critical Care Transport across Colorado, Nebraska, Kansas, Arizona, and Montana. Founded in 2012 by a working paramedic, the company has grown from a special-events medical staffing outfit into a multi-state operator running ambulance stations, a wildland fire and disaster response team under federal USDA Forest Service agreements, and hospital-based staffing contracts.

In the last year alone, EMS Unlimited stood up a new federal ambulance contract at Fort Leavenworth, KS, launched Station 137 in Omaha and Station 237 in Aurora and was awarded a state funded grant for a new Community Paramedic program, with plans for more in 2027 — on top of a wildfire response division whose revenue swings depending on fire season. Keeping that financial picture accurate, current, and station-by-station isn't a side task here. It's the job.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

EMS Unlimited is hiring a Senior Bookkeeper to own the company's day-to-day books across all of its stations and cost centers. This isn't a single-entity, single-checkbook bookkeeping job — you'll be reconciling and coding across multiple bank accounts, a company-wide corporate card program, and eleven separate station/cost-center ledgers, in a business with real debt complexity (several active lending facilities, each with its own payment schedule) and real revenue seasonality (wildfire response revenue alone can move from zero to six figures month to month).

This role sits between "bookkeeper" and "controller" on purpose. You won't be setting financial strategy, running payroll, or managing other staff — that's the Fractional CFO's and Payroll team's lane. What you will own is making sure every dollar, at every station, is coded right, reconciled on time, and ready to report on.

* Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations across multiple accounts
* Maintain the company's debt schedule — tracking balances, payment timing, and maturity dates across several active lending facilities
* Support monthly close and deliver accurate, audit-ready financials to the Fractional CFO/CAO
* Coordinate with the payroll team on payroll-related GL entries (you won't run payroll — Payroll & Benefits is handled separately through the company's PEO)
* Flag inconsistencies before they become problems — this company runs lean, and a good catch here saves real money

**What this role is not:** a CPA-track controller position, a financial-strategy role, or a people-management role. If you're looking to run the finance department, this isn't that. If you want to be the person who makes sure a fast-growing, multi-state EMS company's books are actually right — this is.

Salary commensurate with experience. Comprehensive benefits administered through the company's PEO — full W-2 employment, no contractor arrangements.

* Comfortable owning books independently with minimal oversight, while knowing when to escalate

**Senior Accounts Payable Specialist**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Process corporate invoices for the REIT team and Corporate Accounting, including professional services, legal, audit, software, insurance and vendor services.
* Code and allocate invoices to the correct entity and general ledger account, including intercompany splits.
* Manage approvals and support documents in Coupa, and build Coupa and Sage invoice imports.

* Partner with the REIT team and Corporate Accounting to secure approvals and resolve invoice questions.
* Reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, support month-end close and provide documentation for audits.

**Accounting Projects**

* Lead general ledger clean-up for AP-related accounts, including clearing aged unapplied items, misclassified invoices and stale accruals.
* Reconcile vendor statements and vendor balances to the AP subledger and resolve differences with the REIT team and corporate teams.
* Drive vendor master clean-up, including duplicate vendor review, W-9 and tax ID completeness, and inactive vendor removal.
* Lead standardization of AP procedures, coding rules and approval workflows across corporate accounts payable.
* Design and document controls for invoice intake, duplicate prevention and segregation of duties.
* Support AP automation and Coupa process changes, and assist with system conversion or ERP migration work.
* Build reconciliation, aging and KPI reporting that leadership can use to track AP and GL health.
* Provide documentation and testing support for internal and external audits.

**Required Qualifications**

* Supports multi-property or multi-entity organizations, including intercompany coding.
* Demonstrates a strong understanding of accounts payable processes and accounting fundamentals.
* Manages competing priorities across the REIT team, Corporate Accounting and deadlines.
* Builds strong partnerships with the REIT team and Corporate Accounting.
* Commits to standardization, controls and continuous improvement.
* Communicates clearly in written and verbal English.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
* Corporate shared services or centralized accounting experience.
* Hospitality or food service industry exposure.
* Experience with AP automation or workflow tools.
* Experience with ERP or accounting systems such as Sage.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company, and Revenue Operations owns the systems, data, and infrastructure that turn that growth into revenue.  With a large volume of people discovering and signing up for Netlify every day, Marketing Operations is critical to understanding those users, connecting activity across our systems, and creating scalable ways to engage them throughout their journey.

As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll own the operational foundation behind that work. You’ll connect HubSpot, Salesforce, product data, and analytics, build the systems and lifecycle infrastructure that turn signals into action, and give Marketing and our GTM partners trusted visibility into performance. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, you’ll translate the Marketing Operations vision into a roadmap and independently drive it forward while partnering closely with Growth, RevOps, Data, Product, and other GTM teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute on the Marketing Operations roadmap, translating broader Marketing and GTM priorities into scalable systems, processes, and programs.
  • Own our marketing automation platform end to end, including workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, forms, lists, email operations, data hygiene, deliverability, governance, and documentation.
  • Build and maintain the connection between marketing automation, Salesforce, product data, and analytics so we can understand and engage users throughout the customer journey.
  • Establish reliable attribution and measurement across marketing and product-led journeys, including UTM governance and connections between campaigns, signups, activation, conversion, and revenue.
  • Build reporting and self-service dashboards that give Marketing and GTM partners a trusted view of performance and support weekly, monthly, and executive-level decision-making.
  • Partner with Growth to operationalize lifecycle programs across email, in-product experiences, and sales-assist triggers, turning customer and product signals into scalable journeys from signup through activation and conversion.
  • Build experimentation infrastructure that allows marketers to launch, measure, and learn from tests without requiring engineering support for every experiment.
  • Own the operational health of the MarTech stack, including integrations, data flows, governance, vendor relationships, and periodic assessments of what we should keep, retire, consolidate, or integrate.
  • Establish scalable practices for high-volume email operations, including audience management, domain and inbox health, deliverability, and safeguards that protect the customer experience.
  • Turn large and sometimes ambiguous datasets into actionable recommendations, identifying points of friction or drop-off and partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Data, and RevOps on opportunities to improve conversion.
  • Own the Marketing Operations portion of the broader Marketing budget and evaluate technology investments based on business value, scalability, and ROI.
  • Explore emerging capabilities in AI-enabled marketing operations and AI visibility measurement, helping the team establish useful workflows and baselines as the space develops.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or a closely related discipline, with experience operating independently in a complex B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment.
  • Deep experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, and Salesforce, including lifecycle stages, campaign architecture, attribution, lead or account routing, and data governance.
  • Experience working with high-volume customer or prospect datasets and designing segmentation, lifecycle, and operational approaches that remain reliable at scale.</

jobs.desc:
**Company Overview**

Linmarr Associates Inc is a 40-year-old U.S. government contracting firm and an integrated supply chain partner supporting the U.S. Military and the warfighter. The company is one of the fastest growing US Government supply chain partners in the US. We have recently relocated to Mooresville, NC and are seeking a talented individual to join our team.

We are an established, fast-growing value-added reseller and distributor servicing high-dollar contracts. Our operational model is highly efficient: we operate a low-transaction, high-dollar cross-docking environment with no permanent physical inventory storage. Every transaction matters immensely. We are seeking a meticulous, process-driven Senior Bookkeeper to own our day-to-day financial workflows, interface cleanly with our external CPA, and scale with us into a full-time role as our contract volume expands.

**Position Overview**  
You will be the core custodian of our daily financial data. Because our transaction volume is low (averaging 5 major shipments/invoices per day) but individual dollar values are exceptionally high, this role requires an absolute hawk for detail, documentation alignment, and strict process adherence. **Prior government contracting experience is preferred but NOT required; we have the in-house talent and are fully prepared to train the right person on government billing systems / WAWF and PAR systems.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* **High-Precision Three-Way Matching:** Verify and match vendor bills, receiving logs/bills of lading, and daily customer invoices to ensure absolute alignment before clearing balances.
* **QuickBooks Management:** Execute daily invoicing, manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR), classify credit card transactions, and perform meticulous monthly bank and card reconciliations. (Must have)
* **Payroll & Journal Entries:** Post payroll journal entries and perform standard month-end adjustments to keep the general ledger pristine.
* **Government Portal Administration (Training Provided):** Learn and manage daily invoicing submissions through WAWF (PIEE), monitor DLA PARS tracking systems, and systematically follow up on outstanding accounts payable with DFAS.
* **CPA Interface & Reporting:** Gather quarterly financial data, prepare accurate checks for owner review, and compile organized financial spreadsheets/flash reports to hand directly to our external CPA for streamlined tax planning.
* **Metric Tracking:** Assist leadership in pulling operational data and tracking key business performance metrics for quarterly reviews.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience as a Full-Charge Bookkeeper or Senior Bookkeeper, preferably in a logistics, distribution, kitting, or professional services environment.
* **Accounting Mastery:** Expert-level knowledge of QuickBooks and general ledger accounting. Must thoroughly understand double-entry bookkeeping, payroll mapping, and complex journal entries.
* **The "Hawk" Factor:** Exceptional administrative discipline. You are someone who spots a mismatched line item or a missing digit instantly and takes pride in audit-ready financials.
* **Bureaucratic Patience:** A persistent, professional demeanor when navigating large organization networks (like vendor accounting or customer payment desks) to track down late collections.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Strong proficiency in Excel for pulling data and structuring basic financial metric reports. Ability to learn proprietary web portals quickly.
* **Communication:** Strong, clear email communication skills for professional documentation and vendor outreach.

**Why Apply?**  
This is a unique opportunity to gain highly lucrative, specialized skills in the defense contracting sector while enjoying a flexible, low-stress, part-time schedule finance schedule today. Full time employment is immediately available for the right candidate that is comfortable with multitasking in other area

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Specialist (Part-Time)
jobs.desc:
**About Us**

At Beewise, we develop and operate autonomous robotic beehives that actively protect and support bee colonies, enabling sustainable pollination and revolutionizing agri-tech. We combine robotics, AI, and environmental tech to bring precision to the heart of nature.

**About the Role**

The Payroll Specialist owns getting Beewise's people paid correctly and on time. You'll run payroll, review timesheets, calculate commissions, process per diems, and handle payroll tax and year-end work, partnering closely with the Director of Finance and People Operations.

We pay about 50 US employees through our PEO (TriNet) and 2 Canadian employees through PEO Canada, and may add employees in Mexico through an Employer of Record. Our workforce includes nonexempt field crews, exempt office staff, and commissioned sales roles, paid on both biweekly and semi-monthly schedules.

This is a hands-on, part-time role for someone who knows payroll inside and out, works accurately under deadlines, and is comfortable owning a recurring calendar.

**Key Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**Payroll Processing**

* Prepare and submit biweekly payroll for hourly employees and semi-monthly payroll for salaried employees in TriNet
* Coordinate payroll inputs and changes with PEO Canada and, if needed, our Mexico EOR, and confirm results are accurate
* Enter payroll changes for new hires, terminations, pay changes, bonuses, and commissions based on approved documentation from People Operations
* Run pre- and post-payroll audits and reconcile TriNet invoices and payroll registers before submitting for Director of Finance approval
* Answer employee payroll questions promptly and professionally

**Timesheet Review**

* Review nonexempt timesheets for missed punches, overtime, double time, meal and rest period premiums, PTO, and other exceptions
* Resolve timesheet issues with managers before payroll deadlines
* Apply multi-state wage-and-hour rules correctly, including California daily overtime and employees temporarily working in other states

**Per Diems and Reimbursements**

* Process per diems and expense reimbursements for field crews and traveling employees based on approved policy and documentation
* Apply accountable plan rules so per diems and reimbursements are treated correctly as taxable or non-taxable

**Sales Commissions**

* Calculate monthly commission and broker payouts based on signed, approved commission plans
* Maintain commission tracking schedules and supporting documentation
* Flag plan questions or exceptions to the Director of Finance and People Operations rather than interpreting plan terms independently

**Contractor Payments and 1099s**

* Process payments to independent contractors and brokers based on approved invoices and agreements
* Collect and maintain W-9s, track 1099-reportable payments, and prepare year-end 1099s
* Route any questions about contractor classification to People Operations rather than deciding them independently

**Payroll Tax and Compliance**

* Research and resolve payroll tax notices from federal, state, local, and Canadian agencies, working with TriNet and PEO Canada
* Track new work states as employees travel or relocate, and coordinate tax setup and withholding through TriNet
* Keep current on payroll tax and wage-and-hour changes that affect our employees and flag them to the Director of Finance and People Operations

**Month-End Close and Year-End**

* Prepare payroll and commission journal entries and accruals for month-end close
* Reconcile payroll accounts to the general ledger each month
* Review TriNet and PEO Canada year-end data (W-2s, T4s) and support year-end payroll reconciliation
* Provide payroll documentation for annual audits

**Systems, Automation, and AI**

* Use AI tools to speed up timesheet review and reconciliations, with review steps that protect accuracy and confidentiality
* Keep payroll procedures documented so the work can be covered during absences
* Support the evaluation

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, you will serve as a strategic partner to the executive and partner closely with the CPO’s Chief of Staff. * Manage and optimize the CPO's calendar, ensuring alignment with product, business, and company priorities.
* Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, prioritize meetings, and maximize executive productivity across multiple time zones.
* Develop a strong understanding of business priorities to effectively guide scheduling decisions and meeting prioritization.
* Anticipate executive needs and recommend solutions to ensure seamless execution of priorities.

**Product Leadership Coordination**

* Partner with the Product Leadership Team to coordinate and execute operating rhythms, leadership meetings, product reviews, roadmap planning sessions, quarterly business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
* Ensure appropriate preparation, documentation, and follow-up actions for key product and executive forums.
* Drive accountability for action items, milestones, and deliverables resulting from leadership meetings and strategic initiatives.

**Meeting Planning and Organization**

* Plan and execute internal and external meetings, leadership offsites, customer engagements, analyst briefings, board-related product reviews, and team events.
* Coordinate agendas, logistics, meeting materials, and action-item tracking.

**Executive Communications**

* Serve as a key point of contact for the Office of the Chief Product Officer.
* Manage communications, inquiries, approvals, and requests on behalf of the executive, as appropriate.
* Foster effective communication between the Product organization and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ensure communications produced on behalf of the executive are accurate, professional, and aligned with business priorities.

ONE Carmel is an 891-acre private community in Carmel Valley, framed by the Santa Lucia Mountains and the Pacific, with 73 estate homes across the property. Under the direction of its CEO and Director of Arts and Culture, ONE Carmel is developing a program of exhibitions, performances, artist residencies, and gatherings that connect the community to the creative life of the Monterey Peninsula and beyond.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support James Pihakis in his dual role as CEO and Director of Arts and Culture. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position for someone who anticipates needs before they are spoken, manages a demanding calendar with judgment, and handles confidential matters with complete discretion. You will sit at the intersection of a real estate business, a cultural program, and a small, fast-moving leadership team.

What you will do Executive support

- Own the CEO's calendar end to end: prioritize competing requests, protect focus time, and resolve conflicts proactively.

- Manage inbox triage and correspondence, drafting replies in the CEO's voice and flagging what needs his attention.

- Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, changes, and expense reconciliation.

- Prepare briefing materials for meetings with homeowners, investors, partners, and civic stakeholders; capture action items and follow through.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for callers and visitors on the CEO's behalf.

Arts and culture program

- Coordinate logistics for exhibitions, performances, salons, artist residencies, and community events, from vendor contracts to day-of run-of-show.

- Track program budgets, invoices, loan agreements, and insurance for artworks and installations.

- Manage guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, and hospitality for cultural gatherings.

- Keep the program calendar, contact database, and archive of press and photography current.

Office and projects

- Build and maintain the systems (CRM, filing, document management) that keep the executive office organized.

- Handle light bookkeeping, purchasing, and vendor coordination for the executive office.

- Take on special projects and limited personal administrative support for the CEO as needed.

- A genuine interest in art, design, music, or culture, and comfort moving between a boardroom and a gallery opening.

UEI, a Sacramento State non-profit auxiliary organization, exists to meet the evolving needs of the campus community by providing programs and services that support and strengthen the Sacramento State experience. Each day, UEI’s management and staff work to advance Sacramento State’s commitment to being an integral educational, intellectual, economic, social, and cultural resource for the region.

UEI is responsible for grant and contract management and fiscal services for University research and sponsored programs, and also provides fiscal and administrative services to University-related agencies and activities. Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com. 

We truly care about our Bitwarden users and want them to have the best experience while accessing their sensitive information online. Our Billing Support team helps people as quickly as possible through our email support system with the majority of inquiries being resolved the same day received. Team members must have excellent writing skills: stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply. Success is measured in swiftness, accuracy, and clarity.

We are searching for an attentive and analytical Billing Support Specialist to assist with resolving billing related customer inquiries, order processing, and account administration. You will advocate for our customers and partner with internal support staff to ensure the client’s specific needs are met to the best of our ability, accounts are billed appropriately, and processes are operating as expected. For this role, we are looking for candidates located in the U.S. 

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage customer accounts, generate invoices, collect payments, and update accounts to reflect changes
  • Answer customer questions about billing and account status
  • Accurately identify and resolve any billing and account errors or issues
  • Review incoming Purchase Orders for accuracy and adherence to sales and finance guidelines
  • Generate invoices for new orders as well as renewal invoices and assure they are calculated and recognized correctly
  • Setup and maintain customer accounts in the billing system
  • Assist with other accounting duties and participate in departmental projects to meet business needs

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • A passion for helping Bitwarden users
  • A strong sense of empathy and the ability to advocate for others
  • Experience with customer service and communicating billing issues with customers and other internal departments
  • Understanding the sensitivity of working with confidential, billing, and accounting information
  • Superb organization, attention to detail, and time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Creative problem-solving skills, good judgment, logic, and ability to learn new things quickly
  • Strong work ethic
  • Experience multitasking in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment
  • Working knowledge of Google G Suite and/or Microsoft Office applications
  • Experience with cloud and/or web-based applications is a plus
  • Experience working with Stripe is a plus
  • Experience in retail or other fast-paced customer facing environments is a plus

 

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Screening call with Recruiting Manager 
  • Interview with Billing Support Manager
  • Interview with Director

 

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team

jobs.desc:
Description

Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimisation, and performance reporting.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to help our Founder and Managing Director, Alex, and our Chief of Staff, Anna, make the best possible use of their time, while ensuring important work across the business is prepared, coordinated and followed through. You'll provide day-to-day EA support to Alex and work closely with Anna on wider business matters.

You will be the metronome that helps the business keep moving. Your work will be extremely high-impact, and you’ll be involved at a high level across the business. This is not a general operations role: your focus is excellent executive support, careful coordination and practical follow-through.

This position can be broken down as follows:

60% support to Alex.

40% support to Anna on wider business priorities, including finance and people administration.

Remote work requires trust, and in this role this will be absolutely critical. Trust is built over time, and accordingly your responsibilities will grow over time. Our hope is that you will prove indispensable to the business, but we understand it will take months to get to this place. Thus, below is a list of some of the responsibilities you’ll be able to grow into over time.

 

Support to Alex 

Your most important responsibility is helping Alex maximise his time, protect his attention, reduce unnecessary context-switching, and stay focused on the work where he adds the most value.

  • Calendar management: Own and manage Alex’s diary and calendar. Protect focused work and create space for strategic priorities. Make sensible scheduling decisions using your knowledge of Alex’s priorities, resolve clashes proactively, and account for preparation, travel time, location, time zones and the purpose of each meeting. Challenge or reorganise meetings where there is a better use of Alex’s time, and make sure Alex has the right preparation and information before important meetings.
  • Inbox and communication: Assist the Managing Director with maintaining an organised and efficient inbox, including drafting replies or responding directly on his behalf at times. Effectively triage emails, understand possible courses of action, and present information to Alex in a way that lets him quickly provide a batch of responses that unblock you. Chase outstanding replies, actions and commitments, and build templates and systems for recurring email patterns so that important messages and obligations do not disappear.
  • Briefings: Prepare a clear, concise morning briefing for Alex at the start of each day before he logs on (8.30am uk), giving him an overview of his schedule, priorities, deadlines, outstanding decisions and follow-up. Monitor his relevant communication channels, use judgement to identify what needs his attention, and make sure he is reminded of important to-dos, commitments and preparation ahead of time. These briefings are sometimes also required in the afte

jobs.title: CRM Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Description

CRM Marketing Manager

Reporting to: CMO
Location: Fully Remote
Markets: 12

About the Role

We are looking for a CRM Marketing Manager to own CXM’s customer lifecycle marketing across 12 markets. You will use customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalised communications to improve activation, first-time deposits, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build CRM journeys from the ground up, manage campaigns across multiple markets, and use performance data to continuously improve results.

Key Objectives

  • Build and launch at least 3 automated lifecycle journeys covering welcome/activation, retention, and reactivation within the first 6 months.
  • Improve the current 9% lead-to-FTD conversion rate through targeted CRM activation campaigns.
  • Support reducing churn to below 10% through structured retention and reactivation programmes.
  • Build and maintain localised CRM journeys across all 12 markets.
  • Maintain 99%+ deliverability and ensure all CRM activity meets applicable compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

  • Own customer journeys across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, loyalty, VIP, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Define triggers, audiences, journey logic, exclusions, frequency caps, and exit criteria.
  • Coordinate email and push communications to create a consistent customer experience.

Campaigns & Automation

  • Build, launch, and optimise automated CRM campaigns using platforms such as Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or equivalent.
  • Create targeted campaigns based on customer behaviour, lifecycle stage, market, language, and product.
  • Manage promotional campaigns, newsletters, VIP communications, retention campaigns, and partner communications.
  • Develop and maintain reusable email templates and content blocks.

Segmentation & Personalisation

  • Build and maintain customer segments, consent lists, exclusions, and communication rules.
  • Configure personalised and dynamic content based on customer data.
  • Work with Product, Analytics, and IT to define and validate data and event requirements.
  • SQL knowledge is a strong advantage.

Localisation

  • Manage CRM communications across multiple languages and markets.
  • Coordinate translation, editing, and linguistic QA.
  • Ensure correct currencies, dates, links, variables, legal messaging, tone, and RTL requirements.
  • Maintain master journeys and localisation matrices across all markets.

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor deliverability, bounces, spam complaints, suppression lists, and domain/IP reputation.
  • Maintain strong email hygiene and deliverability standards.
  • Run detailed pre-launch QA covering audiences, links, variables, tracking, content, sender details, and scheduling.
  • Ensure campaigns comply with consent, unsubscribe, data retention, and local regulatory requirements.

Analytics & Optimisation

  • Analyse CRM performance by market, language, segment, and customer lifecycle stage.
  • Measure conversion, retention, churn, revenue, and incremental uplift — not just opens and clicks.
  • Run A/B and holdout tests across offers, messaging, timing, frequency, channels, and journey structure.
  • Maintain a clear optimisation backlog and turn insights into measurable improvements.


Requirements
  • Proven experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing auto

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products.

As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives
  • Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use
  • Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting
  • Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations
  • Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team
  • Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization

What you should have

  • 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment
  • Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines
  • Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions
  • Experience partnering with Engineering and/or Product on technical escalations, platform integrations, or API-level troubleshooting
  • Successful track record working directly with clients — understanding needs and delivering value
  • Strong analytical proficiency: ability to query and interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions
  • Familiarity with market trends and KPIs such as viewability, brand safety, yield analysis, and audience extension
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a fast-changing, cross-functional environment

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing or building internal automation/tooling (bots, pipelines, dashboards) that scaled a team's operations
  • Team player with a sense of humor, humility, curiosity, and empathy

This position is US-based and can be based in New York (remote) or San Francisco but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.&n

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.desc:
Y Combinator is the leading startup accelerator for entrepreneurs. Since 2005, YC has invested in over 6,000 companies, including Airbnb, Dropbox, OpenAI, Stripe, Reddit, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Instacart. Today, YC has built the most powerful startup community in the world and is committed to supporting founders for the life of their company.

Job Description:

Y Combinator is looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with two General Partners. You’ll help manage their calendar, organize and run events, and use internal YC software to manage communications with our founders and portfolio companies.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable working independently from our San Francisco headquarters. This is an amazing opportunity if you’re curious about startups, enjoy learning how they get started, and would find it interesting to meet the people who start them.

This is also a unique opportunity to enjoy many of the perks of working for a successful company, including a competitive salary and excellent benefits, while working with a small, fast-moving, high-impact team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administrative tasks, including scheduling and calendar management. You’ll help schedule internal and external meetings, preventing conflicts and helping our General Partner use their time efficiently.
  • Plan, execute, and attend many events. You’ll be responsible for helping with the logistics of events held at the YC office and other locations, ranging from 20 to 500+ attendees. You must be available to work evenings and occasionally on weekends. That said, hours are flexible to accommodate time spent outside of standard office hours.
  • Plan, execute, and attend domestic and international events and college tours, along with your General Partner(s).
  • Coordinate travel and be generally able to process ad hoc tasks expeditiously and proactively.
  • Comfortable using AI tools thoughtfully in daily work and to make processes more efficient.
  • Work cross-functionally with other YC team members as needed.
  • Writing projects as requested.

Skills & Experience:

  • At least 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or working in an operations/support position.
  • Comfortable supporting multiple executives with different leadership styles.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Evidence of strong writing ability will be valued especially highly.
  • Strong organizational, project management, problem-solving skills, and multitasking abilities.
  • Friendly demeanor.
  • Familiar with startups.

Every employee at YC has significant individual responsibility and access to sensitive information, so we need to hire people we can trust. Your ability to make good trade-offs and exercise good judgment is particularly important to us.

Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Executive Assistants are expected to work from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-person availability for afternoon and evening events and occasional weekend events.

Compensation: $180,000-$225,000 salary (depending on skills and experience).

Benefits: Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, an infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, a flexible spending account, a health savings account, a 401(k) with 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and a flexible paid time off policy.

Work Authorization: This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone to join our operations team to own customer relationships. This is a hands-on, high-touch role where you’ll be the primary point of contact to our customers and manage their logistics operations end to end. You’ll partner directly with our founders and engineers to drive the products we build.

  • Own a book of freight and customs brokerage clients end to end
  • Build relationships with Director+ supply chain stakeholders and grow accounts across our full suite: brokerage, forwarding, and duty drawback
  • Execute with logistics partners and boots on the ground worldwide
  • Automate your own workflows by building them with AI tools
  • Partner with our CTO to turn your prototypes into durable production software
  • Report directly to the CEO
  • You DO NOT need to have experience in the logistics industry, we will teach you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage day-to-day client operations: bookings, entries, documents, exceptions, billing
  • Coordinate carriers, truckers, warehouses, and agents to keep freight moving
  • Run point when things break: delays, exams, holds, angry phone calls
  • Become the trusted contact for supply chain leaders and expand what they do with us
  • Prototype automation for anything you do more than twice, then ship it as real software with the CTO
  • Wear many hats. Early-stage means we all do a bit of everything

BONUS POINTS IF YOU

  • Have experience in logistics
  • Speak another language fluently
  • Are a licensed customs broker (LCB)

WHY FORGE

  • Founding-level ownership over a core function of the business
  • Small team, fast decisions, no bureaucracy
  • Direct exposure to clients, partners, and how their businesses operate
  • Build the playbook, then build the automation that replaces it
  • 5 days a week in office. We move fast and we do it together

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Free lunches & dinners
  • 401k matching
  • Health insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Competitive salary: we offer three cash/equity balance options; no negotiation needed
