jobs.title: Marketplace Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
Trata hosts unique buyside conversations pertaining public markets between analysts and portfolio managers who manage billions in AUM. We’re working to kill Bloomberg chat and win this market.

Users request calls on a ticker (demand) and make themselves available for calls (supply). We win when daily supply meets demand and the call actually happens. To grow, we must increase both supply and demand.

We’re backed by Y Combinator, Walter Kortschak (SignalFire, Summit Partners), Pioneer Fund, and 10+ hedge funds. The team has worked at xAI, IMC Trading, Instagram, McKinsey, and Evercore.

The Role

We’re hiring a Marketplace Operations Manager to join us in person in Hudson Yards, NY. We’re at seed-stage and are a team of 6.

You will immediately own the core process underlying our business: match, schedule, moderate, and process calls. You learn the process by doing it.

Over time, as you understand the product and the users, you take on the work that grows the marketplace: relationships with high-value users, metrics that move the needle, automations and product features and that remove bottlenecks.

You will learn processes by doing them and work directly with engineering and GTM along the way.

What You’ll Do

Now

  • Own matching, outreach, scheduling, moderation, and post-call processing between users on a ticker.
  • Understand the current process by doing it. Then streamline it. Then automate it independently and with engineering.
  • Treat onboarded users like a working list: follow up, reactivate quiet supply, fill demand that would otherwise die.
  • Establish and run pre- and post-call compliance so volume can rise without breaking trust.
  • Keep transcription and post-call processing on time. Manage contractors as volume moves.

Over Time

  • Grow call engagement: activation, retention, and completed calls per week.
  • Own the scorecard (requests → outreach → reply → confirm → completed call → repeat use) and find the metric we’re missing.
  • Run experiments on call type, ask, and timing. Keep what improves completed calls or quality.
  • Build relationships with high-value users.
  • Automate workflows and collaborate with engineering to scope product features and relieve bottlenecks

Who You Are

  • 2-5 years of working experience doing high-ownership operational work where you personally produced transactions (a match, a call, a booked meeting, etc)
  • High ownership: you take problems from discovery to measurable impact.
  • High agency: few people, unclear processes. You find a way through.
  • You work in the weeds first, then write the playbook, then automate, then iterate.
  • You leverage AI for speed while maintaining rigorous understanding.
  • You are based in NYC or willing to relocate—we work 55-65 hours a week

Why Join Us

  • Rare Opportunity: own the core processes underlying our product with significant expansion potential beyond buy-side analysts.
  • Gain founding experience: a high-upside scaling startup that has yet to scale its team headcount. You contribute to defining operations and direction
  • High autonomy in determining 0→1 operations
  • $120-150k base salary + equity
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance + all meals covered

Interview Steps

  • Screen — 30 minutes
  • Operations working session — 1 hour (we will work together on a relevant case study)
  • Onsite and Meeting with CEO (in office if you’re in New York; virtual otherwise)
  • Offer

Let us know of any timelines and we can complete all steps under a week

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle
jobs.desc:
Company: Rove Next, by Rove Concepts
Location: Remote. Open across the Americas and Europe.
Hours: Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.
Type: Independent contractor, full time
Apply: [talent@rovenext.com]

About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**Operations Coordinator**

*Reports to: Scott Ebert, Owner | Status: Full-Time | Pay: $28–$32/hour (DOE)*

**Role Summary**

The Operations Coordinator owns the day-to-day operational backbone of the business — scheduling, dispatch, ticket lifecycle management, and billing accuracy — so Scott's time is protected for client-facing and high-value work. This role is the connective tissue between the field/service team, the CRM, and billing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Administrative & Logistics**

* Pick up mail and equipment; run business errands as needed

* Serve as a general point of coordination for day-to-day office logistics

**Scheduling & Dispatch**

* Manage Scott's onsite time and meeting calendar — filter and prioritize what should and shouldn't go on his schedule

* Triage incoming service requests by urgency (severe / rush / not a rush)

* Ensure tickets aren't quietly pushed off or left unscheduled without a clear next touchpoint

**Ticket Management & Documentation**

* Improve ticket resolution quality, turnaround time, and documentation standards

* Identify service tickets missing a schedule or follow-up date and get them assigned

* Track open tickets requiring completion follow-up (e.g., pending hardware/server purchases)

* Identify tickets that are ready to close and move to billing

**Billing Accuracy & Quality Control**

* Review closed tickets for billing readiness — confirm the resolution and summary actually support the charge

* Compare time spent vs. time billed; flag anything outside normal minimums/ranges for approval

* Maintain stronger documentation standards across staff to support clean billing

* Cross-check order/equipment spreadsheets against tickets to confirm all purchased products are billed

**Payments & Vendor Coordination**

* Confirm client payment is received/connected before equipment is ordered

* Set up ACH auto-payment for eligible clients

* Support consistent use of service agreements tied to billing

**CRM & Systems**

* Manage a system that ties into the CRM to flag tickets needing more work and route them for assignment

* Own this workflow today, with the expectation that AI tooling will increasingly automate flagging, triage, and billing-match functions over time

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2+ years in an administrative, dispatch, or operations coordinator role (MSP/IT services background preferred, not mandatory)

* Comfort working inside a CRM/ticketing system

* Strong attention to detail with numbers — able to catch a mismatch between time logged and time billed

* Clear written communication; ticket documentation must hold up for both the client and the accountant

* Comfortable owning a calendar/schedule and prioritizing on Scott's behalf

* Basic spreadsheet proficiency (Excel/Google Sheets) for order-vs-ticket reconciliation

* Valid driver's license (for equipment pickup/errands)

**Preferred**

* Experience with QuickBooks or similar invoicing workflows

* Familiarity with ACH/payment processing setup

* Prior experience triaging urgency (dispatch, healthcare scheduling, service coordination)

* Basic understanding of IT service agreements/SLAs and billable minimums

**Soft Skills**

* Sound judgment to flag something as “off” without needing a rule written for every scenario

* Trustworthy with money-adjacent decisions — payment gating before ordering equipment is a real financial control point

Pay: $28.00 - $32.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

### **Job Title:** **Accounting Coordinator**

Employment Type: Hourly part-time

##### **Location: LEARN Main Office in Whittier (in-person)**

**About LEARN**

LEARN LA strives to encourage a culture of learning for both our students and our staff! We offer rewarding internship and job opportunities and proudly support our team members by fostering their professional development and offering promotional opportunities when possible. Join our team at LEARN LA, and see the difference you can make!

**About the role:**

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

Under the supervision of the Chief Operations Officer, the Accounting Coordinator performs a range of fiscal duties and responsibilities including processing a variety of accounting transactions such as invoices, payments, and expenses in accordance with department procedures. Maintains accounting files. Checks and verifies accounting data; enters data into computerized accounting system and uses systems to research questions and generate reports. Processes accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, account reconciliation and performs related general clerical accounting duties. Basic Payroll-related tasks will be performed occasionally, as needed. The incumbent communicates with LEARN staff and vendors to ensure that fiscal activities and reporting are accurate, timely, and follow LEARN, State, Federal, and grant related policies and procedures.

**What you'll do:**

* Assist the department with running the day to day operations of Accounts Payable (AP) including, but not limited to:
* Collecting, inputting, processing transactions and monitoring activities for all accounts payable functions;
* Collect, review, and process all fixed assets and inventory;
* Review and process check requests and cash disbursements; and
* Reconcile all AP and fixed assets/inventory on a monthly basis to ensure accurate records.
* Processes Accounts Receivable by invoicing contract customers on a monthly basis for services rendered in accordance with LEARN’s contracts/agreements;

* Communicate with staff and vendors regarding fiscal matters;
* Process AP, AR and Fixed Assets/Inventory reports regularly, as requested by the Staff Accountant and Director of Finance;
* Assist the department with maintaining users and workflows in its accounting software;
* Develop, organize and maintain electronic and hard copy fiscal files of all AR, AP and Fixed Assets/Inventory;
* Assist with annual audit preparation activities;
* Other related duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

Requires a BA degree in finance, accounting, or related field; **OR**

An AA degree in finance, accounting, or related field **and** two years of experience performing fiscal related duties.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES**

Requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use sound judgment. Requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to work as part of a team. Requires knowledge of basic laws, rules, and regulations related to employee payroll and other fiscal matters administered by a nonprofit.

**LANGUAGE & COMPUTER SKILLS**

Requires the ability to utilize basic word processing and financial related software including Microsoft Word, and Excel. Experience with Abila related software is highly preferred. Basic knowledge of payroll and other financially related laws and rules.

**PHYSICAL SKILLS**

Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds and push up to 100 pounds (on wheels). Must be able to hear staff on the phone and those who are served in-person, and speak clearly in order to communicate information to vendors and staff. Must have vision with or without lenses adequate to read memos, a computer screen, forms and administrative documents. Must have high manual dexterity. jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.desc:
**Position Overview**

The Office Assistant is integral to our team, focusing on the initial intake, lead creation, and coordination of activities related to mitigation and reconstruction services. This role involves a variety of administrative tasks, ensuring efficient workflow and communication between different departments and external parties.

**Responsibilities**

The Office Assistant will perform the following duties, along with any additional responsibilities as assigned by management:

**Administrative and Data Management:**

* Manage inbound and outbound phone calls, serving as the initial point of contact for inquiries and facilitating lead generation.
* Enter comprehensive lead details into the DASH system with meticulous attention to accuracy and completeness. This includes recording customer information, detailed job specifications, loss descriptions, any special instructions, and areas affected.
* Facilitate seamless communication with external parties to ensure precise recording of insurance-related information.
* Efficiently assign leads to appropriate stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-ups and smooth progression through the pipeline.
* Monitor and track compliance tasks, such as contact and inspection dates, to ensure adherence to established timelines and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain proactive and transparent communication with customers, providing regular updates on the progress of their projects and the estimation process.
* Create and maintain detailed Dash Notes to facilitate internal communication, ensuring all team members are well-informed about lead statuses and job assignments.

**Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Collaborate closely with the Business Development and Estimation teams to optimize lead conversion rates.
* Coordinate the scheduling of inspections in alignment with customer preferences and project requirements.
* Facilitate the execution of Performance Authorizations and Construction Agreements, ensuring all necessary documentation is completed accurately and on time.
* Act as a liaison between different departments, fostering seamless communication and collaboration to drive efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in a similar role or administrative position is preferred.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic understanding of the insurance claims process is advantageous.
* Attention to detail and the ability to work with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in navigating diverse personalities.

**Physical Requirements & Work Conditions**

* Fulfill all standard office activities including prolonged seating, computer entry, filing, lifting, and carrying office supplies.
* General office environment exposure.
* Moderate noise levels that are typical of an office setting.

**Payroll/HR Administrator & Accounting Assistant**
===================================================

**About SteelWave**

SteelWave is a vertically integrated real estate investment manager, owner, and operator with a commercial portfolio across the western U.S., including Northern and Southern California, Denver, Seattle, and Austin. Since 1973, we have acquired and developed more than $11 billion in real estate.

**The Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Payroll/HR Administrator to own multi-state payroll for 75–100 employees, support core Payroll/HR operations, and assist the accounting team. This is a hands-on role for someone who values accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through.

**What You'll Do**

**Payroll & HR (~60%)**

* Process multi-state payroll and time reporting for exempt and non-exempt employees, ensuring compliance with company policy and wage and hour laws.

**Accounting (~40%)**

* Support accounts payable, including employee expense reports and weekly check/ACH payment runs.
* Prepare wire requests and assist with processing wires.
* Assist with corporate accounting, including cost allocations.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2–5 years of payroll processing and time reporting experience; HR or recruiting coordination experience a plus.
* Working knowledge of federal and state wage and hour laws; multi-state payroll experience preferred.
* TriNet/PEO experience a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and math aptitude for payroll calculations and reconciliations.
* Excellent organization; able to manage competing deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Clear written and verbal communication and a service-oriented approach with employees at all levels.
* High degree of discretion with confidential information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; comfortable learning new systems.

Why leave Orange County to build a tech company, when you can do it right here in OC?

About Us  
Month2Month is a rare tech startup based in central south Orange County, an area more commonly known for its peaceful lifestyle than for startup activity, founded by leaders from top Silicon Valley companies like NVIDIA and Intel. Our mission is to bring the innovation-driven mindset of Silicon Valley to OC and create a home for professionals who want to stay local without compromising on growth, challenge, or impact.

We operate furnished homes across multiple U.S. markets and manage the full housing experience, from property onboarding and reservations to move-in, customer service, maintenance, billing, and ongoing property operations, and we are reimagining the midterm rental market with full-stack, AI-powered solutions.

Our team structure is built for agility and innovation. We take bold ideas from 0 to 1, scale them from 1 to 10, and grow them from 10 to 100. Month2Month is seeking an experienced Regional Customer Experience & Product Operations Manager to own tenant experience and related product operations for an assigned geographic region from the beginning of the role.

You will serve as the accountable business owner for tenant customer service and customer experience within your region. You will lead the team supporting regional tenants throughout their stay, manage escalated cases, improve service processes, and work closely with product and engineering teams to turn regional customer feedback into scalable product and system improvements.

This is not a traditional customer service supervisor position. You will manage business performance, develop team capabilities, improve operational systems, and make independent decisions that balance customer experience, operating costs, company policies, and long-term business value.

You will begin with direct responsibility for one assigned region. As you demonstrate results, the role can expand to additional markets or broader ownership of the region's operations and business performance.

Team Management and Development

--------------------

The Sales Project Coordinator is responsible for driving execution, accountability, and coordination of key sales initiatives, customer programs, and strategic projects across the organization. This role serves as the central point of contact between Sales, Customer Service, Procurement, Operations, Logistics, and key customers to ensure projects remain on schedule, customer expectations are met, and business objectives are achieved.

The Sales Project Coordinator is a strategic and hands-on leader who manages complex customer programs, tracks performance metrics, identifies risks, and facilitates communication among internal and external stakeholders. This position plays a critical role in supporting revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence within the flexible packaging distribution business.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Program and Project Management**

* Lead and manage multiple customer programs and sales-related projects simultaneously.
* Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and accountability measures.
* Monitor project progress and proactively address delays, risks, and bottlenecks.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of customer commitments.
* Facilitate project meetings and provide regular status updates to leadership.

* Partner with Sales and the Operations Teams to support strategic customer accounts.
* Assist with customer onboarding, program launches, product transitions, and implementation activities.

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to sales programs and project execution.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting systems.
* Support forecasting, pipeline management, and sales planning initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, and customer service levels.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Procurement, Quotation, Art, Warehouse Logistics, Customer Service, and Accounting teams.
* Coordinate inventory planning and product availability for customer programs.
* Ensure alignment between customer demand forecasts and operational capabilities.
* Facilitate communication between departments to resolve issues and maintain project timelines.

### **Process Improvement**

* Develop standardized tools, procedures, and best practices for project management.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Analyze data and trends to identify opportunities for process optimization.
* Recommend and implement solutions that support company growth objectives.

### **Leadership and Strategic Support**

* Support senior sales leadership with strategic initiatives and special projects.

* Mentor sales team members on project management best practices when appropriate.

* Experience using CRM systems, ERP platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in flexible packaging, packaging distribution, manufacturing, industrial products, or B2B sales environments strongly preferred.

Our Finance and Shared Services team supports a multi-entity organization that is scaling quickly, and we're looking for people who want to build strong processes as we grow.

The Accounts Payable Specialist manages the full AP cycle across Reliant's legal entities, from invoice intake through payment and reconciliation. * Respond promptly and professionally to vendor and internal inquiries.

------------

* 3+ years of full-cycle accounts payable experience
* Working knowledge of accrual accounting and month-end close processes
* Experience with an ERP system; NetSuite strongly preferred
* Proficiency in Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and reconciliations

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Truck Dispatcher to coordinate and manage the daily operations of freight transportation. In this vital role, you will oversee the scheduling, routing, and dispatching of trucks to ensure timely deliveries while maintaining compliance with transportation regulations. Your energetic approach will help optimize fleet efficiency, enhance customer satisfaction, and support seamless communication across teams. About the Role

We are seeking an experienced **Contract Accountant / Bookkeeper** to manage full-cycle accounting for our standalone restaurant operating within a hotel property. ● **Financial Reporting & Month-End Close:** Complete month-end reconciliations and prepare GAAP-compliant monthly financial statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, Statement of Cash Flows, and Prime Cost analysis) by the 8th of each month.

● **Sales Tax & Compliance:** Prepare and file monthly state/local sales and mixed beverage tax returns on time.

Qualifications & Experience

● **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience (5+ years in full-charge restaurant bookkeeping).

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.desc:
About Slarve Construction

Slarve Construction is a high-end residential general contractor specializing in custom homes, large-scale remodels, and fine finish work throughout the Napa Valley and East Bay. Our project teams work closely with clients, architects, designers, subcontractors, and our in-house cabinet shop to deliver thoughtful, well-executed homes.

Position Details

* **Reports to:** Director of Operations
* **Location:** Napa, CA (office-based)
* **Employment type:** Full-time, hourly (non-exempt, overtime eligible)
* **Pay range:** $26.50–$31.25 per hour (approximately $55,000–$65,000 annually), depending on experience

Position Summary

The Construction Project Coordinator keeps our projects organized from preconstruction through closeout. Working alongside Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Superintendents, this role manages the documents, schedules, communication, and paperwork that keep a job moving — balancing multiple projects and priorities while providing day-to-day support to the office and field teams.

Career Path

We believe in growing our people from within. This role is a strong foundation for advancing to Project Engineer, with mentoring and hands-on exposure to estimating, design coordination, and project controls along the way.

What You'll Do

**Preconstruction & bidding**

* Distribute plans, specifications, and bid packages to subcontractors and suppliers; track bid responses and follow up on outstanding bids.
* Prepare subcontract and purchase order paperwork for Project Manager review.

**Document control**

* Maintain project records in Buildertrend, including drawings, submittals, RFIs, change orders, and correspondence.
* Make sure the office and field teams are always working from the current set of drawings and documents.
* Log, route, and track RFIs, submittals, and shop drawings; follow up on open items until closed.
* Log change orders and route them to the project team for review and approval.

**Scheduling & meetings**

* Enter weekly schedule updates in Buildertrend with input from the Superintendent and Project Manager.
* Schedule project meetings; prepare and distribute agendas and meeting minutes, and track action items.
* Coordinate permits, inspections, and material deliveries with the field team.

**Client selections & procurement**

* Track client selections, finish approvals, and long-lead orders, working closely with designers and our in-house cabinet shop.

**Subcontractor & financial administration**

* Collect and track subcontractor insurance certificates, contracts, and lien releases.
* Support billing and vendor paperwork with the accounting team.
* Code and enter subcontractor and supplier invoices and job receipts in Buildertrend to the correct project and cost codes (synced to QuickBooks), and route them to the Project Manager for approval.

**Closeout**

* Compile punch lists and track completion with the Superintendent.
* Assemble closeout packages, including warranties, as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and final lien releases.

**Team support**

* Manage multiple priorities across projects while serving as a reliable point of contact for clients, subcontractors, and our internal team.
* Learn and help improve Slarve's project management processes and software.

What You Bring

* At least two years of experience in construction project coordination, project administration, or a similar support role.
* Familiarity with construction documents, including plans, specifications, and subcontracts.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across projects.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with clients, subcontractors, and team members.
* High attention to detail and follow-through.
* Comfort with project management software and Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Outlook.
* Good judgment, a positive attitude, and a practical, team-first approach to solving problems.

jobs.desc:
**About Us**

Maine Custom Woodlands is a family-owned forestry and excavation company in Durham, Maine, serving landowners across south-central and mid-coast Maine. We run forestry operations, a trucking company, and we're starting up a sawmill. Learn more at mainecustomwoodlands.com.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented **Full Charge Bookkeeper** to oversee all financial recordkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and month-end closing procedures. You will own the full financial cycle, ensure strict accuracy, and report directly to the VP of Internal Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **General Ledger:** Maintain and balance the general ledger and record daily financial transactions. Perform daily and monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.
* **Fuel tracking and fuel-tax reporting.** Track on- and off-road fuel use and prepare state excise and sales tax data for returns.
* **Accounts Payable & Receivable (AP/AR):** Process vendor invoices, schedule supplier payments, issue customer invoices, and follow-up on collections.
* **Payroll:** Process timesheets, run payroll, and submit quarterly/annual payroll tax filings.
* **Financial Reporting:** Prepare profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and monthly or quarterly financial statements.
* **Month/Year-End:** Execute month-end and year-end closings, track fixed assets, and organize records for external CPAs and annual audits.
* **Compliance paperwork.** Assemble and keep current the registrations, permits, inspections, insurance applications, and tax-prep documents.
* **Assist in office operations.** Support vendors, employees, and clients; help onboard new employees to our systems.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience/education:** 3 to 5+ years of proven bookkeeping or full-cycle accounting experience. A degree in finance or business administration is a strong plus.
* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced working knowledge of accounting software like QuickBooks, plus strong Microsoft Excel skills.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Solid understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and local, state, and federal tax compliance.
* **Leadership skills:** You take responsibility for your work tasks and own them fully. Ability to identify manual, clunky, or duplicated work and streamline it.
* **Accurate, organized and discreet:** Attention to every detail to make sure the numbers are correct. You'll handle sensitive financial and personnel information and treat it that way.

**Details**

Full-time, Monday–Friday, in office in Durham, ME, with some flexibility on daily hours. Benefits include paid holidays, paid time off, and health insurance.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

MCM is recognized as one of the world’s leading groups of talented and knowledgeable marine industry experts who know that the best results stem from dedication, unwavering focus and teamwork in order to provide our clients with an unrivaled experience.

MCM is seeking a Bookkeeper professional to join our dynamic and growing team. This role will support the Yacht Management Division, the Accounting Department and the Principal in meeting the high standards and level of service MCM is known for.

  

**Job Summary:**

The Full Charge Bookkeeper is responsible for supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the company and its managed yachts. This role performs a variety of bookkeeping, accounting, reporting, and administrative functions to ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, and efficient management of client funds.

The position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and a proactive approach in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Yacht Accounting & Financial Management**

* Prepare monthly financial statements, financial reports, and annual budgets for assigned yachts.

* Review invoices daily within the Voly yacht accounting system.

**Client & Crew Support**

* QuickBooks
* Voly Yacht Accounting System

As an Executive Assistant Floater, you will provide high-quality administrative support across a variety of teams and executives, stepping in where coverage is needed while also supporting ongoing assignments. jobs.title: Creative Marketing Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**Creative Marketing Coordinator**  
Location: Mare Island Brewing Co. – Coal Shed Brewery (Vallejo, CA)  
Pay: $20–28/hr, Full-time

Mare Island has been a place where people build what they can't buy since 1854. Our brewery is built on that history. Every beer we make is named for a person, place or event from the Mare Island Naval Shipyard, and we tell those stories across our cans, our three taprooms and every channel in between.

We're looking for a Creative Marketing Coordinator: a designer first, who wants to grow into branding and communications. You'll be one half of a two-person marketing team, working directly with our Director of Marketing. Your work goes out into the world fast, and you'll learn how marketing actually works, not just how to make the assets for it.

The role is based at our Coal Shed Brewery on the Mare Island waterfront. You'll also make regular trips to our Ferry Taproom in the Vallejo Ferry Terminal and to First Street Taphouse in downtown Benicia.

**What You'll Do**

* Design the materials that carry our brand: menus, taproom posters and signage, social graphics, email, and collateral for our taprooms and wholesale partners.
* Take a loose brief and run with it. Requests come in fast, and we need someone who can turn them around on-brand without much hand-holding.
* Plan, create and publish social content that connects people with our beer, our story and our taprooms.
* Shoot photo and video at events, beer releases and around the taprooms.
* Run marketing projects start to finish, following up with printers, vendors and our own team to keep things on deadline.
* Help build out our email marketing.
* Bonus: hand-drawn work. A few times a year that means label illustrations and beer boards.

**What We're Looking For**

* A degree in graphic design or equivalent experience, and a portfolio to show for it.
* Strong layout and typography skills in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop). You can work inside an established brand system and make it look sharp.
* A good eye behind a camera, for both photo and video. Phone work counts.
* Curiosity about the marketing side: why one post works and another doesn't, and how a message changes between Instagram and a poster on the taproom wall.
* Organized enough to keep several projects and vendors moving at once.
* Comfortable working some evenings and weekends for events.
* Writing chops are a plus. Illustration is a big plus.
* Bonus points if you know Vallejo, Benicia or the North Bay.
* Passion for craft beer and curiosity about our history.

**Why You'll Love It Here**

* Your work will be on menus, taproom walls, screens and sometimes cans, and fast.
* You'll learn branding, communications and marketing strategy from the inside, not from the sidelines.
* You'll be part of a small, close-knit team at an independent craft brewery, voted SFGATE's 2026 Best Brewery.
* And of course… there's beer.

**Benefits**

* Paid vacation and holidays
* Employer-shared health, dental and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Employee discounts on beer, food and merchandise
* Monthly "beer benefits"

**How to Apply**  
Send your resume and a link to your portfolio. If you have hand-drawn or illustration work, or photo or video you've shot, include it. Then tell us in a sentence or two: why this job, and why us?

### **Description**

**THE PURPOSE:** This role manages the end-to-end accounts receivable process for True Religion’s Major Department Store, specialty, and international accounts, ensuring revenue is accurately invoiced, collected, and protected against unwarranted deductions. The Accounts Receivable Specialist plays a critical role in maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing financial exposure by researching and resolving chargeback claims, driving timely collections, and identifying the root causes of operationally triggered deductions. By partnering closely with Customer Service, Sales, Shipping, and IT, this role helps translate wholesale routing and shipping requirements into practices that prevent future chargebacks. The ideal candidate brings the credibility and consistency needed to maintain strong customer and cross-functional relationships while protecting True Religion’s bottom line.

* Own collections for an assigned portfolio of Major Department Store, specialty, and international accounts, ensuring invoices are paid within terms.

You move easily between internal teams and outside customers, building the kind of trust that gets invoices paid and disputes resolved without unnecessary back-and-forth. You take ownership of your accounts, stay organized under deadline pressure, and bring both rigor and resourcefulness to solving collections challenges.

### **REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

  

* 2+ years of experience in accounts receivable or collections within a retail/wholesale environment, including work with Major Department Store accounts
* Proven experience researching, disputing, and resolving chargebacks and deductions

* Proficiency in Excel, including building and maintaining weekly aging reports

Nationwide Auto Services (NAS) is an automotive field services company delivering work order based projects across the United States and Canada, billing OEMs, logistics providers, ports, and dealer groups. Because NAS crews travel to job sites and incur significant travel, per diem, and pass through costs, the role also administers the travel and expense process end to end, ensuring every dollar of project spend is captured, coded, reviewed, and either recovered from the customer or correctly recorded. This is a hands on position in a high volume, project billing environment where the quality of invoice and expense documentation directly determines whether a receivable is collected. The role prepares billing and administers expenses under the direction and review of the Controller.

Assemble supporting backup workbooks (weekly hours detail, per diem days, reconciliations, and exception logs) to the standard each customer requires, ensuring every invoice line traces to source documentation before it is released.

* Customer Master and Setup. Maintain customer records, billing contacts, portal credentials , purchase order tracking, and payment terms. Coordinate new customer and new work order setup so that billing requirements are documented before the first invoice.
* Payable Email Management. Own the shared AP and billing inbox, triaging customer remittances, portal notices, and billing inquiries daily, routing or responding to each promptly, and logging items against the correct work order so nothing affecting billing or collections is missed.
* Cross Entity Billing. Support intercompany and Canadian entity invoicing under Controller direction, including correct entity attribution and tax treatment on cross border work.
* Receipt Capture and Documentation. Ensure receipts and supporting documentation are captured for every project expense at the point of spend, follow up promptly on missing or incomplete receipts, and administer the expense platform (for example Ramp or comparable) so that transactions, receipts, and memos are matched with a clean trail from receipt to work order to invoice.

This is a high-trust role for someone who takes ownership, exercises good judgment, and follows through until there is a real resolution.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.desc:
**DEPARTMENT** **OVERVIEW**:

The Accounts Payable Specialist will review, reconcile, and pay multiple entity bills in a timely fashion. This requires not only understanding the accounting process but also working knowledge of a company’s operations.

**POSITION** **OVERVIEW**:

The Accounts Payable Specialist sets up new vendors with all the correct documentation, receives vendor invoices and routes them to the appropriate manager for approval. Once vendor invoices have been approved or match to a purchase order, they will voucher in our ERP system and cut bi-weekly check and ACH runs per Vendor’s terms. They monitor discount opportunities to ensure the company receives the discount. They also run accounts payable reports for month end and year end process.

**Essential Functions**

* Review invoices for accuracy, appropriate approvals, and support documentation prior to payment.
* Perform accurate and timely invoice data entry.
* Process a high volume of purchase orders and related invoices.
* Maintain organized and accurate records for approved and vouchered invoices.
* Obtain required signatures and process checks for distribution.
* Support other departments with research expenses.
* Prepare and review monthly Vendor Aging and Received Invoice Pending reports.
* Assist with annual 1099 preparation, including reviewing vendor information and verifying Federal Tax Identification Numbers.
* Maintain professional and responsive relationships with vendors, including researching and resolving invoice and payment inquiries.
* Research and resolve invoice discrepancies, missing documentation, duplicate invoices, and other payment-related issues.
* Maintain vendor records and ensure supporting documentation is complete and accurate.
* Support Accounts Payable month-end and year-end activities as needed.
* Follow established accounting procedures and internal controls related to invoice processing and payments.
* Assist the Accounting Supervisor and/or Accounting Manager with additional accounting responsibilities and special projects as needed.

**Competency**

* Problem Solving – Identifies and analyzes issues, researches discrepancies, and works collaboratively with others to develop effective solutions.
* Interpersonal Skills – Maintains positive and professional working relationships. Approaches conflict constructively, maintains confidentiality, listens respectfully, and remains open to feedback and new ideas.
* Communication – Communicates clearly and professionally with vendors, coworkers, and management. Listen carefully, seek clarification when needed, and responds appropriately to questions and requests.
* Teamwork – Works effectively both independently and as part of a team. Supports coworkers, contributes to a positive work environment, and works collaboratively toward department and company goals.
* Ethics and Integrity – Demonstrates honesty, professionalism, discretion, and integrity when handling company, employee, vendor, and financial information.
* Company Values – Follows established policies and procedures and supports the company’s goals and values. Demonstrates professionalism and leads by example.
* Adaptability – Adjusts effectively to changing priorities, deadlines, processes, and unexpected situations while maintaining accuracy and productivity.
* Attendance and Punctuality – Maintains reliable and consistent attendance and punctuality and communicates appropriately when an absence may affect work responsibilities.

**Office Manager – Hospice**

**Location: Walnut Ridge, AR**  
**Job Type: Full-Time | Hourly**  
  
**About Us**

At Legacy Hospice, we’re committed to providing compassionate, high-quality care to patients and families facing life-limiting illnesses. We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Office Manager to keep our daily operations running smoothly and support our care team in making a difference every day.

As the Office Manager, you will serve as the hub of our hospice branch operations—supporting administrative tasks, managing clinical records, coordinating supply orders, and assisting with payroll and billing functions.

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records in compliance with regulatory guidelines
* Manage phone calls, scheduling updates, and interoffice communications

* Coordinate invoices, billing, and payroll communication with the corporate office
* Assist with internal audits and compliance tasks
* Track patient admissions, discharges, and recertification dates
* Participate in team meetings, trainings, and community outreach events

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required (Associate’s degree preferred)
* Minimum 2 years of experience in an administrative role, preferably in a healthcare or hospice setting
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and general office technology (phones, printers, tablets, etc.)
* Familiarity with healthcare billing, EMRs, or clinical documentation systems a plus
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally
* Valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation
* Please note: Legacy Hospice is a drug-free workplace. Pre-employment drug screening is required, including testing for marijuana.

**What We Offer**

* Mission-driven culture focused on patient dignity and compassionate care
* Competitive pay and benefits
* Supportive team environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Competitive hourly wage and mileage reimbursement where applicable

**Apply today to help make a meaningful impact behind the scenes of patient care.**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking **Billing Specialist** for our specialty mental health programs. Operating within a manual data workflow utilizing **Excel and FileMaker Pro**, this role requires advanced technical precision, data reconciliation, and analytical skill. The Billing Specialist serves as our primary liaison to county and state electronic health record portals. This role focuses strictly on financial, coding, and administrative billing rules, working in partnership with the Clinical Director (Clinical QA Lead) and the Administrative Assistant.

**1. Clinical Data Entry**

* **Manual Data Bridges:** Extract service records from FileMaker Pro, cross-reference them for accuracy, and maintain master billing ledgers in **Microsoft Excel**.
* **County Portal Entry:** Enter all single service episodes and manually open and close client treatment episodes on the **County CCLink Portal System** to match internal tracking databases.
* **Claims Batching:** Input and submit claims with exact precision through county portals.
* **Authorization Tracking:** Secure, track, and input service authorization codes directly into FileMaker Pro to keep staff informed of approved billing limits.

2. Eligibility Verification & Managed Care Tracking

* **Bulk Monthly Scrubs:** Run a manual medi-cal eligibility sweep on the **Medi-Cal Provider Portal** during the first week of every month for all active clients.
* **Database Updates:** Log updated eligibility status for medi-cal

3. Denial Management & Error Resolution

* **External Rejection Cleardown:** Monitor remittance data (ERAs and EOBs) to catch, investigate, and correct external county/state billing denials (e.g., eligibility lapses, CPT/ICD-10 code mismatches).
* **Resubmission:** Correct technical financial data errors in the system and execute the manual re-batching and resubmission of modified claims.

4. Compliance & Audit Reporting (NOABD)

* **Master Log Maintenance:** Own and maintain the agency’s **Master NOABD (Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination) Tracking Spreadsheet** in Excel to monitor the 10-day timely access window and safeguard reimbursement records.
* **Financial Audit Prep:** Collect, organize, and compile financial billing records and timely access logs to ensure the agency passes annual county audits.
* **Clinical Boundary Adherence:** Route any documentation or medical necessity errors discovered during the billing process directly to the **Clinical Director**, who acts as the sole Quality Assurance Lead for clinical issues.
* **File Management:** Organize and archive electronic remittance advices (ERAs), explanation of benefits (EOBs), and all official agency financial folders.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

* **Experience:** Minimum of **2 to 3 years of hands-on medical billing experience**, with at least **1 year focusing directly on California Medi-Cal Specialty Mental Health** or behavioral health billing. High
* **Education:** High School completion or equivalent
* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced, expert-level comfort with **Microsoft Excel** (managing complex data sheets) and experience working within **FileMaker Pro** or similar relational databases.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Solid understanding of California HIPAA rules, mental health coding structures (CPT codes and ICD-10 modifiers), and county-level behavioral health administrative standards preferred but not required.
* **Analytical Precision:** Outstanding speed and accuracy in manual data entry, with a proven ability to reconcile numbers across separate systems without automated EHR integration.
* **Mission Alignment:** Commitment to collaborating effectively within a tight-knit, multi-disciplinary nonprofit team serving vulnerable populations.

Newport Beach, CA

This role will manage ongoing development and construction projects throughout the commercial portfolio. Aspects of the role will include the definition, documentation and implementation of all construction requirements and processes to ensure timelines and deadlines are met and client expectations are exceeded.

**About the NFF:** As the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS), the National Forest Foundation was chartered by Congress in 1990. Today, the NFF advances forest resiliency, healthy watersheds and wildlife habitat, and recreation for all by working with communities and organizations across the country. The Foundation has grown significantly in the last few years in programmatic impact, revenue and support, and organizational capacity. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country’s 193-million-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals to advance and prepare forests for a new economy.

**Position Function:** The Southern California Project Coordinator reports to the Southern California Program Director and will work closely with key members of SCIRP, including the USDA Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.

The Project Coordinator will support project development and implementation of roadside ignition projects; coordinate with federal, state, and private partners; and support fundraising efforts for projects. This position will work with their supervisor and key members of SCIRP to support project solicitation, project prioritization, and development of the 10-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.

**Position Duties and Responsibilities:** The Southern California Project Coordinator will:

* Work closely with the key SCIRP members and teams to develop project pipeline tools that will support project prioritization, planning, and implementation.
* Support development of the 10-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.
* Develop relationships and facilitate communication between SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Develop agendas, facilitate, and document takeaways for meetings among SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Coordinate with agency partners to complete environmental review, including coordinating associated activities and processes as needed.
* Coordinate and oversee site visits with SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Provide regular updates to the SCIRP Executive Committee and Core Team.
* Work with NFF staff and SCIRP members to secure funds from government sources, foundations, corporations, and individuals to support projects.
* Support preparation of progress and funding reports for federal, state, and local government funding sources as well as for philanthropic support from corporations, foundations, and individuals.
* Oversee the advertisement, negotiation, and award of contracts for services related to SCIRP projects.
* Maintain a breadth of knowledge about current trends, emerging issues, policy interventions, and innovations related to wildfire risk reduction and relevant land management policy and regulations.

* Assist with practice growth, patient communication, and community outreach
* Work comfortably with **AI tools, social media, and digital technology**
* Look for ways to improve systems, efficiency, and the patient experience

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

* **Mature, responsible, and highly organized**
* Naturally **outgoing, engaging, and friendly**
* A strong communicator who genuinely enjoys talking with people
* Comfortable taking initiative and owning responsibilities
* Able to multitask and prioritize without becoming overwhelmed
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and executive skills
* Confident enough to talk with patients about treatment and financial considerations
* Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new technology, including AI
* Social-media savvy or excited to learn
* Someone who brings **energy, personality, and enthusiasm** to their work
* Interested in helping build something—not just filling a position

Dental Experience? Helpful, But Not Required.

**We can teach you our dental software, systems, and processes.**

What we **can’t teach is personality, initiative, organization, communication skills, and the desire to connect with people.**

If you have the right foundation and are smart, motivated, organized, and willing to learn, we’re happy to train you in the dental side of the job.

Our Vibe

We’re a **small, boutique, wellness-focused dental practice**, and we’re definitely not a stuffy corporate office.

We’re a **fun-loving, slightly wacky dental family** who works hard, laughs a lot, supports each other, and genuinely cares about our patients.

We’re passionate about **whole-body wellness** and providing personalized, patient-centered care.

We’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that culture and **VIBE with us.**

If you’re naturally warm and engaging, love people, enjoy being busy, and want to play an important role in helping a practice grow, **we want to hear from you!**

This Position Is NOT a Fit If...

* You prefer to work quietly behind the scenes with minimal interaction
* You don’t enjoy talking with people
* You need to be told what to do at every step
* Multitasking and organization aren't your strengths
* You need to be micromanaged

**We want personality. We want initiative. We want someone who brings their spark to the office every day.**

If that sounds like you, **please apply—we’d love to meet you!**

jobs.title: Medical Assistant/Receptionist
jobs.desc:
**Job Overview**

Join our dynamic healthcare team as a Medical Assistant/Receptionist, where you'll be the friendly face and efficient coordinator at the front desk and beyond. This vital role combines patient-centered medical assisting with administrative excellence, ensuring smooth clinic operations and exceptional patient care. Your energy and attention to detail will help create a welcoming environment for patients while supporting clinical workflows across specialties such as dermatology, urgent care, hospital medicine, and more. If you’re passionate about healthcare, eager to grow your skills, and thrive in a fast-paced setting, this opportunity is perfect for you!

**Duties**

* Greet patients warmly, verify their information, and assist with check-in procedures using Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems.
* Collect patient vital signs, perform basic phlebotomy, and document medical histories accurately.
* Assist healthcare providers with clinical tasks such as taking patient histories, preparing exam rooms, and supporting procedures like medication administration or minor treatments.
* Manage appointment scheduling, patient intake processes, and follow-up communications to ensure seamless clinic flow.
* Maintain precise medical documentation, including medical records, ICD coding for diagnoses, and detailed notes in EMR/EHR systems.
* Support clinical staff with tasks like taking vital signs, performing basic physiology assessments, and assisting with inpatient or outpatient procedures.
* Handle administrative duties including answering phones, managing patient inquiries, verifying insurance information, and processing billing or coding as needed.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations by maintaining accurate medical records and adhering to hospital or clinic protocols for emergency medicine or trauma center procedures when applicable.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in a medical office environment with familiarity in medical administrative support and clinical assisting roles.

The Human Resources Assistant provides essential administrative support to the Campus and the Human Resources department. This role is responsible for assisting with recruitment, onboarding, employee records management, payroll and benefits support as needed while ensuring compliance.

* Ensure all federal, state, and local labor laws posters are hung
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive employee information

jobs.desc:
**Position Overview:**

The Human Resources Coordinator serves as the on-site HR resource for our California location. This position owns day-to-day HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including recruiting support, onboarding, leave administration, benefits support, employee relations, and California compliance, and serves as the site liaison to centralized payroll and HR functions in Georgia.

The Coordinator applies sound judgment within established policies and procedures, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the CHRO. This full-time, non-exempt role offers professional development and potential advancement to HR Generalist.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Recruiting & Onboarding**

* Assist the Georgia-based recruiting team with California hiring, including coordinating interviews with site managers, communicating with local candidates, and gathering hiring manager feedback
* Review California job postings before publication for required pay scale disclosure (California Labor Code 432.3) and California Fair Chance Act compliance; flag issues to the recruiting team
* Coordinate local pre-employment steps, such as background checks and drug screens, in partnership with the recruiting team and consistent with the Fair Chance Act individualized assessment process
* Conduct new hire orientation; complete and verify Form I-9 within required timeframes; issue California-required new hire notices, including the Wage Theft Prevention Act notice

**Leave & Benefits Administration**

* Administer leaves of absence under FMLA, CFRA, Pregnancy Disability Leave, and California paid sick leave, including eligibility tracking, required notices, and return-to-work
* Coordinate the interactive process for accommodation requests in partnership with the CHRO, and document outcomes
* Support benefits enrollment, life event changes, and open enrollment; coordinate SDI and Paid Family Leave paperwork with employees

**Employee Relations**

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions and concerns regarding policies, procedures, and workplace issues
* Advise supervisors on routine performance, attendance, and conduct matters; prepare and maintain corrective action documentation
* Intake complaints and support workplace investigations under the direction of the CHRO; promptly escalate allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, or safety violations
* Coordinate separations, including exit paperwork and California final pay timing requirements

**Compliance & Safety**

* Administer the California harassment prevention training cycle (two hours for supervisors, one hour for non-supervisory employees, every two years and within six months of hire or promotion) and track completion
* Maintain required federal and California workplace postings and annual notice updates
* Conduct periodic I-9 and personnel file audits; maintain records in accordance with California retention requirements
* Coordinate workers’ compensation claims; maintain the Cal/OSHA Form 300 log and support the site Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP)

**Payroll & Timekeeping Liaison**

* Serve as site liaison to centralized payroll in Georgia on California wage and hour requirements, including meal and rest period premiums, daily overtime and double-time, final pay, and wage statement requirements
* Review site timekeeping for accuracy prior to payroll submission; coordinate corrections with supervisors and payroll
* Process employee status changes in the HRIS

**HR Records & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and confidential personnel, medical, and I-9 files
* Prepare routine HR reports, including headcount, turnover, open requisitions, and leave status
* Process employment verifications and coordinate site HR communications and engagement activities
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* At least 5 years of human resources experience with Califor

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.desc:
**About the Role**
------------------

The Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist is responsible for supporting the company’s accounts payable function by ensuring vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, purchase-related documentation, and payments are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies and internal controls.

This position works closely with Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Operations, and other departments to resolve invoice discrepancies, maintain accurate vendor records, support purchase order and receiving reconciliation, and ensure proper documentation and approval of company expenditures.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced and growing environment, and able to effectively manage a high volume of transactions while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Accounts Payable Processing**

* Receive, review, code, and process vendor invoices accurately and timely.
* Verify invoices for appropriate documentation, authorization, account coding, and approval prior to payment.
* Enter invoices and other accounts payable transactions into the company's ERP/accounting system.
* Review invoices for mathematical accuracy, duplicate billing, appropriate sales/use tax treatment, and compliance with established purchasing and payment procedures.
* Process both purchase order (PO) and non-PO invoices.
* Perform three-way matching of purchase orders, receiving documentation, and vendor invoices when applicable.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies involving pricing, quantities, purchase orders, receipts, approvals, or other supporting documentation.
* Ensure invoices are recorded within the appropriate accounting period.
* Maintain accurate and complete electronic accounts payable records.

**Vendor Management**

* Establish and maintain vendor records in accordance with company procedures and internal controls.
* Obtain required vendor documentation, including Form W-9 and payment information.
* Review requests for new vendors and changes to existing vendor information.
* Follow established verification procedures for vendor banking or payment-information changes.
* Respond professionally and timely to vendor inquiries regarding invoice and payment status.
* Research and reconcile vendor statements.
* Investigate outstanding invoices, credits, duplicate payments, and other discrepancies.
* Maintain positive working relationships with vendors while protecting the company's financial interests.

**Payment Processing**

* Prepare invoices for scheduled payment runs.
* Assist with ACH, wire, check, and other approved payment methods.
* Verify appropriate authorization prior to releasing payments.
* Ensure payment documentation is complete and properly retained.
* Monitor payment due dates to help avoid late fees, duplicate payments, and service interruptions.
* Assist with researching returned, rejected, or outstanding payments.
* Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and follow established payment-control procedures.

**Purchase Order & Receiving Reconciliation**

* Work closely with Procurement, Warehouse, PMC/Materials, and other departments to resolve invoice-to-PO discrepancies.
* Research situations involving missing purchase orders, missing receipts, quantity differences, pricing discrepancies, or incomplete approvals.
* Monitor invoices that cannot be processed due to missing or incorrect supporting documentation.
* Follow up with responsible departments to ensure outstanding issues are resolved timely.
* Assist with monitoring open purchase orders and aged unmatched invoices.

**Employee Expenses & Reimbursements**

* Review employee expense reports and reimbursement requests for completeness, proper documentation, approval, and compliance with company policies.
* Verify receipts and business purposes are properly documented.

Streamside Parks is a premier property management company specializing in the operation and enhancement of RV Park Resorts & Campgrounds across the Southeast. Streamside oversees a growing portfolio of 40+ parks, delivering consistent, high-quality experiences for residents and campers alike. With a focus on operational excellence, streamlined processes, and guest satisfaction, Streamside Parks ensures each property thrives under the unified Streamside brand while maintaining a strong financial performance and a commitment to continuous improvement.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The Project Coordinator supports ownership across every active Streamside Parks project by keeping budgets, vendor commitments, permits, and project documentation organized, current, and easy to act on. This is a coordination and tracking role, not a design or engineering role: the Project Coordinator keeps information flowing and deadlines visible so ownership and outside professionals (engineers, surveyors, electricians, architects) can make timely decisions, rather than making design, engineering, or regulatory determinations independently.  
  
**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Budget and Cost Tracking**

* Maintain detailed project budget workbooks across multiple properties (division level tabs plus a master summary), keeping line items current as quotes, change orders, and actual costs come in.

  

* Compare vendor and contractor quotes against budgeted line items and flag variances to ownership.

  

* Track payment schedules and deposit or draw requirements against contracts and vendor terms.

  

* Coordinate with the accounting team on capital projects, making sure invoices, draws, and capital expenditures are coded, recorded, and reconciled against each project's budget.

  
**Vendor and Contractor Coordination**  

* Solicit, log, and compare quotes from vendors and contractors (signage, site work, utilities, construction trades, and similar scopes).

  

* Track vendor deliverables and installation schedules, and coordinate scheduling between vendors, on site staff, and ownership.

  

* Support decisions about which scopes of work are handled by outside contractors versus in house or property staff, by organizing the cost and scheduling information ownership needs to decide.

  

* Prepare contractor pay applications for ownership's approval, checking billed amounts against contract terms and percentage of work complete.

  

* Collect lien waivers from contractors and subcontractors with each payment cycle and keep them on file.

  

* Track construction schedules for contractors on specific jobs, monitoring progress against milestones and flagging delays to ownership.

  
**Acquisition Due Diligence Support**  

* Assemble and organize due diligence materials for prospective acquisitions: title work, surveys (ALTA and boundary), flood zone and FEMA determinations, utility and electrical system condition, and environmental reports.

  

* Track open due diligence items and deadlines through closing, and flag gaps that need a licensed surveyor, engineer, or attorney.

  
**Permitting and Regulatory Tracking**  

* Track permit applications and approval status across jurisdictions and property types (site development, electrical, water and wastewater, building).

  

* Maintain a working awareness of the codes and regulations that commonly apply to RV resort development, and route code specific questions to the appropriate licensed professional rather than answering them directly.

  
**Site Plans and Project Documentation**  

* Maintain current versions of civil site plans, sign packages, and other project drawings, and track what changed between revisions.

  

* Reconcile changes in project scope (for example, a shift in unit count or unit type) against the current site plan and flag discrepancies to ownership and the design consultant.

HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
  
HealthRIGHT 360 offers residential treatment services designed to serve individuals and families with substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health disorders. Our program helps clients address addiction and related issues, increase skills, manage stressors, connect to supportive service, and build a foundation for lasting recovery. Residential programs run 24/7 and Individual and group therapy, family therapy, individualized case management, treatment planning, drug and alcohol counseling, Medication support services, and crisis intervention.

* Training and professional development opportunities

**The required work schedule for this position is:** Sunday through Thursday 8am-4:30pm
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
North County Serenity House (NCSH), a residential program of HealthRIGHT 360, was founded in 1966 to provide substance use disorder services in the community. NCSH provides a gender-responsive and trauma-informed environment, using evidence-based and best practices that recognize and account for the role that trauma frequently plays in substance use and criminal histories of women. For clients with co-occurring mental illness, we provide integrated substance use and mental health services which treat both conditions as primary. Our residential facility serves up to 120 women (with capacity for up to 20 children under 5 years of age) seeking recovery from substance use disorders.
  
  
The Administrative Assistant provides vital administrative support by managing phone lines, coordinating client appointments, and assisting with data entry and report generation. They ensure the accuracy of client records, oversee office supplies, and maintain the cleanliness of shared spaces. The role also involves handling mail, managing client privacy rights, and supporting billing and reconciliation processes. The Administrative Assistant works closely with staff and external agencies to maintain operational efficiency, while ensuring compliance with all relevant policies and procedures.

**STRONG HISTORY. EXCITING FUTURE**

Bolthouse Fresh Foods is a leader in carrot production, serving as a grower, packer, processor, and shipper. Headquartered in Bakersfield, California, we are a proud employer to 1,600 dedicated individuals. Since 1915, we have been committed to growing and producing high-quality carrots, and today, we are one of North America’s largest growers and distributors of fresh carrots for cooking and snacking. Additionally, we supply premium natural ingredients for the food and beverage industry. With over a century of excellence, Bolthouse Fresh™ products are available at major retailers across North America.

Bolthouse Fresh Foods has approximately 1,600 employees.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR IN THIS ROLE**

The Payroll Specialist will support team with processing all payroll duties. This position reports to the Payroll Assistant Manager and interacts with all levels of the Corporation and outside agencies.

* Process weekly payroll for approximately 1,500 employees timely
* Utilize the Payroll Task Checklist to manage and complete all required payroll tasks, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and adherence to weekly payroll deadlines
* Process manual checks as necessary for terminations, adjustments, etc.
* Review documentation of departmental policies and procedures and ensure compliance. Update as necessary
* Ensure data in spreadsheets for taxes, weekly payroll processing and evaluate for accuracy and completeness
* Analyze information submitted for correctness and follow-up if appropriate personnel to validate
* Make recommendations to Payroll Assistant Manager to strengthen departmental controls
* Follow all procedures and controls set up by department to ensure Sarbanes-Oxley compliance
* Provide a high level of service for internal customers and outside agencies when required
* Analyze and correct vacation and sick accruals when necessary
* Process garnishments, tax levies, wage orders, child/spousal support are responded to and processed timely. Ensure all documentation is on file of case disputes
* Work with HR on all pay-related issues, including LOA’s, terminations, new hires, transfers, etc.
* Work with ADP to set up new earnings and/or deduction codes ensuring that the setup includes the proper taxation and W-2 reporting
* Respond to all payroll inquiries via email, phone call, etc. timely and accordingly
* Backup to the front desk when receptionist is absent
* Provide cross-functional support for Human Resources including benefit & HRIS related tasks
* Performs other duties as assigned

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent; three years of progressively responsible payroll experience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience processing payroll for a high-volume, multi-location workforce, including hourly and salaried employees
* Basic knowledge of Payroll and Federal State Tax regulations
* Candidates must have a verifiable history of safe vehicle operation and meet company standards for driving eligibility. This includes maintaining a clean driving record, which will be verified through a background check.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast paced, high-pressure environment
* Excellent communication/interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* Ability to interact with a diverse employee population and with internal/external customers in an effective, professional manner
* Proficient with Microsoft office suite and Excel
* Knowledge of office administration and procedures
* Organization and attention to detail attributes
* Maintain Confidentiality
