jobs.desc:
Project Coordinator / Project Engineer – Heavy Civil Construction / Water & Wastewater Construction

Pacific Hydrotech Corporation | Southern California

Salary Range: $60,000–$110,000 annually

Pacific Hydrotech Corporation (PHC) is seeking a Project Coordinator / Project Engineer to join our water and wastewater construction team.

This is an opportunity to build a career in construction Project Management while working directly with Project Managers, field leadership, subcontractors, engineers, and equipment manufacturers on challenging public infrastructure projects.

This is not a purely administrative position. We are looking for someone who wants to understand how projects are built, take ownership of increasing responsibilities, and develop toward Project Management.

What You'll Do

* Manage and track RFIs, submittals, project documentation, and procurement
* Review drawings and specifications and help identify coordination and constructability issues
* Coordinate with subcontractors, vendors, equipment manufacturers, and field personnel
* Assist with change orders, cost tracking, schedules, and project controls
* Support projects through construction, startup, commissioning, and closeout
* Progressively take ownership of larger project scopes and responsibilities

What We're Looking For

* 0–5 years of construction, engineering, or project management experience
* Organized, proactive, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills
* Interested in understanding both the field and management sides of construction
* Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related degree preferred
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, drawings/specifications, RFIs, and submittals is a plus

Previous water and wastewater experience is not required. We value initiative, organization, construction aptitude, and a strong desire to learn.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $60,000–$110,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

PHC offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

* 100% employee health insurance coverage
* Generous performance-based bonus potential
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
* Retirement benefits
* Company-provided tools and technology necessary for the position
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Clear opportunities for career growth and advancement

Career Development

PHC views this position as part of our Project Management development pipeline. Strong performers will progressively take responsibility for procurement, subcontractors, cost, schedule, change management, and individual project scopes with the opportunity to advance toward a Project Manager role.

About PHC

Pacific Hydrotech Corporation is a California general engineering contractor specializing in water and wastewater treatment facilities, wells, pump stations, pipelines, reservoirs, and complex mechanical process systems.

Based in Los Angeles and reporting to the Head of Réserve, the coordinator will work closely with teams across the company to support member relations, product launches, inventory coordination, communications, and events. * Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets. Familiarity with Shopify,

Klaviyo, or NetSuite is a plus.  

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively with creative teams, and follow

through on tasks.

jobs.desc:
**SUMMARY**

The Payroll Administrator is responsible for the accurate and timely administration, compilation, and maintenance of payroll data and records for Trinidad Rancheria Tribal Operations and Seascape Restaurant and Pier. This position monitors current payroll requirements and practices and prepares payroll-related reports, statements, summaries, and fringe benefit information for submission to the appropriate departments.

Primary responsibilities include processing payroll, payroll taxes, deductions, and related quarterly and year-end reporting. The Payroll Administrator ensures payroll transactions are accurate, completed within established deadlines, and properly reconciled and balanced with the general ledger, with appropriate review and approval by the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The position also maintains accurate payroll records and supports compliance with applicable payroll requirements, policies, and procedures.

The Payroll Administrator reports to the Chief Financial Officer or Deputy Chief Financial Officer.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

· Coordinates payroll with Human Resources and Fiscal departments. Ensures that forms and records are received and processed in a timely and efficient manner, in accordance with applicable Federal and State regulations.

· Verifies accuracy of forms, time sheets, time keeping data base, tips, and benefit data for input into in-house payroll system. Ensures documents include necessary approval signatures.

· Maintains records of payroll, including leave accruals of paid time off, holiday time, and compensatory time, and compares and reconciles to payroll files for accuracy. This includes monitoring new Federal and applicable State regulations for all employees which includes full time, exempt, part time, and temporary positions.

· Processes bi-weekly tax payments to federal and state agencies within required time frames.

· Reviews control documentation submitted with each payroll processed. Acts as primary liaison for resolving payroll-related accounting issues, ensuring accurate recording of required financial statement balances.

· Ensures MOM’s payroll system has the correct current tax rates for each year and reviews federal and state published tax rates to confirm and verify accuracy.

· Reviews and compares computed wages to manually prepared spreadsheets and corrects any errors to ensure accuracy of payroll input.

· Records changes affecting net wages such as exemptions, insurance coverage, and deduction payments for each employee to update master payroll records.

· Prepares periodic reports of earnings, taxes, and deductions. Verifies totals by manually calculating percentages. Prepares semi-annual reports for 401K retirement plan and worker’s compensation.

· Assists employees with payroll questions concerning pay checks and accrued leave. Provides reports for employees as needed. Researches and resolves any issues or concerns regarding payroll.

· Reconciles employee insurance, fuel account, and other vendor invoices to payroll general ledger accounts.

· Prepares and distributes payroll checks and sign out sheets.

· Prepares quarterly and annual payroll tax reports. Maintains files in a secure location.

· Researches changes in the payroll profession and develops/refines procedures that will continually improve the operational efficiency and meet service levels of the Fiscal department.

· Communicates changes in payroll standards, laws and guidelines to Fiscal department, including assisting in the development of manuals and other training materials.

jobs.desc:
Basic Job Description:
  
The Dispatcher is the first point of contact for facilities, coordinating pick-up and delivery times for clients and providing precise logistics for transport drivers. Dispatchers stay in direct contact with transport drivers and provide information and support needed for successful client transports.

This full-time position is located in the Norman office and works a fluid block schedule. Computer and software are provided; PTO, healthcare benefits and 401K are available.

\*\*\*MUST BE ABLE TO WORK 4a-2p, 4days on, 4 days off\*\*\*

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Receive electronic requests for transports, recording significant information and prioritizing submissions according to urgency and proximity to transport drivers.
* Address problems and requests by transmitting information or providing solutions, elevating problems to Dispatch Leads when necessary.
* Confirm transport with referring and destination facilities, offering information on ETAs, riders and drivers.
* Monitor the route and status of current transports to coordinate the schedule, providing transport drivers with information on the client, staff, weather, and other pertinent information.
* Enter data in computer system, maintain logs of calls, incidents, cancellations, driver availability and more, submitting issues in the Issue Log.
* Work collaboratively with Dispatch Leads and Drivers to update and maintain a list of facility contacts and current drivers.
* Drive excellence by creating efficiencies that will reduce the arrival time for drivers (under the 2-hour maximum). Report all overages to Dispatch Lead (DL) or Ops Manager (OM)immediately.
* Track Driver hours to ensure that they stay under drive time protocols, communicating with DL or OM throughout shift.
* Other duties as assigned by leadership.

* Requirements
* Minimum of a high school degree
* Experience as a dispatcher or other relevant position
* Proficient in English (oral and written); active listener with excellent communication skills
* Tech-savvy, good typing skills, and experience with data entry
* Operate in highly stressful situations from both internal and external sources, adapting and making decisions as needed.
* Ability to multi-task, interpreting on-going problems and suggesting possible solutions.

At Brooks & Freund, Project Administrators are the glue that holds every project together. Field Setup

The Office Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the office environment. This position is responsible for overseeing daily administrative functions, managing office resources, and supporting staff to maintain productivity and organization. The Office Manager will coordinate accounts payable and bookkeeping activities, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date. Additionally, this role involves managing appointment schedules and maintaining comprehensive records to support operational needs. Ultimately, the Office Manager contributes to creating a professional and well-organized workplace that supports the overall success of the organization.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in office management or a related administrative role.

* Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Oversee and manage daily office operations to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.

* Organize and maintain records management systems to ensure easy retrieval and compliance.
* Perform general office duties such as ordering supplies, managing correspondence, and supporting staff needs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for office-related inquiries and issues.
* Implement and maintain office policies and procedures to improve workflow.

**Skills:**

The required skills such as office management and general office duties are essential for maintaining a well-organized and efficient workplace, allowing the Office Manager to coordinate daily activities seamlessly. Accounts payable and bookkeeping skills, particularly proficiency with QuickBooks, enable accurate financial tracking and timely vendor payments, which are critical for the organization's fiscal health. Appointment scheduling skills ensure that meetings and deadlines are managed effectively, supporting smooth communication and workflow. Records management expertise helps maintain compliance and easy access to important documents, which supports operational integrity. Preferred skills like advanced Microsoft Office proficiency and experience in related industries enhance the Office Manager’s ability to leverage technology and industry knowledge to optimize office functions.

jobs.desc:
The Role

The Operations Manager oversees daily operations at all of our facilities. You'll keep every home in compliance, fully staffed, and running smoothly, and make sure every resident gets quality care. You'll report directly to ownership and work closely with Administrators, House Managers, Regional Centers, and Community Care Licensing.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee day-to-day operations at all facilities through regular on-site visits and inspections
* Keep every home in full compliance with Title 22, Community Care Licensing (CCL), and Regional Center/vendor requirements
* Get facilities ready for licensing visits, audits, and annual reviews, and close out corrective action plans fast
* Supervise, coach, and evaluate Administrators, House Managers, and Direct Support Professionals (DSPs)
* Manage staffing levels, schedules, overtime, and hiring so every shift is covered
* Track and train staff on required certifications (DSP training, CPR/First Aid, medication handling, background clearances)
* Review resident files, Individual Program Plans (IPPs), Needs & Services Plans, and behavior support plans
* Make sure Special Incident Reports (SIRs) are reported correctly and on time, and follow up on them
* Audit medication administration records (MARs) and resident trust/funds documentation
* Manage facility budgets, supply ordering, and vendor relationships
* Keep facilities safe and maintained: fire drills, emergency plans, repairs, and vehicle safety
* Act as the main contact for Regional Center service coordinators, families, and conservators
* Be on call for emergencies and serious incidents

Requirements

* **3+ years of management experience in an ARF, group home, ICF, or similar licensed residential care setting** (required)
* Experience overseeing **multiple facilities** (strongly preferred)
* Current **ARF Administrator Certificate** (or able to get one within [X] days)
* Strong working knowledge of Title 22 regulations and CCL processes
* Experience working with Regional Centers and serving residents with high behavioral or medical support needs
* Valid driver's license, reliable vehicle, and clean driving record
* Able to pass Live Scan / DOJ / FBI background clearance
* Current CPR and First Aid certification
* Strong skills with Excel/Google Sheets, scheduling software, and written reports

Strong Points (What Makes You Stand Out)

* A track record of **zero or minimal citations** during licensing visits
* Experience **turning around struggling facilities**, such as fixing compliance gaps or reducing staff turnover
* Experience with **Level 6 or higher-acuity residents**: behavior management, crisis intervention (e.g., Pro-ACT, CPI)
* You've **built systems**: audit checklists, training programs, staffing models
* Bilingual (English/Spanish or other languages) is a plus
* Calm, firm, and fair leadership: you hold staff accountable while keeping morale high

jobs.title: Solid Waste Customer Service Coordinator
jobs.desc:
SpecPro Professional Services is recruiting Solid Waste Customer Service Coordinators to support the Fort Irwin Recycling Center and landfill scale house. This position provides customer service and administrative support at both locations, processes recycling center records and landfill scale transactions, and helps keep documentation accurate and operations organized.
  
Coordinators may be assigned to either location based on operational needs and will rotate weekend coverage when the facilities are open. This position reports directly to the Operations Manager.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, commercial drivers, contractors, employees, and supervisors; answer questions, explain site procedures, and direct issues to management.
* Manage landfill scale systems; record inbound and outbound vehicle weights, material types, customer and vehicle information, and other details needed to process transactions and issue accurate tickets.
* Verify customer accounts, load information, required paperwork, and applicable disposal requirements; identify discrepancies and resolve routine errors or escalate them.
* Collect, review, and process recycling center customer documentation, forms, and transaction records for accuracy and completeness.
* Enter and maintain customer and operational information in electronic systems and Excel spreadsheets; organize, scan, file, retrieve, and reconcile physical and electronic records.
* Prepare routine reports and support supervisors and operational staff with documentation, research, and other administrative tasks.
* Coordinate with landfill and recycling center personnel to support customer traffic flow, timely processing, and clear communication between locations.
* Verify scale weights and transaction details before issuing tickets and promptly investigate or escalate discrepancies that could affect customer charges or financial records.
* Reconcile scale tickets and transaction records with financial reports as needed, documenting discrepancies and coordinating corrections with management.
* Identify and report unusual or potentially unacceptable documentation, loads, customer disputes, system problems, safety concerns, or other issues requiring supervisor direction.
* Maintain confidentiality and use sound judgment when handling customer and company information.
* Follow company policies and applicable safety, environmental, and site procedures; maintain an organized work area.
* Work independently, prioritize competing requests, and maintain accurate records during busy periods.
* Perform related customer service and administrative duties as assigned at either location.
* Perform all other duties assigned by the supervisor.

**What You Bring:****Required:**  

* High school diploma or GED.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel spreadsheets, including accurate data entry and routine record maintenance.
* Ability to speak English fluently and communicate clearly with customers and coworkers in person and by phone; ability to read and write routine work documents in English.
* Ability to work at both the Recycling Center and landfill scale house and participate in a rotating weekend schedule.
* Reliable transportation to get to work.
* Valid Class C (minimum) driver’s license.
* Strong customer service, communication, organization, and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn scale software, customer account procedures, and site-specific documentation requirements.
* Sound judgment in handling discrepancies and escalating operational or safety concerns.
* Ability to follow directions, work with a team, and handle multiple priorities with accuracy.

**What We Offer:**  
SpecPro Professional Services, LLC offers a competitive benefits package to include: paid holidays, paid time off including sick and vacation leave, medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, short and long term disability, company paid life insurance, 401(k)

jobs.desc:
**Cobalt Service Partners** (CSP) is building the nation's leading commercial access and security integration platform. Backed by Alpine Investors, we partner with founder-led businesses that install, maintain, and repair commercial gates, doors, loading docks, and integrated security systems.

Since launching in late 2023, we've welcomed 22 partner companies into Cobalt. Each one has its own team, practices, and local history. Bringing them onto shared processes and systems without disrupting the people who built them is central to how we grow. Payroll sits right at the heart of that work.

**About the role**

Cobalt Service Partners is hiring a Payroll Specialist to own accurate, on-time payroll for a group of operating businesses. Each business has its own employees, pay schedules and quirks, and you'll be the person they count on to get it right every cycle.

We're a startup, so our payroll processes, procedures, and systems are still taking shape. Processing payroll is the core of this job. Helping us build the way we do it — documenting steps, tightening controls, and shaping our systems as we grow — is the other part.

**What you'll do**

**Payroll processing (most of your time)**

* Run end-to-end payroll for multiple businesses on weekly, biweekly and semimonthly schedules
* Collect and verify hours, new hires, terminations, pay changes, bonuses and commissions before each run
* Calculate and process deductions, garnishments, PTO accruals and benefit withholdings
* Review payroll registers for accuracy and resolve discrepancies before funds are released
* Make sure federal, state and local payroll taxes are withheld, filed and paid on time, including quarterly and year-end filings (941, W-2, W-3)
* Answer employee and manager questions about pay, deductions and tax forms
* Reconcile payroll to the general ledger and prepare journal entries or reports for accounting
* Support audits, workers' comp reviews and year-end close

**Building how we work**

* Write and maintain step-by-step procedures and checklists for each business you support
* Spot errors, manual workarounds and risks, and propose fixes
* Help evaluate, set up, or migrate payroll and HR systems as we standardize
* Bring newly added businesses onto our payroll process smoothly
* Partner with HR, accounting, and local business managers to keep data flowing cleanly

**What you bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on payroll processing, ideally across more than one company or EIN
* Working knowledge of federal and multi-state payroll tax rules, wage and hour law, and garnishments
* Experience with at least one major payroll platform (for example ADP, Paychex, Paylocity, Gusto or UKG)
* Strong Excel skills: lookups, pivot tables and reconciliations
* A high bar for accuracy and confidentiality
* Clear, friendly communication with employees and managers who aren't payroll experts

**Nice to have**

* Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP)
* Experience with field-service or hourly workforces (overtime, shift differentials, job costing)
* Experience helping implement or migrate a payroll system
* Exposure to acquisitions or onboarding new entities

**Who thrives here**

* You're comfortable when the answer is "we haven't decided that yet" and you'll help decide it
* You fix the root cause, not just this cycle's error
* You write things down so the next person doesn't have to guess
* You can juggle several pay calendars without missing a deadline
* You ask questions early and flag problems before payday, not after

**Why Cobalt**

* **Real variety.** You'll support multiple partner companies, each with its own team, pay practices and history. It's not the same payroll every week.
* **A hand in building it.** Our payroll processes and systems are still taking shape, and you'll help design them instead of inheriting someone else's.
* **Work that matters to people.** The technicians and installers keeping our customers' buildings secu

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.desc:
Description:

The Office Manager is a high-trust administrative and operational partner that balances supporting the entire organization and the administrative needs of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT). This role is responsible for enabling executive effectiveness while overseeing the professional operation of the office. This role applies sound judgment, discretion, and proactive planning to manage priorities, coordinate complex meetings and initiatives, anticipate needs, and protect confidential company, employee, client, financial, legal, and executive information.

Working with a high degree of independence, the Office Manager serves as a central point of proactive coordination across executives, employees, and external vendors and partners to ensure executive support and office operations are organized, responsive, and aligned with company priorities.

The successful Office Manager is highly collaborative, team-oriented, flexible, and servant-oriented, with a willingness to step in wherever needed to help the ELT and broader organization accomplish important projects, tasks, and business objectives. This individual consistently puts the interests of Gregory & Appel ahead of individual or departmental preferences and models The G&A Way and the company’s Core Values in daily decisions, interactions, and follow-through.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

Success in this role means the ELT and broader organization can rely on the Office Manager to anticipate needs, protect executive time, maintain a professional and efficient workplace, and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.

The Office Manager:

* Anticipates what executives, employees, and the organization will need before being asked.
* Creates order, consistency, and efficiency across executive support and office operations.
* Handles confidential and sensitive information with sound judgment and discretion.
* Keeps meetings, projects, vendors, facilities, and administrative responsibilities moving forward with strong follow-through.
* Serves as a trusted resource and problem-solver who brings solutions, not just problems.
* Steps in wherever needed to support the success of the organization and create a consistent One G&A experience.
* Communicates clearly, raises concerns early, and takes ownership from beginning to end.
* Maintains a calm, professional, and service-oriented presence while managing competing priorities and unexpected needs.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Executive Leadership & Administrative Support**

* Serve as a trusted administrative and operational partner to the Executive Leadership Team, exercising independent judgment and discretion in managing priorities, requests, and sensitive matters.
* Plan, organize, and coordinate executive calendars, meetings, commitments, and key deadlines; assess competing priorities and recommend adjustments to protect executive time and business continuity.
* Anticipate executive needs, identify potential conflicts or gaps, and proactively prepare information, materials, logistics, and follow-up actions.
* Receive and appropriately triage sensitive inquiries and requests on behalf of executives, determining what requires immediate attention, delegation, escalation, or confidential handling.
* Draft, format, proofread, and coordinate executive correspondence, presentations, reports, and company-wide communications with accuracy and appropriate tone.
* Represent the ELT professionally in interactions with employees, clients, carriers, vendors, legal counsel, building management, and other external partners.
* Maintain strict confidentiality for executive, employee, client, financial, legal, strategic, and organizational information.

**Meetings, Events & Special Projects**

* Coordinate ELT and company-wide meetings, including agenda development, pre-read materials, presentations, room and technology readiness, catering, minutes or action-item tracking, and timely follow-through.

**Data & Office Operations Coordinator**  
$15/hour ($31,200/year) · Full-time · On-site · Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–6:00 p.m., 1.5-hour lunch

**About us.** We're a family of South Texas Mexican candy businesses: retail stores, a distribution center, a wholesale distributor, and a heritage candy maker.

**The role.** You'll be the go-to person for our data across all four of our companies. Working with every department, you'll make sure the information in QuickBooks and Toast is accurate and complete and fill in what's missing. You'll turn that data into the reports our teams use to make decisions, from regular sales reports to one-off requests. You'll also keep daily operations moving by processing orders between our companies, answering phones, and helping onboard new employees. We'll train you on our systems.

**What you'll do**

*Data*

* Fix and clean up existing data in QuickBooks and Toast: errors, duplicates, gaps, and mismatches between systems
* Keep product, price, customer, and vendor records accurate across all our companies, including setting up new items (UPCs, units, costs, and prices)
* Help the stores resolve price and item issues
* Help maintain the data tools we're building, and keep our procedures up to date

*Reports*

* Build reports from our systems and data for any department
* Run a standard set of recurring reports on a set schedule
* Create one-off reports when someone needs something specific
* Build new data sets when a report needs data we don't track yet, or a gap needs filling
* Find information quickly when a salesperson needs it urgently
* Use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to clean up data, build reports, and speed up routine work

*Daily operations*

* Turn purchase orders into sales orders between our companies, accurately and the same day
* Answer and route phone calls
* Help onboard and offboard employees

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Bilingual in English and Spanish
* Basic Excel experience: entering data, sorting, filtering, and simple formulas
* Experience using AI tools, and the ability to write clear prompts that get accurate, useful results

**Qualities we're looking for**

* A good attitude
* Coachable: you take feedback well and put it to use
* Takes initiative: you spot what needs doing and handle it without being asked
* Detail-oriented: you double-check your work before calling it done
* Curious: when something doesn't add up, you ask why
* Dependable and on time
* Organized enough to juggle many small tasks without dropping any
* Calm and focused while switching between phones and data work
* Trustworthy and discreet with pricing and employee information
* Quick to learn new software

**Bonus points if you have**

* An associate's or bachelor's degree
* QuickBooks, Toast, or other point-of-sale experience
* Office, retail, or distribution experience

We are an equal opportunity employer.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**JOB TITLE:** Parts & Administrative Coordinator

**EMPLOYER:** Coast

**DEPARTMENT:** Maintenance

**REPORTS TO:** Director of Client Relations / Maintenance Management

**JOB TYPE:** **Full-Time**

**SCHEDULE:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–4:00 PM

**SUMMARY:**
============

Coast is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Parts & Administrative Coordinator to support the Maintenance Department with customer communication, administrative coordination, parts support, and day-to-day shop operations.

This position works closely with the Director of Client Relations, Director of Administration, technicians, vendors, and customers to keep maintenance projects organized, communication timely, and parts moving efficiently.

The role offers hands-on learning across the administrative, customer-service, parts, and operational sides of an aircraft maintenance business. Candidates should be receptive to training and feedback, with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and grow with the company over time.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
================================

**Customer and Administrative Support**
---------------------------------------

* Assist with responding to customer phone calls and email inquiries in a professional, timely, and courteous manner.
* Assist with customer updates regarding aircraft status, maintenance progress, parts, scheduling, and other service-related questions.
* Monitor and organize incoming emails, ensuring customer requests are acknowledged and followed up on appropriately.
* Assist with preparing and sending work orders, estimates, invoices, receipts, and other customer documentation.
* Maintain accurate customer and aircraft information within company systems.
* Track customer requests and outstanding items to support timely follow-up.
* Coordinate with internal departments to gather information needed to respond to customer inquiries.
* Assist with scheduling, aircraft drop-offs and pick-ups, test flights, and other maintenance-related coordination as needed.
* Maintain organized digital and physical records, including work orders, purchase orders, invoices, and aircraft documentation.

**Parts Coordination**
----------------------

* Assist with researching, sourcing, ordering, receiving, and tracking aircraft parts and supplies.
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, lead times, shipping, returns, and core exchanges.
* Assist technicians and management with identifying and locating parts needed for maintenance work.
* Track outstanding and backordered parts and provide updates to the appropriate team members.
* Receive and inspect incoming parts and supplies for accuracy and visible damage.
* Maintain organized parts records and ensure received parts are properly documented and routed to the appropriate work order or aircraft.
* Assist with shipping parts, cores, warranty items, and other materials as needed.
* Help maintain an organized parts area and assist with inventory-related tasks.

**Maintenance Department Support**
----------------------------------

* Assist the maintenance team with administrative tasks related to active work orders.
* Review work orders, purchase orders, invoices, and other documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Help identify outstanding items that may affect aircraft completion or customer communication.
* Communicate relevant updates between customers, technicians, management, vendors, and other departments.
* Assist with warranty documentation, returns, and related follow-up as assigned.
* Support general office, shop, and airport operations as needed.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
=================================

* This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
===================

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED), or one to three years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education

We are looking for a friendly, organized, and dependable **Assistant Office Coordinator** to join our team. This position plays an important role in supporting the day-to-day operations of our office, assisting customers, and working closely with our sales and production teams to keep projects and daily activities organized and moving forward.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is comfortable managing a variety of responsibilities throughout the day. This hands-on position combines administrative support, customer service, sales assistance, order coordination, and basic accounting. The Assistant Office Coordinator will also report directly to the Owner and provide administrative and operational support as needed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Answer incoming phone calls, greet customers, and provide friendly, professional customer service
* Manage the general office email inbox, respond to inquiries, and direct customers and requests to the appropriate team member
* Perform general administrative duties and maintain accurate customer, order, and project records
* Support the outside sales team with estimates, customer communication, project information, and follow-ups

* Provide additional administrative and operational support to the Owner and team as requested

  

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A friendly and professional approach to customer service
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn new software and processes
* Initiative, dependability, and a willingness to jump in and help where needed
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team

  

Previous experience in customer service, office administration, sales support, bookkeeping, printing, signage, or a related field is helpful but **not required**. We are willing to train the right person on our industry, products, software, and internal processes.

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.desc:
### **Job Summary:**

The **Office Assistant** is a key member of our front office team, helping create a welcoming, organized, and supportive environment for clients, staff, and visitors. This role handles a variety of general office tasks, such as answering phones, scheduling appointments, assisting with billing, and maintaining day-to-day office operations. Due to client needs, we require someone bilingual in Spanish.

### **Essential Job Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the first point of contact by answering phones and welcoming clients and visitors.
* Perform general clerical and office support tasks such as filing, scanning, copying, and preparing letters or forms.
* Assist with purchasing and managing office supplies to ensure the team has what they need.
* Support the scheduling of appointments for therapists and psychiatrists.
* Take basic vitals from clients as needed (training provided).
* Maintain accurate and confidential records, files, and case entries.
* Help with printing, scanning, and preparing documents for staff and clients.
* Support billing and fee collections as needed, including reconciling payments.
* Provide coverage for other Office Assistants during absences.
* Keep the front office and shared spaces clean and orderly.
* Maintain professional and respectful communication with clients, coworkers, and supervisors at all times.
* Handle emergencies calmly and efficiently, following agency protocols.
* Take notes and assist in report preparation when requested.
* Complete other tasks and projects as assigned by supervisors.

### **Qualifications & Requirements:**

* At least 1 year of previous experience in secretarial, receptionist, or office support work is **required**
* Spanish language fluency is **required.**
* High school diploma or equivalent **required.**
* Completion of secretarial coursework or 2 years of college coursework in Business Administration (preferred but not required).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
* Basic math skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn and use Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Intermediate computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Office 365, Teams, and Zoom.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable, insured transportation (as needed for travel between clinics).
* Ability to maintain positive working relationships with staff, clients, vendors, and community partners.

jobs.desc:

The Billing Specialist & Warranty Administrator books and submits accurate warranty claims and bills and codes repair orders. You'll work closely with advisors, technicians, parts, and management to keep claims accepted and paid.

**Starting pay is $25-$30/hr based on experience. As you grow with us, so does your earning potential.**

* Family-owned and operated
* Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
* On-the-job paid training

* Report suspected improper claim activity to management
* Submitt all warranty claims to manufacturer, verify full payment

This position is under the supervision of the Billing Manager, with responsibility for conducting all patient reimbursement billing.

High school diploma or equivalent. Ability to type 50 words per minute. Knowledgeable in various medical software and billing programs.

Minimum of one year experience in medical billing. . Experience working for Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) is highly desired.

**Big Sur Land Trust | Monterey, CA**  
**Full-Time | Non-Exempt**  
**Pay Range: $34.50 - $39.50 per hour**

Join a Mission That Protects Land and Connects Communities

Big Sur Land Trust (BSLT) is seeking an exceptionally organized, collaborative, and resourceful **Resource Development Project Coordinator** to help turn ambitious ideas into coordinated action and measurable results.

As the operational hub of our Resource Development team, this role supports fundraising, marketing, communications, donor engagement, campaigns, and events. The ideal candidate thrives on building systems, keeping projects moving, coordinating across teams, and ensuring that important work is completed on time and with excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Big Sur Land Trust's mission of inspiring love of land across generations, conserving Monterey County's unique landscapes, and providing access to outdoor experiences for all.

**What You'll Do**

Project & Team Coordination

* Create and maintain project plans, workflows, calendars, dashboards, templates, and tracking systems.
* Coordinate multiple projects and campaigns simultaneously while managing priorities and deadlines.
* Facilitate meetings, track action items, and ensure follow-through on commitments.
* Keep teams aligned by communicating progress, deadlines, risks, and next steps.

Fundraising & Donor Support

* Support donor stewardship activities including acknowledgments, thank-you letters, mailings, and donor communications.
* Assist with donor and prospect research, reporting, meeting preparation, and record management.
* Help coordinate fundraising appeals and campaign activities.

Campaign & Communications Support

* Coordinate integrated fundraising and communications initiatives.
* Support BSLT's 50th Anniversary Campaign and long-term philanthropic goals.
* Help connect communications and donor engagement activities to organizational priorities and audience needs.

Events & Logistics

* Assist with planning and execution of fundraising and community events.
* Coordinate vendors, materials, schedules, and event follow-up activities.
* Support campaign and event logistics as needed.

**What We're Looking For**

Required Qualifications

* Experience managing multiple projects, initiatives, or workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to develop project plans, workflows, and tracking systems.
* Experience coordinating deadlines, deliverables, and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and sound judgment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management or collaboration tools.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on administrative support.
* Professionalism and discretion when handling donor and organizational information.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in nonprofit organizations, fundraising, philanthropy, marketing, communications, or event planning.
* Familiarity with conservation, environmental organizations, or land trusts.
* Passion for community engagement, conservation, and mission-driven work.

Why Join Big Sur Land Trust?

* Contribute to meaningful conservation and community impact work.
* Collaborate with a dedicated and mission-driven team.
* Support exciting campaigns and special initiatives, including our 50th Anniversary efforts.
* Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Help build lasting relationships that support conservation across Monterey County.

How to Apply

Submit:

* Resume
* Cover letter describing your relevant experience and availability to start

Email application materials to **employment@bigsurlandtrust.org**.

Candidates whose qualifications most closely align with the position will be contacted for interviews. Please do not call. Position open until filled.

We are a premier fencing company in Orlando specializing in high-quality, American-made products, including Homeland Vinyl and Antebellum Aluminum. We are seeking a high-energy, fully bilingual (English/Spanish) Inside Sales Representative to manage our front office and act as the first point of contact for our valued homeowners, contractors, and commercial clients.

--------------------

The Medical Billing Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely billing, claim submission, payment posting, and follow-up of medical claims for Health Care Partners of South Carolina. This position ensures claims are processed in accordance with payer guidelines while supporting the organization’s revenue cycle goals. The Medical Billing Specialist works collaboratively with providers, clinical staff, insurance carriers, and patients to resolve billing issues, maximize reimbursement, and maintain compliance with federal, state, HRSA, FQHC, and organizational requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Prepare, review, and submit accurate medical claims using appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding.

* Post insurance and patient payments, adjustments, and reconcile billing transactions.

* Respond to patient billing inquiries and assist with payment arrangements when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate billing records and patient account information within the Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management system.
* Assist with accounts receivable follow-up and support departmental revenue cycle goals.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, HRSA, FQHC requirements, payer guidelines, and organizational policies.
* Participate in staff meetings, required trainings, and quality improvement initiatives.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and payer reimbursement guidelines required.
* Experience using Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management systems preferred.
* Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or equivalent certification preferred.

------------------------------------

* Ability to maintain confidentiality and protect patient information in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

LSB is committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world. The LSB team is dedicated to building a culture of excellence in customer experiences as we deliver essential products across the agricultural and industrial end markets and, in the future, the energy markets. Immerse yourself in the scenic beauty of El Dorado, ideal for fishing, boating, and picnics, or wander through the historic downtown district. El Dorado has heaps of small-town charm and was even named Best Small-Town Cultural Scene in America 2021 by USA Today Reader's Choice. El Dorado is home to a unique school district, beautiful and friendly neighborhoods, one-of-a-kind restaurants, and top-notch libraries. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the easy access to a myriad of activities, from parks to hiking and biking the trails of South Arkansas Arboretum and even an award-winning golf course. El Dorado's festival season brings live music performances, and their arts district boasts museums, an arts center, and a busy performing arts calendar. This small town has a lot of spirit!

**Job Overview**  
We are seeking a dynamic and organized Office Assistant to join our team and help keep our daily operations running smoothly. This energetic role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys multitasking, and has a passion for providing excellent customer service. As an Office Assistant, you will be the first point of contact for visitors and callers, manage administrative tasks, and support office management functions to ensure an efficient workplace. Your positive attitude and proactive approach will contribute significantly to our team’s success and create a welcoming environment for clients and staff alike.

**Duties**

* Greet visitors and clients at the front desk with professionalism and warmth, ensuring a positive first impression
* Manage multi-line phone systems, screen calls, take messages, and direct inquiries appropriately
* Handle data entry, filing, and document proofreading to maintain accurate records and correspondence
* Assist with calendar management, scheduling appointments, meetings, and coordinating office events
* Support bookkeeping tasks using QuickBooks or similar accounting software for invoicing and expense tracking
* Maintain office supplies inventory, order necessary materials, and organize workspaces for efficiency
* Provide exceptional customer support by addressing inquiries promptly via phone or email while practicing proper phone etiquette
* Utilize Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace tools to prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence
* Support office management activities including organizing files, managing incoming mail, and ensuring compliance with company policies
* Assist with clerical duties such as photocopying, scanning documents, and proofreading materials to ensure accuracy

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in an office environment with strong clerical skills and organizational abilities
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace applications
* Familiarity with QuickBooks or other bookkeeping software is highly desirable
* Excellent communication skills to serve clients effectively
* Strong computer literacy with the ability to learn new software quickly
* Experience with professional phone etiquette
* Demonstrated ability to handle data entry accurately while maintaining attention to detail
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently and manage time effectively
* Personal assistant experience or background in office management is advantageous

Join us as an Office Assistant where your enthusiasm meets your expertise! Be part of a vibrant team dedicated to creating a seamless office environment that supports our mission of excellence. Your proactive approach will help foster a productive workspace where everyone feels valued.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.desc:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and organized AP/AR Specialist with at least 2 years of experience to join our growing finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of both Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable functions. You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, processing vendor payments, issuing client invoices, managing collections, and performing monthly reconciliations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

· Review, code, and process vendor invoices, expense reports, and check requests in a timely manner.

· Perform 3-way matching (purchase orders, receiving reports, and invoices) to ensure billing accuracy.

· Schedule and execute weekly/monthly payment runs via ACH, wire, or check.

· Communicate with vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies, missing receipts, or payment inquiries.

· Maintain organized electronic vendor files and w-9/1099 tax records.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

· Prepare and distribute accurate client invoices and billing statements according to contractual terms.

· Monitor outstanding balances and perform routine collections calls or email follow-ups on overdue accounts.

· Process incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, credit cards) and accurately post cash receipts to GL accounts.

· Perform credit checks on new customers and monitor credit limits.

· Assist in resolving billing disputes and discrepancies with clients.

**General Accounting & Reconciliation**

· Reconcile AP and AR sub-ledgers against the general ledger during month-end close.

jobs.title: Payroll Administrator
jobs.desc:
**Summary**

We are seeking an organized and reliable full-time **Payroll Administrator** to oversee in-house payroll operations at our headquarters in Gardena. The Payroll Administrator is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and compliant weekly payroll checks and reports while ensuring the integrity of timekeeping and pay data. The ideal candidate for the role will be reconciling paper and electronic time records, resolving discrepancies, and partnering with managers and Human Resources to maintain consistent payroll practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the accurate and timely processing of weekly payroll for all employees in accordance with established payroll schedules and internal controls.
* Review, validate, and enter paper timecards and electronic timekeeping records into Foundation software to ensure complete and accurate payroll input.
* Reconcile timekeeping data across manual and electronic systems, identify discrepancies, and resolve issues before payroll finalization.
* Analyze payroll exceptions, investigate pay-related variances, and coordinate timely corrections to minimize payroll errors and rework.
* Ensure payroll practices comply with applicable federal, state, and local wage and hour requirements as well as company policies and procedures.
* Maintain complete and accurate payroll records, supporting documentation, and audit trails in accordance with recordkeeping standards.
* Partner with managers, employees, and Human Resources to resolve timekeeping questions, pay issues, and payroll-related inquiries in a responsive and professional manner.
* Prepare payroll reports, support internal or external audits, and provide payroll data needed for compliance and operational review.

**Experience**

* At least 5 years of payroll processing experience required; 7 or more years preferred, ideally in a fast-paced or high-volume environment.
* Experience working with both paper-based and electronic timekeeping records.

**Skills**

* Ability to handle multi-location payroll processing on a weekly basis.
* Familiarity with HRIS and payroll systems, including Foundation or similar platforms.
* Capability to meet strict weekly payroll deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Knowledge of payroll regulations, wage and hour requirements, and standard payroll recordkeeping practices.
* Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and apply sound judgment in resolving payroll exceptions.
* Proficiency in payroll systems and Microsoft Excel for reviewing, managing, and reporting payroll-related data accurately.
* Effective organizational, communication, and time management skills, with a high level of accuracy, discretion, and attention to detail.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.

**Education**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.

Pay: $28.00 - $33.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

This role will focus on supporting the AR Manager with posting invoices, applying customer payments, and ensuring accurate and timely tracking of shipments to support revenue recognition. The AR Clerk will work closely with the Controller and Operations team to maintain clean, reliable financial records.

This position also offers meaningful growth opportunities. For the right candidate, there is potential to expand into broader accounting responsibilities, including bank reconciliations, month-end close procedures, participating in the annual financial audit, job costing, and expense analysis.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a foundation in accounting while gaining exposure to more advanced functions under the mentorship of the Controller. It is a great steppingstone for someone interested in growing into a Staff Accountant or Accounting Specialist role. Part-time and full-time candidates are encouraged to apply.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Accounts Receivable**

* Prepares and posts customer invoices accurately and on schedule.
* Applies customer payments (ACH, wires, checks, credit card) to the appropriate accounts.
* Reconciles daily deposits and maintains an up-to-date AR subledger.
* Monitors outstanding balances and supports collections efforts as needed.
* Communicates with customers regarding invoice status, payment questions, and documentation requests.

**Operational Coordination**

* Tracks product shipments and matches shipping documents to invoices to ensure accurate and timely billing.

* Coordinates with Sales, Operations, and Customer Service to resolve discrepancies in orders, shipments, and invoices.

**Accounting Support (Growth Opportunities)**

* Assists the Controller with monthly bank reconciliations.
* Supports month-end close activities, including accruals and reconciliations.
* Participates in preparation for the annual financial audit, including gathering supporting documentation.
* Assists with process improvements, documentation of SOPs, and efficiency initiatives across the accounting function.

**Education Requirements**

* 2 + years of Accounts Receivable or general accounting experience preferred.

**Competencies / Skill Qualifications**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with accounting or ERP systems (experience with QuickBooks or similar is a plus).
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

**Character Requirements**

* Friendly
* Approachable
* Proactive
* Honest
* Responsible
* Punctual

* Team worker

**Exciting Opportunities with Share Food Program! We are looking for an Accounting Assistant to add to our team!**

Share Food Program (https://www.sharefoodprogram.org/about-us/) (“Share”) is the leading hunger relief organization in the Greater Philadelphia region and one of the largest independent food banks in the nation. Share feeds hundreds of thousands of individuals each month—more than half of whom are children and seniors. The ripple effects of the pandemic, record rates of inflation, and critical cuts to government assistance benefits have plunged even more people into hunger and poverty. Philadelphia has the highest rate of poverty of any major city in the U.S., and food insecurity is a public health crisis. Our network of caring volunteers, dedicated professionals, and generous donors works to bring nourishing food to our neighbors in need.

The Hospice Office Staff / Office Manager is responsible for coordinating, organizing, and overseeing the daily administrative and clerical functions of the hospice agency to ensure efficient operations, accurate recordkeeping, effective communication, and compliance with applicable organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

The Office Manager provides administrative support to the Administrator, Director of Nursing, Medical Director, clinical personnel, and interdisciplinary team members.

jobs.title: Office Administrator (Maui)
jobs.desc:
Job Purpose
  
The Office Administrator position is responsible for the overall administrative operations of the kīpuka, including managing the front office reception area; coordinating facilities use; and repairs and maintenance of the facilities. The position is also responsible for directing and coordinating business functions of the facilities, including developing and supervising processes for the maximum utilization of workspaces, administrative services, and equipment.
  
  
About Kīpuka
  
Kīpuka are grounded in Hawaiian culture and values through a healing centered approach, with heightened focus elevating the strengths and innate values of all kamalei. Kīpuka provide Hawaiian youth with opportunities to connect to caring adults, peers and mentors, receive supportive services, and discover pathways to passion, purpose, and prosperity. Kīpuka are a hub for culture, creativity, healing, technology, and play, and will serve as a resource for kamalei and their ʻohana. These safe spaces are located throughout the pae ʻaina where youth are inspired to pursue their dreams, including exploring pathways in the arts, sports, technology, and entrepreneurship while receiving wraparound support to help them reach their goals and become thriving kamalei.
  
  
Essential Responsibilities
  

* Manages the reception area to ensure effective telephone and mail communications both internally and externally to maintain professional image.
* Responsible for process improvement for organizational procedures and systems for office operations and facilities. Supports and implements all new computer software programs for operations.
* Oversees and is responsible for the kīpuka’s administrative operations budget, capital improvements, and expenditures; ensures compliance with the agency’s policies and procedures.
* Manages and oversees the daily incoming and outgoing checks, billing statements and invoices
* Manage relationship with vendors and service providers to assure that the operations and maintenance of the office floors (building, equipment, furnishing, etc.) are addressed.
* Supervises the maintenance and alteration of office areas and equipment, as well as layout, arrangement and housekeeping of office facilities.
* Coordinate and collaborate with our IT Department to ensure that the daily operations of all the system technologies are properly functioning i.e. computer, phones, softwares, copier, fax machine, etc.
* Coordinates service/professional contract submittals and follow-ups.
* Responsible for managing office services by ensuring operations and procedures are organized, ensures the unit’s filing systems are designed and secured. Follows standardized procedures for permanent records retention and retrieval.
* Negotiates the purchase of office supplies and furniture, office equipment, etc., for the entire staff in accordance with company purchasing policies and budgetary restrictions.
* Responsible for the facilities day-to-day security (such as distributing building access keys and back-up to security access cards, etc.)
* Responsible for the kīpuka parking
* Responsible for arranging internal office moves and providing arrangements for office meetings.
* Participates as needed in special projects as assigned by the Manager, Kīpuka Services and collaborates with other Office Administrators.
* Responsible for reviewing and approving direct reports activities in Concur and NetSuite.

Other Duties
  

* Contributes to the Trust’s success by accepting new assignments, helping team members, learning new skills, and striving to improve team and organization results.
* Contributes to providing a safe environment for teammates and beneficiaries.
* Provides transportation for organization related business, such as driving staff, beneficiaries and/or families to assigned destinations.
* Participates in continuing education and training opportunities for professional development
* Holiday, evening and weekend hours required as needed.

**Position Summary**

The Office Administrator plays a critical role in delivering hospitality, administrative support, and care for employees and guests within the Tower Office at Paws Up Montana. Acting as a central operational point of contact, this role ensures seamless daily executive office workflows, calendar management, cash handling, and cross-office coordination. By upholding the highest standards of discretion, organization, and guest service, the Office Administrator supports leadership initiatives while embodying the core values and luxury standards of Paws Up Montana.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Administrative & Calendar Support:** Manage mailings, calendars, and appointments for Executive Office leadership, while acting as a seamless conduit of communication between the Las Vegas corporate office and Montana operations teams.
* **Confidentiality & Professional Standards:** Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive executive materials, corporate communications, and high-level operational data at all times.
* **Office Operations & Supply Management:** Maintain an organized, professional workspace and manage inventory levels for all office supplies required for smooth executive office operations.
* **Financial & Cash Handling Oversight:** Manage the office safe, oversee petty cash procedures, and execute cash handling duties, including coordinating town runner cash pick-ups with basic bookkeeping accuracy.
* **Guest & Interdepartmental Hospitality:** Answer phone calls according to Paws Up Montana standards and deliver exceptional service to visiting guests, executives, and internal team members.
* **Procurement & Special Projects:** Collaborate with the Director of Special Projects, Purchasing Manager, and Department Directors to source materials, coordinate corporate events, and execute special projects as assigned.
* **Ad-Hoc Duties:** Perform additional duties as assigned by the Managing Director or Director of Special Projects.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 2–3 years of administrative, office management, or executive support experience, preferably within a luxury resort, hospitality, or corporate office setting.
* **Specialized Knowledge:** Basic understanding of accounting or bookkeeping principles, office administration workflows, and luxury guest service standards.
* **Core Skills:** Exceptional problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills; highly flexible, detailed-oriented, and capable of handling sensitive, high-level information with utmost discretion.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook), basic computer/hardware troubleshooting skills, and experience with property management systems (such as Maestro PMS or similar systems).
* **Work Style:** Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a neat, professional appearance and a proactive approach to office upkeep.
* **Licensing/Certification:** Valid State Driver’s License.

**Physical Requirements**

* **Mobility & Stamina:** Ability to frequently sit, stand, walk, and navigate office facilities for extended periods throughout the workday.
* **Scheduling:** Ability to maintain a flexible work schedule, including occasional extended hours or varied schedules to support executive events and operational requirements.
* **Lifting & Handling:** Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull office supplies, packages, and administrative equipment weighing up to 25–30 lbs.

Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

DGA is a 180-person architecture firm with offices in Mountain View, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, and recently we opened an office in Orange County. Since 1995, we have specialized in architecture, interiors and planning for the life sciences, higher education, healthcare, and mission critical sectors.

  

Our new office in Orange County is an exciting start up within a successful stable firm. It is a fast-paced hub that requires a unique hybrid of high-level administrative precision and proactive office hospitality. The office location is 4695 MacArthur Court in Newport Beach, conveniently located between the 405, 55, and 73.

  

We are looking for an Office Manager who views "no task as too small and no contract as too complex." You will be the face of the firm for clients and the backbone of the office for our architects.

This isn't a "sit-and-wait" reception role. You will balance two distinct worlds:

* Project & Contract Administration: You will act as a technical resource, assisting with the preparation of AIA Contract Documents, detailed contract completion and staffing reports.

* Office Stewardship & Hospitality: You will take personal pride in the physical environment—ensuring the "client-ready" state of the office by managing everything from snack inventory to kitchen maintenance.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to…)

* Assisting in the preparation and formatting of AIA Contract Documents, letters of agreement, and complex spreadsheets.

* Proactively managing and restocking office and kitchen supplies—ensuring the team never runs out of the essentials.
* Planning and executing everything from weekly catered staff meetings to large-scale social parties and holiday events.
* Assisting to on-board new Architectural hires.
* Serving as the primary contact for property management and building maintenance to ensure the facility is operating at peak efficiency.
* This is a 5-day in the office position

  

Qualifications

* 5+ years of administrative experience (A/E/C industry experience is a significant advantage).
* Expert-level Google Workspace and MS Office. Powerful experience with Bluebeam and Deltek Ajera, AIA Contract Documents preferred,
* Exceptional writing skills are a must. You should be able to draft a formal professional letter as easily as a firm-wide social invite.
* You are detail-oriented, self-aware, and possess the "hospitality heart" required to keep a physical office running smoothly.

  

DGA is a fantastic company to work for, just talk to our people! Along with great pay, we offer excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, 401k, three (3) weeks of PTO, and an annual staff development allowance. We also have a very generous bonus program.

  

At the time of posting this job advertisement, the annual pay salary range for this position is between $75,000 to $95,000 commensurate with qualifications

jobs.desc:
**Patient Care Coordinator / Front Desk Receptionist — Mission Viejo, CA**

If you want a job where your energy matters, your work matters, and you get to be part of people getting their lives back, this could be a great fit.

We’re a small, two-doctor practice. My wife, Dr. Tara, and I see every patient ourselves, and you would be the third person on our team.

Functional Restoration Institute is a chiropractic sports medicine and functional medicine clinic. Many of our patients come to us after years of seeing specialists, trying different treatments, and being told to “just live with it” or that surgery may be their only option.

This is not a front desk job where you sit behind a counter and check in strangers all day.

You’ll know our patients by name. You’ll hear their stories. You’ll see their progress. And you’ll be part of their experience from the first phone call through their care.

We want someone who brings energy into the office, enjoys talking to people, and takes pride in making sure every patient feels taken care of.

**What a normal day looks like**

- Have the clinic open, organized, and ready for the first patient at 9:00 AM

- Call people who have reached out to us, answer their questions, and help get them scheduled

- Take the handoff after a new patient finishes their first visit with the doctor, get their next appointments scheduled, and make sure they understand what happens next

- Follow up with patients who canceled, missed appointments, or fell off their schedule

- Answer phone calls, texts, and emails throughout the day

- Help manage our social media by scheduling posts and responding to comments and messages

- Keep the front desk and patient experience running smoothly

**Who does well here**

You have energy. You like people. And people can feel that when they talk to you.

You’re comfortable picking up the phone and starting a conversation. Some of the people you speak with will be nervous, skeptical, frustrated, in pain, or difficult to reach. You’re not intimidated by that. You know how to connect with people, answer their questions, and make them feel comfortable moving forward.

If you enjoy building trust, helping people, and being part of their progress, you’ll probably love this role.

You’re dependable. We are a three-person team, so everyone matters. We need someone who shows up every day, on time, ready to work, and takes their responsibilities seriously.

You’ve had real work experience. Maybe that’s in sales, hospitality, customer service, healthcare, leadership, or even running your own business.

You’re also very comfortable with technology and learning new systems. A big part of this role involves working in our EHR, CRM, Google Drive, phone and texting systems, email, scheduling software, and other day-to-day office platforms. **What You Will Do**
  
This position reports directly to the Patient Accounting Supervisor and is responsible for working to resolve pre-billing edits which prevent clean claim submission. This position will work to identify root cause and work closely with Management across multiple departments to mitigate reoccurrence.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* H.S. Diploma or Equivalent
* 2 Years experience in the performance of charge quality assessment in an acute care hospital.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate's Degree
* Bachelor's Degree
  

**Essential Functions**

* The position characteristics reflect the most important duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential functions of the job in a fully competent manner. They should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. The characteristics of the position and standards of performance may be changed by TCMC with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.
    
  Maintains a safe, clean working environment, including unit based safety and infection control requirements.
    
  Access multiple reports daily to identify encounters hitting delinquent data and/or placed on hold for research by a collector and/or member of management within the department.
    
  Pre-Billing
    
  Work all encounters hitting an APC/OCE edit daily by performing the necessary research, applying the correct modifier, adding/removing a charge if necessary and/or following-up with the department for assistance if required.
    
  Review accounts pending Modifier review by accessing Craneware and determining the necessity of the requested modifier and/or review the exception to determine if a charge could possibly be missing creating the issue.
    
  Review 'LWOT' encounters in Cerner to determine if the patient was seen by a Physician’s Assistant and/or Physician while in Triage to determine the appropriateness of billing the encounter.
    
  Research MUE edits to determine if the code hitting the edit is packaged with a maximum quantity allowed, crediting any overage.
    
  Retrieve and email all encounters requiring review by Key Healthcare for OPOBS charging daily.
    
  Retrieve Missing ED Charge report monthly and determine if there is a missing emergency room charge and/or a missing procedure code. Work with KHC and/or HIM to determine next steps.
    
  Re-abstract encounters daily that have been placed on hold to ensure the appropriate APC/DRG/APR-DRG is reflected on the encounter.
    
  Identify encounters in which Invega is administered and coordinate charging with the Pharmacy prior to the bill dropping.
    
  Updating/Reabstracting encounters to provide Self-pay rates as needed.
    
  Other assigned duties pertaining to pre-billing edits, charge capture and AR as required.
    
  Work closely with IT to ensure 3M updates are current and factors correct.
    
  Cross Function
    
  Works in collaboration with the collectors and/or billers to review any encounters with an edit/denial that may have an issue outlined above.
    
  May assist in patient calls as well as place follow-up calls to insurance carriers.

**Pay:** $20–$30 per hour, depending on experience  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Position

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Office Administrator to assist with the daily operations of our front office. This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with numbers, managing documents, communicating professionally, and keeping office operations organized and up to date.

The ideal candidate does not need to be an experienced bookkeeper or accountant. We already have accounting support in place and are looking for someone who can handle routine accounts payable and receivable, maintain tenant records, assist with bill payments, and provide general administrative support across our business operations.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through on responsibilities, stays organized, and can be trusted to keep track of important details.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounts Payable & Receivable**

* Prepare monthly accounts payable and accounts receivable reports.
* Track incoming payments, outstanding balances, rent, and utility payments.
* Maintain accurate tenant ledgers and payment records.
* Monitor bills and due dates, help ensure payments are made on time, and flag discrepancies or unusual charges.
* Write and process checks through QuickBooks.
* Mail checks, prepare bank deposits, and maintain organized payment records.
* Assist with insurance payments, policy records, renewals, and related documentation.

**Office Administration**

* Receive, sort, distribute, and manage incoming mail.
* Answer incoming phone calls and direct inquiries appropriately.
* Monitor company email accounts and bring important messages, requests, and deadlines to management's attention.

* Keep track of important paperwork, correspondence, and recurring administrative deadlines.
* Help maintain a clean, orderly, and professional front office.
* Assist management with general office tasks and other administrative responsibilities as needed.

**Organization & Recordkeeping**

* Maintain and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking logs, and other administrative records.
* Keep tenant files, insurance documents, bills, receipts, and other company records accurate and accessible.
* Follow established procedures and ensure routine tasks are completed consistently.
* Identify missing information, overdue payments, upcoming deadlines, and other items requiring attention.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with numbers, payments, records, and financial documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including maintaining spreadsheets and organizing data.
* Basic familiarity with QuickBooks or the ability to learn it quickly.
* Comfortable using email, computers, digital filing systems, and standard office equipment.
* Professional communication skills and a courteous telephone manner.
* Dependable, trustworthy, and able to handle confidential business information appropriately.
* Able to manage recurring responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and work independently once trained.

Previous office administration, accounts payable/receivable, property management administration, or general clerical experience is helpful but not required. We are willing to train the right candidate.

The right person is someone who enjoys keeping things in order, notices when something needs attention, and follows through without needing constant reminders. They should be comfortable balancing routine administrative tasks with occasional requests from management.
