jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**About this** **position**

Are you looking for an opportunity where you can showcase your creativity, innovate marketing materials that make a real impact? The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for assisting the Director of Marketing, to further the ServiceMaster DSI Brand through the implementation of an integrated marketing plan across all ServiceMaster DSI locations. This will also be a remote position with onsite travel required.

**About DSI**

Would you like to work for a growing, strong, empire-building franchise company, where you can make a difference by growing with them? When disaster strikes, ServiceMaster DSI will be there to help. As the largest operator of ServiceMaster Restore, ServiceMaster DSI has the experience and resources to help homeowners and business owners recover after a loss. From a kitchen fire to a flash flood, ServiceMaster DSI is your recovery expert. DSI is an amazing place to work, with happy employees that are ready to help families and businesses recover from fire and water damage. With continued investment in education, the latest tools and technology, and expert training, we are industry leaders in disaster restoration and cleaning. Did we mention we're the largest ServiceMaster Franchise? We have 26 locations across the US!

The salary for this position is $50K - 60K, depending on experience.

**What you will do:**

* Support the Director of Marketing in establishing, implementing and evaluating localized marketing strategies and plans.
  + Write, develop and design new print materials, including hard collateral, advertisements, promotional items and more.
  + Write, develop and design digital campaigns, including emails, social media, website landing pages, blogs, graphics and more that align with DSI's overall business goals and campaign optimization.
* Identify areas of improvement in marketing, modify them, and remain up-to-date on competitor strategies.
* Develop and work with the Director of Marketing on marketing strategies and determine the most effective channels for the target audience.
* Adhere to and uphold brand identity standards.
* Maintain an inventory and directory of sales support materials making sure all resources are accurate.
* Setup tracking systems for marketing campaigns and online activities.
* Manage print contractors and other promotional vendors.
* Analyze the competitive landscape.
* Manage and communicate promotions and marketing materials to sales representatives.
* Occasional travel may be required. This is a remote position, with occasional visits to branch locations or events needed. Coordinator must be within reasonable driving distance of a DSI branch location.
* Create branded advertising and support the marketing team by planning and coordinating content.
* Create, maintain and strengthen the organization's overall brand through all media avenues.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Collaborate with other departments internally, ensure the promotions run well, and track and evaluate their effectiveness.
* Maintain regular communication with marketing, local sales teams and promotional vendors as needed.
* Meet all marketing goals provided by the Director of Marketing.
* Complete other projects as needed.
* Adhere to DSI Policies and Procedures.
* Position may require alternative bending and lifting of items up to 20 pounds.
* Some work within this position may involve work completed on the road.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications or related field required
* 4+ years' professional business experience in marketing, social media, communications, advertising and/or graphic design.
* Adept in Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Suite, Facebook, LinkedIn, Canva, email marketing tools and social media scheduling tools.
* Photography and video content creation experience is a plus.
* Proven track record of strong writing and editing skills.
* Proven track record of strong graphic design

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our team and ensure the accuracy and integrity of our financial records. In this vital role, you will manage a wide range of accounting functions, from maintaining the general ledger to processing payroll, reconciling accounts, and preparing financial reports. Your expertise will support our organization’s financial health and compliance with accounting standards, enabling us to operate efficiently and transparently. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for precise financial management, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute your skills to a purpose-driven organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date general ledger entries using accounting software such as QuickBooks Online.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice processing, payment scheduling, and collections.
* Reconcile bank statements, credit card statements, and other financial accounts regularly to ensure consistency with ledger records.
* Prepare journal entries for various financial transactions following GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) standards.
* Conduct balance sheet reconciliation to verify the accuracy of asset, liability, and equity accounts.
* Assist in budgeting processes and provide detailed account analysis for financial reporting purposes.
* Support governmental or non-profit accounting procedures as needed, ensuring adherence to specific regulations.
* Perform account analysis and general ledger reconciliation to identify discrepancies or errors promptly.
* Maintain thorough documentation of all financial transactions and prepare reports for internal review or external audits.

**Skills**

* Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, OpenInvoice
* Strong understanding of corporate accounting principles, GAAP standards, and governmental or non-profit accounting practices.
* Experience with double-entry bookkeeping, journal entries, bank reconciliations, and account analysis.
* Skilled in payroll processing, accounts payable/receivable management, and tax-related tasks.
* Excellent spreadsheet skills with advanced knowledge of Excel or other spreadsheet tools for data analysis and reporting.
* Familiarity with financial concepts including debits & credits, balance sheet reconciliation, general ledger accounting, and account reconciliation.
* Ability to interpret financial reports accurately and write clear financial summaries.
* Attention to detail with 10-key typing proficiency for data entry accuracy.
* Knowledge of budgeting processes and technical accounting standards required for precise recordkeeping.

Join us in a role where your expertise will directly impact our organization’s financial stability! We value meticulousness combined with proactive problem-solving — if you’re passionate about keeping finances on track while supporting our mission through precise bookkeeping practices, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $15.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35.0 – 45.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.desc:
**International Minerals Carlsbad, INC.** is seeking a detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist to support accurate and timely accounts payable operations. This position is responsible for processing invoices, verifying supporting documentation, coding expenses to the appropriate general ledger accounts, and assisting with month-end closing activities.

The ideal candidate understands Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), has experience with two-way and three-way invoice matching, and can effectively investigate and resolve discrepancies. Experience using Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.

#### **Essential Responsibilities**

* Review, code, and process vendor invoices accurately and within established deadlines.
* Perform two-way and three-way matching of invoices, purchase orders, and receiving documentation.
* Assign appropriate general ledger account codes, cost centers, departments, and project information.
* Verify invoices for accuracy, proper authorization, and supporting documentation.
* Enter invoices and related accounts payable information into the accounting system.
* Research and resolve invoice, pricing, purchase order, and receiving discrepancies.
* Communicate professionally with vendors, procurement personnel, receiving teams, and internal departments.
* Reconcile vendor statements and follow up on missing invoices, credits, or outstanding balances.
* Assist with weekly payment processing, including checks, ACH payments, and other approved payment methods.
* Maintain accurate and complete accounts payable records in accordance with company policies and recordkeeping requirements.
* Support month-end closing activities, including account reconciliations, accruals, and outstanding invoice reviews.
* Help ensure accounts payable transactions are processed in accordance with GAAP and established internal controls.
* Respond to vendor inquiries and resolve payment-related concerns promptly.
* Support internal and external audits by providing requested documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounts payable accuracy, efficiency, and workflow.
* Perform additional accounting and administrative duties as assigned.

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous accounts payable, bookkeeping, accounting, or related financial experience.
* Familiarity with GAAP and standard accounting controls.
* Experience supporting month-end closing activities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to organize and prioritize a high volume of invoices and competing deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential financial and business information appropriately.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Microsoft Dynamics.
* Accounts payable experience within mining, manufacturing, construction, oil and gas, utilities, or another industrial environment.
* Experience working with purchase orders, receiving documentation, vendor statements, and general ledger reconciliations.
* Additional coursework or training in accounting, finance, or business administration.
* Work Environment

This position supports accounting operations within an active industrial organization. The Accounts Payable Specialist must be comfortable working across departments and communicating with employees, vendors, procurement personnel, and operational leaders to resolve issues and maintain accurate financial records.

**International Minerals Carlsbad, INC.** is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Preferred Education:** Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field

**About the Opportunity**  
Well-established non-profit accounting firm in Ventura County, California is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and dependable Bookkeeper to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records, and thrives in an organized, professional environment.

We are looking for someone who brings not only strong bookkeeping experience but also a proactive mindset, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to seeing responsibilities through to completion.

The ideal candidate is organized, resourceful, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively.

A minimum of three years of bookkeeping experience is required, with five or more years strongly preferred.

Accounting experience, coursework, or related education is highly desirable. An accounting degree is a plus but is not required.

**Position Summary**  
The Bookkeeper will be responsible for supporting day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling accounts, processing financial transactions, and assisting with reporting and month-end activities.

This position requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

The Bookkeeper will work closely with the firm's accounting professionals and may communicate directly with clients to obtain financial information, resolve discrepancies, and ensure timely completion of assigned work.

Successful candidates will demonstrate accountability, professionalism, confidentiality, and a willingness to take ownership of their responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Bookkeeping & Financial Recordkeeping**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records for assigned accounts and clients.
* Record and categorize financial transactions, including income, expenses, payments, deposits, and adjustments.
* Maintain general ledger accounts and supporting documentation.
* Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and proper classification.
* Identify and correct discrepancies in financial records.
* Maintain organized electronic and financial records.

**Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable**

* Process and record vendor invoices, payments, and related transactions.
* Track outstanding accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Monitor customer payments and outstanding balances.
* Assist with billing, invoicing, and payment reconciliation.
* Communicate with clients and vendors regarding missing information, discrepancies, and payment-related questions.
* Ensure financial transactions are recorded accurately and promptly.

**Bank & Account Reconciliations**

* Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations.
* Reconcile general ledger accounts and investigate discrepancies.
* Review financial statements and supporting transactions to identify inconsistencies.
* Research and resolve outstanding or unreconciled items.
* Maintain accurate reconciliation records and documentation.

**Financial Reporting & Accounting Support**

* Assist with preparing routine financial reports and statements.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities.
* Prepare and organize financial information for review by accountants and management.
* Assist with maintaining schedules and supporting documentation.
* Help identify unusual transactions, missing records, and potential accounting errors.
* Support tax preparation by gathering and organizing financial records and documentation.

**Payroll & Additional Accounting Support**

* Assist with payroll-related recordkeeping and reconciliations, as applicable.
* Review payroll-related transactions for proper recording and classification.
* Assist with expense tracking, reimbursements, and financial documentation.

jobs.desc:
Power Trip Rentals is seeking an experienced **Heavy Equipment Dispatcher** to join our operations team. This role is responsible for coordinating the daily movement of **heavy rental equipment** using **Class A flatbed and Class C trucks**, communicating with drivers, and ensuring deliveries and pickups are completed safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

This is **not general freight or courier dispatch**. The ideal candidate has prior experience dispatching **flatbeds and/or rental equipment**, understands jobsite logistics, and can adapt quickly in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting the film, entertainment, and event industries.

**Responsibilities**

* Schedule, assign, and dispatch **Class A flatbed and Class C drivers** for equipment deliveries, pickups, transfers, and will-call orders
* Coordinate transportation of **heavy equipment** including forklifts, boom lifts, scissor lifts, generators, light towers, and related rental assets
* Review rental orders and contracts to ensure **correct equipment, delivery method, and truck type** prior to dispatch
* Plan routes and delivery schedules based on **jobsite access, delivery windows, load requirements, and operational priorities**
* Maintain constant communication with drivers, providing instructions, updates, and support throughout the day
* Monitor fleet locations, job progress, and equipment status; proactively respond to **delays, site changes, or last-minute requests**
* Communicate with customers regarding **ETAs, delivery changes, access issues, or delays**
* Coordinate closely with yard, service, sales, and operations teams to ensure equipment readiness and accuracy
* Update dispatch notes, job statuses, and delivery documentation in the rental management system
* Handle dispatch paperwork, driver logs, and delivery confirmations
* Ensure drivers are compliant with **DOT regulations, hours of service, and company safety policies**
* Assist with occasional local deliveries or site checks as needed

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in **heavy equipment, rental, logistics, or flatbed dispatching** strongly preferred
* Experience dispatching **Class A flatbed trucks** is highly desirable
* Familiarity with **jobsite deliveries and equipment transportation**
* Working knowledge of **DOT regulations and driver compliance requirements**
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient with computers and scheduling systems (Microsoft Office, Outlook, dispatch or rental software)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred
* Must be available for **weekend coverage and occasional overtime**

* Up to 13 paid holidays

***Essential Job Responsibilities***Reporting to the HR Manager, the Payroll/HR Assistant is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of the Credit Union's weekly payroll, maintaining the integrity of the Human Resources Information System (HRIS), assisting with recruiting, onboarding and leaves of absence tracking. The responsibilities include assisting with HRIS data management, recruiting and onboarding, leave of absence tracking, benefit management and system-related inquiries. The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail, sound judgment with confidential information, and a service-oriented approach consistent with the Credit Union's member-and employee-focused culture.

* Maintain and update employee records in the HRIS, including new hires, terminations, status changes, compensation changes, tax withholdings, and direct deposit information.
* Administer payroll-related deductions such as benefits premiums, retirement plan contributions (e.g., 401(k), garnishments, and other voluntary and involuntary deductions.
* Reconcile payroll accounts and prepare reports for accounting and maintain reports for audit purposes.
* Ensure compliance with FLSA, IRS, state, and local payroll regulations; prepare and quarterly and year-end reports and documentation as required.
* Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and security of HRIS data; perform regular audits and resolve discrepancies.
* Generate standard and ad hoc reports from the HRIS to support HR, management, audit, and regulatory needs.
* Support benefits administration activities, including open enrollment, life-event changes, and carrier file feeds within the HRIS.
* Respond to employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, tax forms, and HRIS self-service functions in a timely and professional manner.
* Respond to requests for employment verification requests.
* Maintain confidentiality of all payroll and personnel information.
* Maintain all legally required postings in break room areas.
* Assist with leave of absence tracking and documentation.
* Assist with recruitment activities and onboarding documentation.
* Perform other related HR duties as assigned.

Requirements:  

* Minimum of **three (3) years** of progressively responsible payroll and/or HRIS administration experience.
* Working knowledge of payroll laws and regulations, including FLSA, wage and hour

**General description:**

Accounts Receivable Clerk

**Essential work requirements (not limited to):**

Records, verifies, and posts payments received by KMDSI. Ensures transactions are recorded promptly and accurately in accordance with internal accounting policies. Reconciles payments with the accounts receivable ledger and prepares delinquent-account reports. Handles invoicing, customer statements, billing, collections, and responses to customer inquiries about bills. Audits daily manufacturing orders for accuracy. Manages inventory counts semi-annually. jobs.desc:
Sol Stack Battery LLC is seeking a professional, dependable, and highly organized **Customer Relations & Operations Coordinator** to join our growing team at our office in Añasco.

This position plays an important role in both customer communication and the day-to-day coordination of our field operations. The successful candidate will communicate regularly with customers by phone and email, help coordinate scheduling for our field crews, and assist the General Manager with a variety of administrative and organizational responsibilities.

We are looking for someone who is **well organized, detail oriented, an excellent communicator, and comfortable keeping track of multiple priorities at the same time**.

No previous solar industry experience is required. For the right candidate, this position offers an opportunity to learn the solar and battery energy industry, develop valuable technical and operational knowledge, and grow into greater responsibilities as the company continues to expand.

Responsibilities

* Answer incoming customer phone calls in a professional and courteous manner
* Respond to customer emails and other communications
* Assist customers with general questions and direct technical or specialized matters to the appropriate team member
* Follow up with customers and help ensure inquiries and outstanding matters are handled promptly
* Help coordinate and maintain schedules for installation, service, and other field crews
* Communicate scheduling information and updates between customers, field personnel, and management
* Assist with organizing upcoming jobs and ensuring necessary information is available to the appropriate team members
* Maintain accurate customer records, scheduling information, and other documentation
* Assist the General Manager with administrative and organizational tasks
* Help coordinate information between customers and other members of the Sol Stack team
* Perform other general administrative and operational duties as needed

Qualifications

* **Fluent bilingual English and Spanish is required**
* Excellent verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish
* Strong written communication skills in both English and Spanish
* **Highly organized and detail oriented**
* Able to coordinate schedules and keep track of multiple ongoing tasks
* Professional, friendly, and courteous when communicating with customers
* Comfortable using computers, email, and common office software
* Able to prioritize responsibilities and follow through on outstanding items
* Dependable, punctual, and able to work independently when needed
* Previous customer service, administrative, scheduling, or coordination experience is preferred
* Previous solar or renewable energy experience is **not required**

Opportunity for Growth

Sol Stack is a growing company, and we are looking for someone interested in growing with us. This position provides an opportunity to learn about **solar energy, battery energy storage, and renewable energy systems** while working closely with our management and field teams.

The right candidate will have the opportunity to develop significant knowledge of the industry, become an expert in solar and battery energy systems, take on increasing responsibilities, and **advance within the company as we grow**.

Schedule & Location

This is a **full-time, 40-hour-per-week, in-office position** at our facility in **Añasco, Puerto Rico**. This is not a remote position.

Compensation & Benefits

* **$13.00–$16.00 per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications
* **Bonuses**
* **Paid vacation**
* Opportunity for professional development and advancement within the company

About Sol Stack Battery LLC

**Who You Are**

jobs.title: SL- Business Office Manager
jobs.desc:
**Summary of Duties:**  
Responsible for the coordination and administration of facility Business Office functions including billing, collections, and maintenance of resident financial records. Provides residents and sponsors with information regarding payment source, accounts, charges and/or account status.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions:**  
1.Determines residents’ level of care and payment source and communicates such to Central Billing Office (CBO), family/sponsors, and appropriate management staff.
  
  
2.Gathers information and submits application to Medicaid for eligibility determination.
  
  
3.Processes admissions/discharges on all Medicaid residents into the LTC (State System), completes required forms upon admission/readmission and maintains Medicaid resource amounts.
  
  
4.Collects, record and document information regarding all activity occurring on an account including posting/processing of ancillary charges, resident charges, and late charges in resident accounting system.
  
  
5.Reconciles daily resident census, update electronic billing systems and forwards information to required parties.
  
  
6.Maintains all resident files to ensure that required documentation is filed properly. Purges paid out resident files consistent with retention guidelines.
  
  
7.Collects payments, or if necessary, makes financial arrangements at time of admission on amount due according to established policy. Forwards all information on deposits to CBO for proper posting.
  
  
8.Consults with admissions representative in the admission of residents regarding financial arrangements including insurance verification and certification.
  
  
9.Determines if an account is potentially uncollectible and forwards information to CBO.
  
  
10.Submits paperwork to Social Security on residents for which resident representatives fail to pay resource amount to ensure payment is received on account monthly.
  
  
11.Submits requested information for monthly Medicaid audit.
  
  
12.Coordinates efforts with residents/resident representatives in enrollment in a drug plan as needed. Communicates with pharmacy to ensure correct billing on drugs.
  
  
13.Manages resident trust fund.
  
  
14.Supervises and manages front desk personnel and reception functions as assigned.
  
  
15.Performs other duties and responsibilities as directed, including any special projects.
  
  
**Education and Experience:**  
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or related field preferred. Experience may be considered in lieu of degree. Minimum of two (2) years’ experience performing business office functions in a healthcare setting required. One (1) year of supervisory experience preferred.

------------------

Fragment is the AI platform that autonomously streamlines procurement workflows end to end. Within a few months of launch, we signed Fortune 500 companies. Within a year of founding, our customers, all $1B+ revenue enterprises, continue to grow in number and are actively championing us to their networks, and our marketing and CAC to get here has been $0.

We work from our San Francisco office five days a week. Being in the room together is how we move blazingly fast at "Fragment Pace". You'll work with a team of passionate builders, sharp operators, and most importantly kind, thoughtful humans who are here to reimagine the systems underlying the movement of physical goods and build a generational company.

**The role**
------------

Our founders’ time is increasingly becoming scarce at Fragment. Your job is to protect it and multiply it, so our founders and leadership team can efficiently prioritize the allocation of energy – to customers, product, and hiring exceptional people.

This role is about 70% executive support and 30% office and operations, and you'll directly support both founders. It's a high-trust seat: you'll have a view into nearly everything happening at the company, and real latitude to decide how we run. You'll also own the office and the moments that bring the team together as we scale.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run the calendars of our founders: decide what gets time, resolve conflicts before they happen, and protect focus time. Relentless prioritization and optimization of their productivity.
* Coordinate with ops and drive preparation every day of agendas, briefing notes and materials, and follow through on action items so nothing drops.
* Plan travel end to end, from customer visits to last-minute trips, and rebook fast when plans change.
* Coordinate board and investor meetings, from scheduling and materials to logistics on the day.
* Run the office: facilities, vendors, supplies, meals and the hundred small things that make it a place people want to be.
* Plan team events, offsites and rituals that strengthen our culture as we grow.
* Build systems for all of it. We'd rather you automate a task once than do it by hand a hundred times.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4+ years as an Executive Assistant, ideally supporting multiple executives at a high-growth startup.
* You've seen what world-class executive support looks like, and you hold yourself to that bar.
* You build rapport. You honor commitments and meet deadlines.
* You anticipate. You've booked the car, sent the pre-read, and flagged the conflict before anyone asks.
* Sharp judgment on priorities: you know when to say yes, when to push back and when to escalate.
* Discretion. You'll see board materials, compensation and sensitive conversations, and they stay with you.
* You write well and move fast; requests get handled the same day, not the next week
* Organized and proactive. You juggle many competing demands and share updates before anyone has to ask.
* Low ego. No task is too small when it helps the team, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* You hold yourself to an exceptionally high standard and cannot work any other way; this is just how you're wired.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

* **Write it down.** Help document workflows and communication standards, so client service stays consistent no matter who’s on shift.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Coordination experience.** 2+ years in a client-facing or coordination role in logistics, 3PL, or ecommerce operations.
* **Strong Excel and data skills.** Comfortable working with large datasets, lookups, and pivot tables, and finding the answer in the data rather than guessing.

**Qualifications & Key Competencies**

* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience in office management, dispatching, or administrative operations (experience in trades, HVAC, plumbing, or field services is a major plus).
* **Detail-Oriented Mindset:** Proven track record of high accuracy in data entry, scheduling, and financial/invoicing tasks. You naturally review your own work before pressing "send."
* **Tech-Savvy:** Comfortable navigating digital software, cloud platforms (Google Workspace/Drive), field service software, and modern communication apps. Eager to use modern AI automation tools to reduce manual typing.
* **Communication:** Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills for interacting with clients, technicians, and executive leadership.
* **Problem Solver:** Calm under pressure when managing shifting technician schedules or urgent client service requests.

**Compensation & Work Environment**

* **Hybrid Structure:** Balanced hybrid model with 50% in-office collaboration in San Diego and 50% remote flexibility once fully onboarded.
* **Growth:** Opportunity to help shape and modernize the operational standards of a growing mechanical services company.

Please submit your resume along with a brief summary highlighting your experience with scheduling, invoicing, and keeping operations running smoothly.

jobs.desc:
MEDICAL BILLING SPECIALIST

Department: Administration  
Reports To: Revenue Cycle Director  
Supervises: None  
Status: Full-Time  
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

The Medical Billing Specialist is responsible for accurate and timely billing, follow-up, and resolution of patient and insurance accounts for Rice Community Health. This position supports the hospital, Rural Health Clinics (RHCs), and other applicable healthcare services and is responsible for ensuring claims are submitted accurately, appropriately adjudicated, and followed through to payment or resolution.

The Medical Billing Specialist works closely with Revenue Cycle, Health Information Management, Registration, clinical departments, and external payers to identify and resolve billing issues that may delay or prevent reimbursement. The position requires a strong understanding of medical billing practices, payer requirements, hospital and RHC billing, and applicable federal and state regulations.

The successful candidate will demonstrate attention to detail, strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities while maintaining confidentiality and compliance with applicable laws and Rice Community Health policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and/or Experience

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate's degree in medical billing, healthcare administration, accounting, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years of medical billing, healthcare revenue cycle, or related experience preferred.
* Experience with hospital or facility billing preferred.
* Experience with Critical Access Hospital (CAH) and/or Rural Health Clinic (RHC) billing strongly preferred.
* Experience with CPSI/TruBridge and eClinicalWorks strongly preferred, particularly experience performing hospital and/or RHC billing within these systems.
* Experience working with electronic claims, clearinghouses, payer portals, and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems preferred.
* Experience with UB-04 and CMS-1500 claims preferred.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS / JOB DUTIES

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

Billing and Claims

* Review, prepare, and submit accurate and timely hospital, RHC, and other healthcare claims to third-party payers.
* Review claims for accuracy and completeness prior to submission and identify information that may result in denials or payment delays.
* Work clearinghouse edits, DDE errors, payer rejections, and other claim issues in a timely manner.
* Monitor claims from submission through adjudication and payment.
* Follow up on unpaid, underpaid, and delayed claims in accordance with established Revenue Cycle workflows.
* Research and resolve claim discrepancies involving eligibility, authorization, coding, medical necessity, billing requirements, and payer policies.
* Review accounts after insurance processing to ensure payments, adjustments, contractual allowances, and patient responsibility are accurately posted.
* Identify and resolve payment variances and potential underpayments.
* Process payer correspondence and take appropriate action to resolve outstanding issues.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of billing activity, follow-up, and account resolution within the applicable systems.
* Monitor accounts receivable and prioritize accounts based on aging, balance, payer requirements, and timely filing deadlines.
* Submit reconsiderations, corrected claims, appeals, and other payer requests as appropriate.
* Identify recurring billing issues and communicate trends or concerns to Revenue Cycle leadership.

Denials and Accounts Receivable

* Work assigned denial and accounts receivable reports to identify and resolve outstanding balances.
* Research the cause of denials and determine the appropriate corrective action.

This position assists with all phases of prequalification, bidding, contracting, and contract administration in alignment with established company policies. * PROJECT SUPPORT: Utilize established company policies and workflows to support all stages of project development, including contractor prequalification, bid solicitation, proposal review, contracting, and ongoing contract administration. Ensure that all required documentation is collected, verified, and properly stored. Assist project managers by preparing bid packages, gathering specifications, tracking deliverables, and ensuring all materials comply with internal standards and client requirements.
* DOCUMENTATION MANAGEMENT: Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date project documentation including correspondence, drawings, specifications, proposals, contracts, change orders, and approvals. Ensure all documents are organized according to company standards and stored within the appropriate digital or physical systems. Verify pricing, scope changes, and supporting documentation before submission. Minimum of two (2) years of experience in project coordination, operations support, or construction-related work.

jobs.desc:
At Jukebox Health, our mission is to empower everyone to live safer, healthier, more independent lives at home. We partner with health plans to make homes safer and more accessible for older adults and high-needs populations. We achieve this by combining technology with networks of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications and environmental supports nationwide. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, Jukebox Health is a fast growing healthcare services company backed by top venture capital firms like Valtruis and The Home Depot.

We are seeking a Project Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for a portfolio of home modification projects within their assigned region. You'll be the primary point of contact for Jukebox's service provider network, helping move home modification projects from bid through completion. You'll spend much of your day communicating with service providers - scheduling work, following up on bids, checking in on active projects, collecting closeout documentation, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll work closely with our Project Managers and Member Engagement team to surface risks early, resolve issues quickly, and create a smooth experience for our service providers and members. You'll also support the operational side of the business through order entry, claims processing, and maintaining accurate project records in our CRM.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on a high volume of work, is a resourceful problem solver who takes initiative, and enjoys building relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Service Provider Coordination**

* Answer inbound calls and emails, handle routine questions, and escalate to the Project Manager when needed
* Follow up with service providers to get bids submitted
* Schedule and confirm project start dates
* Check in on active projects and flag delays or risks early
* Make sure providers understand expectations, timelines, and documentation requirements
* Build trusted relationships with our network to keep providers responsive, engaged, and eager to take on our projects

**Project Throughput**

* Keep a high volume of active projects moving through each stage without letting them stall
* Work daily from operational queues to determine priorities and next actions
* Send reminders ahead of key milestones and deadlines

**Documentation, Claims & Administration**

* Collect closeout documents, photos, and required forms, and follow up until everything is complete and accurate
* Assist with claims entry and processing
* Enter and maintain project orders accurately
* Review records for completeness and accuracy before submission
* Resolve discrepancies and follow up on missing information
* Keep CRM records current and complete, including significant provider communications and project updates

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in vendor coordination, contractor coordination, dispatch, scheduling, project coordination, field operations, or a similar role
* Strong phone presence, comfortable spending much of the day on calls and email with contractors, vendors, or small business owners
* Persistent follow-up skills, especially with people who are busy and slow to respond
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of accuracy in data entry, documentation review, or administrative operations
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and open items without dropping details
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable learning new technology platforms and working in a remote environment
* Willingness to travel occasionally for company events or field visits

**Preferred**

* Experience in construction, home services, remodeling, or accessibility modifications
* Experience with claims processing, billing, or order management
* Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM

**How We Invest In You**

jobs.desc:
**About the Position**

The Gaming Co. is a growing retail and e-commerce business specializing in trading cards, collectibles, and gaming products.

We're looking for an experienced **Accounting & Office Manager** to take ownership of our financial operations, maintain accurate books, manage payroll and tax-related responsibilities, and help leadership better understand the financial performance of our company.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and self-sufficient. Someone who takes initiative, identifies financial trends, develops useful reports, and recommends improvements without waiting to be asked.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Accounting & Financial Management*

* Independently manage the company's accounting software, bookkeeping, and financial records.
* Maintain accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger records.
* Perform bank, credit card, and account reconciliations.
* Manage payroll processing, records, and related tax obligations.
* Prepare or coordinate federal, state, and local tax filings, including applicable payroll and sales taxes.
* Work with outside accountants as necessary for tax preparation and compliance.
* Monitor expenses, cash flow, liabilities, and financial deadlines.
* Maintain accurate financial records and establish consistent reporting procedures.

*Financial Analysis & Reporting*

* Develop and monitor departmental budgets.
* Analyze profitability across departments, locations, and sales channels.
* Create financial dashboards, charts, graphs, and reports for company leadership.
* Track revenue, expenses, profit margins, and operating costs.
* Compare actual expenses against budgets and identify discrepancies.
* Identify financial trends, unnecessary spending, and opportunities to improve profitability.
* Provide regular financial summaries and actionable recommendations.
* Help establish financial KPIs and improve existing reporting systems.

*Office Management & Administration*

* Assist with employee records, onboarding, and general HR administration.
* Maintain insurance records, renewals, and administrative compliance.
* Coordinate vendor payments, purchasing, supplies, and invoices.
* Assist with freight scheduling and miscellaneous administrative projects.
* Develop organized systems for recurring tasks, deadlines, and documentation.
* Support company operations as needed.

**Qualifications**

*Required:*

* Experience independently managing business financial records.
* Strong understanding of reconciliations, payroll, and business tax obligations.
* Experience with QuickBooks or comparable accounting software.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to create financial reports, budgets, charts, and graphs.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

*Preferred:*

* Experience with departmental budgeting, forecasting, and profitability analysis.
* Experience with multi-location retail, e-commerce, or inventory-based businesses.
* Experience creating financial dashboards and performance reports.
* Experience preparing or coordinating business tax filings.
* Experience improving existing accounting systems or financial processes.

A college degree is not required. We value demonstrated experience, technical ability, and initiative over formal education.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and actively looks for ways to improve the business.

Someone who doesn't just report that expenses increased, but investigates why. Someone who can develop a departmental profitability report without being asked and identify opportunities to improve margins.

Our workplace is casual and fast-paced, but we take accountability, accuracy, and getting things done seriously.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $20.00–$25.00 per hour, based on experience.
* Full-time, Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.desc:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler™ is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

Atomic Machines is looking for a full-time Executive Assistant to support two senior executives, iGo-to-Market and Engineering, from our Emeryville five days a week. You'll be the operational backbone behind both leaders, managing calendars, travel, meetings, expenses, and projects, freeing them to focus on their highest-impact work. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between two different functions and working styles, partnering closely with each executive and their respective teams. ### **What You'll Need:**

* 7+ years of Executive Assistant experience, including direct experience supporting Sr. Director-level and above leadership; experience supporting multiple executives across different functions is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated comfort operating across both engineering and go-to-market functions. Familiarity with engineering workflows and terminology (e.g., program reviews, sprint planning, hardware/software development cycles) as well as GTM cadences (e.g., pipeline reviews, customer meetings, launch planning) is a strong plus.

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. **Job Summary**

Join our dynamic transportation team as a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) Dispatcher! In this vital role, you will coordinate and manage the scheduling and dispatching of transportation services for clients requiring non-emergency medical rides. Your energetic approach and exceptional organizational skills will ensure timely, safe, and efficient transport solutions. You’ll serve as the central communication hub, liaising with drivers, healthcare providers, and clients to deliver outstanding service while adhering to all DOT (Department of Transportation) regulations. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives through reliable transportation support.

**Duties**

* Coordinate daily dispatching of vehicles using transportation management systems and vehicle dispatch software to ensure efficient routing and timely pickups.
* Manage multi-line phone systems to handle incoming requests, schedule rides, and provide real-time updates to drivers and clients.
* Utilize GPS and GIS tools for route planning, traffic monitoring, and optimizing transportation logistics.
* Maintain accurate data entry in transportation management systems such as Oracle Transportation Management, ensuring all records are current and precise.
* Communicate effectively with drivers, healthcare facilities, and clients via phone calls and internal communication channels to confirm schedules, address issues, and relay important information.
* Ensure compliance with DOT regulations by monitoring driver hours, vehicle safety standards, and documentation requirements.
* Support shipping & receiving activities related to freight or supplies needed for transportation operations when applicable.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience with transportation planning, logistics, or fleet management is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of GIS, GPS technology, and transportation management systems like Oracle Transportation Management.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for documentation and reporting purposes.
* Outstanding communication skills with phone etiquette expertise for managing customer service interactions professionally.
* Ability to operate vehicle dispatch software and internal communication tools effectively.
* Familiarity with road transportation operations, shipping & receiving processes, and freight handling procedures.

jobs.desc:
**Join our team where Healthcare is reimagined!**

We are looking for a Front Office Manager to join our team. We are an established practice that is continually growing. Work with our well-respected group serving the community for many years. Whether starting your career or looking to share your knowledge with others, we are the place for you!

**What makes us different?**

While working at our Company, you will enjoy great perks, such as a great Monday thru Friday work schedule **(no weekends)**, an excellent benefits package, and PTO. We strive to maintain an environment where our employees can grow and further their skills and careers while being a part of a strong team.

**Responsibilities**:

* Overseeing the daily operations of the front office, including appointment scheduling, patient check-ins, patient registration, insurance verifications, and other patient services.
* Supervising and training front office staff, including, training, scheduling, and conducting performance evaluations for receptionist staff.
* Developing and implementing receptionist training programs, policies, and procedures to ensure optimal performance and productivity.
* Ensuring compliance with HIPAA privacy and security regulations, OSHA standards, and other medical practice-related protocols.
* Resolving patient complaints and addressing patient concerns promptly and effectively, while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor.
* Maintaining accurate patient records and ensuring completeness and accuracy of electronic health record (EHR) data.
* Coordinating with medical staff and other departments to ensure timely and smooth patient care services.
* Taking inventory, maintaining, and ordering front desk supplies and materials.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent. Some college coursework in medical coding, medical terminology, or business administration is preferred.
* At least 3-5 years of medical office experience, preferably in lead or supervisory roles.
* Excellent customer service skills and ability to communicate effectively with patients, staff, and physicians.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge of medical terminology, medical insurance policies, and billing procedures.
* Ability to operate medical office equipment and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and multitask while maintaining a positive attitude.
* Strong leadership skills and ability to work collaboratively with other departments.

***We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status.***

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Office Manager to oversee the daily operations of our busy office environment. * Previous experience in customer service or front desk roles demonstrating excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining attention to detail in clerical tasks such as proofreading and filing

jobs.desc:
**Job Description**

We have an exciting opportunity for an **Executive Assistant** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Rockville, Maryland office.

The Executive Assistant provides administrative support and assistance to the Vice President of Research and the Electrochemical Safety team. Working with minimal supervision, this role oversees complex calendar and travel management, coordinates meetings and events, develops detailed travel itineraries, and prepares sophisticated correspondence and briefing materials. The Executive Assistant also contributes to the development and administration of budgets, records, data, and other documents essential to operational and personnel-related processes. As a trusted administrative partner to executive leadership, this individual consistently demonstrates exceptional tact, integrity, and discretion

**UL Research Institutes:**

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Electrochemical Safety teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

**Electrochemical Safety Research Institute:**

The Electrochemical Safety Research Institute (ESRI) investigates the safety and performance limits of energy technologies. Through our discovery-driven research, we innovate, test, model, and lay the foundation for electrochemical energy storage that is both safe and reliable. Our scientific research helps everyone in the energy storage and battery value chain — from cell and battery manufacturers, suppliers, and original equipment manufacturers to recyclers, shippers, and consumers — understand and thereby help minimize the various safety risks associated with batteries in various applications, including electric vehicles and renewable energy storage systems.

Collaborating with a wide variety of partners to help meet the world’s energy safety needs, we disseminate information by convening a diverse group of stakeholders at events such as global battery summits and webinars to find data-driven solutions to new and emerging energy storage risks.

**What you’ll learn and achieve:**

As the Executive Assistant , you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

* Represents the Electrochemical Safety’s mission with professionalism while upholding absolute discretion and confidentiality.
* Supports high‑level, sensitive projects by preparing documentation, presentations, and related materials.
* Prepares, organizes, and maintains office records, statistics, and reports related to operations and personnel.
* Manages complex calendar and travel needs, including scheduling, coordinating, and adjusting meetings and itineraries.
* Serves as an administrative liaison across internal and external stakeholders on organizational matters.
* Drafts and prepares complex correspondence, memoranda, presentations, and briefing materials for leadership.
* Collects, synthesizes, and distributes meeting notes and follow‑up actions to relevant stakeholders.
* Develops supporting materials such as charts, graphs, and data summaries for executive projects.
* Assists with budget processes, including expense tracking, expense reports, and documentation management.
* Performs other duties as directed.

**What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:** We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

**The role**

Every great small company has one person who holds it together. The paychecks are right. The books make sense. The files are where they should be. Customers get a warm, clear answer about their bill. That's this role.

You'll be the heart of our office, working closely with the founder on the business side of Symplify: payroll, commissions, receivables and payables, HR paperwork, and an office that runs smoothly.

We run on modern, cloud-based tools, including QuickBooks Online, Gusto, HubSpot, Google Workspace and Slack, and we keep adding better ones as we grow. You don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be comfortable picking up new software quickly.

**What you'll do**

* Run payroll and commissions, accurately and on time.
* Manage receivables: follow up on open invoices and help customers through payment.
* Review and pay vendor and subcontractor bills.
* Handle HR paperwork, from onboarding to employee files.
* Keep QuickBooks Online accurate and up to date.
* Stay close to our project team so you always know where things stand.
* Keep the office organized, stocked and running.

**Why you'll like it here**

* A positive team with good energy. We work hard, keep it light, and look out for each other.
* A new office in Walnut Creek, right next to BART, with free parking.
* Monday to Friday, daytime hours, weekends off.
* Modern tools, so you're not fighting old systems.
* Real ownership of your work and a direct line to the founder.
* 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and paid sick leave.

**You might be our person if**

* People describe you as steady, warm and trustworthy.
* You take quiet pride in work done right, even when no one is checking.
* You notice the small detail that doesn't add up, and you don't let it go.
* You can be kind on the phone and still clear about what's owed.
* You finish what you start, and you speak up early when something needs attention.
* You'd rather leave a place better than you found it.

**What you bring**

* Experience managing an office.
* Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.
* Payroll experience, including commissions.
* Comfort with cloud-based software and a knack for learning new tools quickly.
* Discretion with confidential information.

**Nice to have**

* HR experience, ideally in California.

**Schedule**

1. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem.

3. Tell us about a software tool you learned recently. How did you get up to speed?

**About mBIOTA Labs**
---------------------

**We're on a mission to redefine gut health – and we need you.**

mBIOTA Labs is a clinically backed, women-owned and led medical nutrition company on a mission to transform how people think about - and treat - digestive health.

Our products sit at the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer experience. We build therapeutic, nutrition-based solutions that are rooted in clinical research, shaped by patient needs, and designed to fit into real lives.

We're a fast-growing startup, which means we move quickly and everyone pitches in. We're building a team of thoughtful, curious people who take pride in doing things well.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an organized, proactive Office Administrator to run our Santa Monica office day to day. This is a full-time, hourly, in-office role, reporting to the General Manager. You'll be expected to start a little before the rest of the team so the office is open and ready each morning.

You'll be the go-to person for how our office runs: the space, the building, the mail, deliveries and shipments, and the vendors who keep it all working. You'll also lend a hand with events and occasional errands across the Founder's broader business portfolio.

This is a hands-on role. Some days that means packing shipments or setting up for an event; others it's chasing a vendor or sorting out a building issue. We care about a space that's organized, welcoming, and ready for guests every day, and we want someone who takes pride in that.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Office Operations*

* Open the office each morning and keep the space tidy, welcoming, and ready for guests
* Welcome visitors, from healthcare providers to partners, and set up the conference room for meetings and video calls
* Keep the kitchen, bathrooms, and shared spaces stocked and organized, and order office and kitchen supplies as needed
* Be the first point of contact for office questions and requests from the team

*Office Systems & Admin*

* Be the go-to for everyday office tech: set up video calls and conference room screens, troubleshoot printers, computers, and Wi-Fi, and bring in our IT vendor when something needs more than a quick fix
* Help with office projects, such as new furniture, equipment, or layout changes, from order through setup
* Track office purchases, submit receipts, and keep office spending within budget
* Keep required workplace postings current, the first aid kit stocked, and emergency contacts up to date
* Maintain our office playbook, including vendor contacts and how-tos, so recurring work runs smoothly

*People & Team Support*

* Get new hires set up before day one, including desk, supplies, and key fob, so their first day runs smoothly
* Collect laptops, keys, fobs, and other company equipment during employee offboarding
* Plan small team moments, like birthdays, team lunches, and celebrations

*Building & Vendors*

* Serve as the main contact for building management
* Manage office key fobs: issue, track, and deactivate them as people join and leave
* Coordinate cleaners, repair people, and other service providers, and follow up until the job is done
* Become the office key holder and, once trained, manage the alarm system

*Mail, Shipping & Receiving*

* Check, sort, and route the mail daily, sending invoices, tax documents, and bank statements to appropriate leadership and flagging anything time-sensitive
* Receive deliveries and get them put away the same day
* Pack and ship PR, influencer, and sample boxes, and schedule carrier pickups
* Track the product samples kept in the office for sales and provider use
* Keep printed sales and event materials ready to go, including assembling folders and kits
* Assist with processing routine invoices

*Events & Errands*

* Help set up and break down for events, activations, and office gatherings
* Provide additional administrative support to the Founder and her personal a

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful **Office Manager & Executive Support professional** to take ownership of the day-to-day operations of our office while providing direct support to our CEO.

This is a hands-on, high-responsibility role for someone who knows how to run an office effectively, anticipates needs before they arise, and takes pride in keeping everything organized, efficient, and running smoothly. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thinks several steps ahead, takes initiative without waiting to be asked, and can confidently manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

In addition to overseeing all office operations and supporting the CEO, this individual will manage invoicing and billing processes and maintain accurate financial records using QuickBooks. We are looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, solutions-driven, and willing to jump in wherever needed. **No task is too small, and no responsibility is overlooked.**

The right person will be a trusted partner to leadership and a key contributor to the overall efficiency and success of the business.

* Manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

* Proven experience successfully managing and running an office with minimal supervision.

**Success in this role means keeping the office running seamlessly, the CEO well-supported, and invoicing and billing accurate, organized, and up to date.**

**Job Title:** Startup Operations Coordinator & Executive Admin  
**Location:** Corona, CA / On-site or Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Part to Full Time  
**Reports To:** Founder & CEO

About the Role:

As a early-stage startup, we move fast, build on the fly, and wear many hats—and we need an operational powerhouse to keep our foundation rock-solid.

We are looking for a high-energy, versatile **Operations Coordinator & Executive Admin** who thrives in a dynamic, unstructured environment. In this role, you will be the glue holding our operations together: handling financial transactions, managing office inventory, keeping the CEO on track, and serving as the primary logistics bridge between our field installation team and our customers.

If you are a resourceful self-starter who loves solving multi-faceted problems, staying organized amidst growth, and stepping up whenever a new challenge arises, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

**Startup Operations & Accounts Payable**

* Manage vendor relationships, process accounts payable, track receipts, and ensure timely vendor payments.
* Keep the business stocked by managing inventory, ordering tools/supplies, and finding cost-effective suppliers.
* Build and refine basic operational processes to help the company scale efficiently.

**Logistics, Customer & Field Coordination**

* Own the full installation lifecycle: schedule appointments, dispatch the installation team, and communicate directly with customers.
* Ensure installation crews have all relevant job details, address maps, client preferences, and physical equipment before heading to a job site.
* Serve as the main point of contact for customer inquiries, appointment reminders, and post-installation satisfaction checks.

**CEO Support & Schedule Management**

* Maintain work schedules and shift assignments for team members.
* Provide direct support to the CEO—managing calendar priorities, handling client correspondence, coordinating travel, and keeping key projects on track.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc projects and step in to fill operational gaps as new startup needs arise ("wearing many hats").

Who You Are

* **Adaptable & Resourceful:** You don't wait for a manual—you figure things out, create solutions, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* **Master Organizer:** You can juggle vendor invoices, field schedules, executive calendars, and customer calls without letting details slip through the cracks.
* **Proactive Communicator:** You give clear, concise updates to internal teams and external customers alike.
* **Tech-Savvy:** Quick to learn new SaaS tools, CRMs, scheduling platforms, and accounting tools (e.g., QuickBooks, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion).

Qualifications

* 2+ years of experience in office administration, operations coordination, customer support, or executive assistance (startup or small-business experience is a major plus).
* Proven track record managing schedules, basic logistics, or inventory/vendor operations.
* Familiarity with basic invoice processing and bookkeeping workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first attitude.

Why Join Us?

* **High Impact:** You will work directly with the leadership team and play a vital role in shaping how our company operates and grows.
* **Broad Exposure:** Perfect role for someone wanting cross-functional experience in finance, operations, customer relations, and executive leadership.
* **Competitive Compensation & Perks:** [$35 / hr., flexible PTO, and growth opportunities as the team expands.

Pay: $30.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Corona, CA 92881

Stalwart Law Group, a highly respected boutique civil litigation firm, specializing in the representation of injured victims, is seeking a full-time Office Coordinator. This is an onsite position in our Santa Ana office.

The Office Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administrative and operational support of the law firm. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable individual who can manage multiple responsibilities while maintaining a professional office environment and handling confidential information with discretion.

The Office Coordinator will support the firm as needed including:

· **Mail Management:** Process, organize, and distribute all incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries.

· **Facilities and Vendor Management:** Coordinate maintenance, repairs, cleaning services, and other vendor services; schedule service visits and follow up on outstanding requests.

· **Reception and Administrative Support:** Greet visitors, answer and route calls, and provide general administrative support to attorneys and staff as needed.

Prior experience in an administrative, receptionist, or office coordination role is required, ideally in a law firm or professional services environment. The successful candidate will have strong organizational skills, attention to detail, professional communication skills, proficiency with standard office software, and the ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

The Office Coordinator is expected to maintain a professional and organized workplace, complete assigned tasks accurately and promptly, and provide reliable support to the firm’s attorneys and staff. Additional administrative duties may be assigned as needed.

jobs.desc:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9:30AM-6PM (can be flexible anytime 8AM-7PM)
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
Building on this mission, the Prototypes Housing, a program of HealthRIGHT 360, provides housing and case management services for women and women with children across Los Angeles County through three core programs that support clients along the housing continuum. Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) offers short-term, recovery-focused interim housing for unhoused adults and perinatal women engaged in outpatient substance use treatment, emphasizing life skills development within a 90-day period to promote long-term stability. The Bridge Housing program serves individuals with behavioral health needs who are experiencing homelessness by providing interim housing and supportive services until they secure permanent placement. The Continuum of Care (COC), funded through LAHSA, delivers permanent housing solutions focused on sustained stability for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Across all programs, Prototypes provides comprehensive case management, including assessments, individualized service planning, resource linkage, and ongoing support to help clients achieve lasting recovery and housing stability.
  
  
Aligned with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission to advance health equity and the Prototypes Housing continuum serving women and families across Los Angeles County, the Administrative Coordinator supports daily operations that ensure safe, stable housing by maintaining housing readiness, tracking client census and bed availability, coordinating unit turnover, and managing maintenance requests. This role also supports administrative functions by maintaining documentation systems, managing workflows and supply levels, and coordinating communication across multidisciplinary teams to support efficient service delivery and positive client housing outcomes in alignment with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission and values.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Housing Operations Support
  

* Maintain daily client census and track bed availability to support admissions and program flow.
* Ensure unit readiness by coordinating room turnover, cleanliness, and appropriate housing conditions.
* Submit and track maintenance requests; follow up to ensure timely completion of repairs. This may include traveling to off-site RBH locations in Pomona.
* Collaborate with supervisors and managers to optimize housing utilization and client placement.
* Maintain inventory of housing supplies including toiletries, linens, and bedding.
* Monitor supply levels and coordinate replenishment to ensure consistent availability for clients.
* Organize and manage storage areas to ensure accessibility and efficiency.
* Transport clients if necessary.

Office Support
  

* Maintain office organization, including filing systems and administrative processes.
* Support overall office efficiency by coordinating tasks and improving workflow systems.
* Assist with docume
