jobs.title: Billing Specialist
jobs.desc:
Description:

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Turns documented FSP-HFW services into accurate, timely Medi-Cal claims and County invoices, then follows each claim until it is paid. Billing Specialists enter billing data separately from the clinicians and direct service staff who provide and document the services. Turns documented FSP-HFW services into accurate, timely Medi-Cal claims and County invoices, then follows each claim until it is paid. Billing Specialists enter billing data separately from the clinicians and direct service staff who provide and document the services.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* When a referral comes in, obtain the IRIS referral documents and give them to the Intake Specialist: client history by MRN, Medi-Cal eligibility, Special Cohort status, and the current status of the CANS and PSC-35.
* Check Medi-Cal eligibility and other insurance at intake and every month. Flag clients whose coverage has lapsed or changed.
* Create the client intake profile in IRIS, including the Special Cohort designation when it applies.
* Enter CANS and PSC-35 results in IRIS.
* Update client demographics in IRIS whenever they change while the client is enrolled.
* Review services entered in the EHR for billing completeness (codes, units, dates, rendering provider NPI, location) before claims go out.
* Enter and submit claims through the County billing system (IRIS) and the 837 claim files.
* Work the denial and rejection queues: find the cause, send corrections back to staff when needed, and resubmit claims on time.
* Correct any service billed by mistake within 10 calendar days of finding it, as Exhibit A requires.
* Post payments and remittances (835s), reconcile them to submitted claims, and track accounts receivable by age.
* Help prepare the monthly County invoice, due on the 20th, along with its backup.
* Complete Coordination of Benefits before billing Medi-Cal.
* When a client leaves the program, discharge them in IRIS and close the episode of care (EOC) on time.
* Keep the rendering-provider list current: new hires' NPIs, credentials, and taxonomy. Report NPIs to the County as soon as staff receive them.
* Keep billing records in a form ready for audit and retention: claims, remittances, invoices, and supporting time records.
* Use only the IRIS token assigned to you, and return it when you leave or no longer need access.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. An associate degree or a medical billing certificate is preferred.
* At least 2 years of healthcare claims billing, preferably Medi-Cal or County behavioral health (SMHS).
* Familiarity with CPT and HCPCS codes, CMS-1500 and 837P claims, eligibility verification, and reading 835 remittances.
* Strong attention to detail, intermediate Excel skills, and experience working in an EHR, with myEvolv (Netsmart) experience strongly preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPB or CMRS certification.
* Experience with Orange County HCA's IRIS system.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish or English/Vietnamese) for eligibility follow-up with families.

**Required Trainings**

County BHS New User Training (required for anyone who enters data in the County billing system), Annual Provider Training, Annual Compliance Training, and HIPAA/42 CFR Part 2 training.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to drive a motor vehicle without restrictions, often in heavy traffic and frequently long distances (one hour or more).
* Senses of vision, hearing and smell sufficient to regularly operate a motor vehicle, to visualize threats in the environment and operate safely.
* Required to occasionally lift and carry 10-20 pounds.
* Regularly required to sit, stand, climb stairs (1 or more flights) and walk.
* Regularly required to sit and use computer in office settings.

**EOE, INCLUDING DISABILITY/VETS**

We are looking to add an **Accounting & Payroll Specialist** to our Accounting and Finance team. This is a great opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional to gain broad experience and grow with us. A successful candidate will possess strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and a commitment to follow-up, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment.

The Accounting & Payroll Specialist will support a variety of accounting and operational functions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll administration, benefits billing reconciliation, employee expense reimbursements, and general accounting support. This role will work closely with Finance and Human Resources to ensure accurate and timely processing of financial transactions.

**Responsibilities:**

* Process full-cycle accounts payable, including receipt and review of incoming invoices for appropriate documentation, coding invoices in NetSuite, and obtaining timely approvals.
* Prepare and process invoices for services rendered and ensure timely posting of customer payments within NetSuite.
* Audit and process company credit card expenses and employee expense reimbursements in a timely manner.
* Reconcile vendor statements, investigate account discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Identify and resolve outstanding accounts receivable items by reviewing aging reports, researching delinquent accounts, communicating with internal and external customers, and following through to support timely payment.
* Provide invoice and payment resolution assistance to vendors and internal company personnel while acting as a liaison between departments and vendors.
* Manage vendor and customer setup, including collecting and maintaining applicable tax documentation.
* Maintain necessary tracking within NetSuite to support applicable tax filings, including 1099s.
* Process bi-weekly payroll for approximately 75 employees using Paylocity, ensuring employee earnings, deductions, taxes, benefits, reimbursements, and other payroll changes are accurate.
* Review payroll information, research discrepancies, maintain supporting documentation, and assist with payroll reporting, audits, and year-end activities.
* Reconcile monthly benefit carrier invoices against enrollment records and payroll deductions, and research and resolve billing discrepancies.
* Review and process employee reimbursements, including wellness, home office, parking, tuition, vacation incentive, and other one-time payments.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close activities through reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Respond to information requests and assist with internal and external audits.
* Proactively improve operational efficiency and effectiveness by streamlining daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual processes.
* Maintain documentation for existing processes and document procedures for new processes.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree, or equivalent experience, in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, bookkeeping, or accounting operations.
* Experience processing payroll and handling confidential employee and financial information.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, cash management, and financial controls.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced and changing environment.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience processing payroll in Paylocity.
* Experience with benefits billing recon

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.desc:
**About the Role:**

The Payroll Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring accurate and timely processing of employee compensation within the organization. This position is responsible for managing the end-to-end payroll process, including calculating wages, deductions, and taxes in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations. The Payroll Specialist will maintain payroll records, reconcile payroll accounts, and collaborate with HR and finance teams to resolve discrepancies. A key outcome of this role is to guarantee that all employees are paid correctly and on schedule, while adhering to company policies and legal requirements. Additionally, the Payroll Specialist will support audits and reporting activities to provide transparency and accuracy in payroll operations.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Proven experience as a Payroll Specialist or in a similar payroll processing role.
* Strong knowledge of payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements in the United States.
* Proficiency in payroll systems and software, specifically Ultipro and PeopleSoft.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in handling payroll data.
* Ability to manage confidential information with integrity and discretion.

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years of payroll experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in payroll management such as Certified Payroll Professional (CPP).
* Experience working in a multi-state payroll environment.
* Familiarity with additional payroll software platforms and HRIS systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.
* Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with employees and cross-functional teams.

**Responsibilities:**

* Process payroll accurately and on time using payroll software such as Ultipro and PeopleSoft.
* Calculate and withhold appropriate payroll taxes, including federal, state, and local taxes, ensuring compliance with all regulations.
* Maintain and update payroll records, including employee information, tax data, and benefits deductions.
* Reconcile payroll accounts and resolve discrepancies by collaborating with HR, finance, and other departments.
* Prepare and submit payroll tax filings and reports to relevant government agencies in a timely manner.
* Respond to employee inquiries regarding payroll issues and provide clear explanations and resolutions.
* Assist with internal and external payroll audits by providing necessary documentation and reports.
* Continuously review and improve payroll processes to enhance accuracy and efficiency.

**Skills:**

The Payroll Specialist utilizes their expertise in payroll tax regulations and payroll processes daily to ensure compliance and accuracy in employee compensation. Proficiency with payroll software like Ultipro and PeopleSoft enables efficient processing and management of payroll data. Strong organizational skills are essential for maintaining detailed payroll records and reconciling accounts. Effective communication skills are used to address employee inquiries and collaborate with HR and finance teams to resolve issues. Additionally, analytical skills support the identification of discrepancies and continuous improvement of payroll operations.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist-Arcata- Closes 10/27/2026
jobs.desc:
**Payroll Specialist-Arcata- Closes 10/27/2026**

**SUMMARY:**

This position is located with the United Indian Health Services, Inc., Fiscal Division-Fiscal Services Section. The primary

purpose of this position is to perform advanced tasks related to processing employee payroll and maintaining related

internal and external reporting.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Under the direction of the Fiscal Controller and Assistant Fiscal Controller assume responsibility for accurately

maintaining payroll information by collecting, calculating, and entering data.

* Updates payroll records by entering changes in exemptions, insurance coverage, other deductions, and job title and

department/division transfers.

* Prepares reports by compiling summaries of earnings, taxes, deductions, leave, disability, and nontaxable wages.
* Utilizing the human resource information system prepares demographic, benefits, recruiting and other reporting at

the direction of Human Resources Section.

* Supports overall organizational budgeting process by reporting on staffing costs and employee status.
* Determines payroll liabilities by calculating employee federal and state income and social security taxes and

employer's social security, unemployment, and workers compensation payments.

* Resolves payroll discrepancies by collecting and analyzing information.
* Provides payroll information as directed by preparing reports and answering questions and requests.
* Maintains payroll operations by following policies and procedures and identifying needed changes.
* Maintains and protects employee records and payroll operations by strict compliance with confidentiality policies.
* Maintains currency with applicable accreditation and compliance standards, rules and regulations and participates in

quality improvement activities.

* Assists in monthly accounting processing and closings.
* Plans and implements the successive steps and problem solves in response to minor deviations in the work

assignments in accordance with instructions and UIHS policies and procedures.

* Attends staff meeting and other meetings as assigned.
* Must be willing to learn more about the American Indian culture and attend at least one Cultural

Presentation/Training per year.

* Must be willing to work with American Indian/Alaska Native people and demonstrate cultural awareness and

humility

* Must be willing to deliver services in a culturally responsive manner.
* Adheres to accreditation and compliance standards/guideline
* Other duties may be assigned.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty

satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable

accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. All individuals

must demonstrate a commitment to the provision of culturally sensitive counseling services to American Indians.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:** Educational degrees must be from a US Department of Education accredited school

* Associate's degree (A.A.) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school; and two or more years related

experience and/or training; or

* High School Diploma or equivalent, and at least four (4) years current experience in all stated areas of the payroll

processing cycle; and,

* Must be knowledgeable and proficient in the use of ADP/Workforce or similar payroll processing and reporting

systems.

**COMPUTER OPERATIONS:**

* Proficient personal computer skills including electronic mail, record keeping, routine database activity, word

processing, spreadsheet, graphics, etc.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or

governmental regulations.

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator (Estimating and Job Costing)
jobs.desc:
**About our Company**

Woman-owned dirt-work and pipeline contractor in the Central Valley. We do grade and earthwork, billed by the yard and sometimes by the hour on tractors and scrapers, and irrigation and pond pipeline work. We are small. The owner still bids, runs jobs, and makes the decisions. This person takes over the desk, so jobs get estimated, tracked, billed, and costed without things sitting in a pile.

**What you will do:**

* Build and track estimates in QuickBooks and Excel for dirt work (quantities, haul, equipment hours, yardage) and pipeline (pipe, fittings, structures, labor, equipment).
* Turn field tickets, material invoices, and sub bills into job costs.
* Enter and reconcile jobs in QuickBooks Desktop and Excel. Code costs to the right job. Produce invoices from the estimate or from time-and-material tickets.
* Track active jobs: percent complete, change orders, what has been billed, what is still owed, and what the job is making.
* Follow up on past-due invoices.
* Keep vendor and customer files, lien releases, and job folders in order.
* Prepare simple job-cost and cash reports for the owner each week.
* Answer calls, schedule material deliveries, and coordinate with operators and subcontractors.
* Occasional site visits to confirm quantities or pick up tickets.

**What you need:**

* Solid QuickBooks Desktop. Construction or job-costing use is a plus. We are not on QuickBooks Online.
* Strong Excel: formulas, lookups, and clean tracking sheets. Not just data entry. You may need to build an Excel book to track jobs if the one we have is not adequate.
* At least two years in a construction office, bookkeeping, estimating support, or project admin role.
* Comfort with numbers, deadlines, and messy field paperwork.
* Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license.
* Able to work on-site in Hanford during business hours.

**Helpful, not required:**

* Dirt, grading, underground, irrigation, or agricultural construction.
* Reading plans enough to do a basic quantity takeoff.
* Progress billing and retention.
* Certified payroll or prevailing wage exposure. Some of our work is public.

**How we work:**

You will be trained on our sheets, our unit prices, and how we bill. The owner reviews estimates before they go out for the first several months. After that, the goal is for you to run estimating support, billing, and job costing with the owner checking the big items, not rebuilding every spreadsheet unless sheets are not adequate to perform the tasks required. This is a hands-on office role in a small company. You will not have a department under you. You will have direct access to the owner and real responsibility.

**To apply:**

Send a resume and a short note on the construction software you have used, especially QuickBooks Desktop and Excel. Tell us whether you have done estimating, billing, job costing, or all three. If resume does not meet requirements, it will not be considered.

**\*Pay is negotiable, depending on experience.\***

Pay: $24.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

Application Question(s):

* Have you ever been a project manager for construction?
* What type of estimating do you have experience with?
* What type of programs have you used? Example: Excel, Quickbooks, etc.

Work Location: In person

Every propane delivery keeps a home warm, a farm running, or a business operating without interruption. As a Dispatch Coordinator at Dassel's Energy, you’ll be the nerve center that turns planning into dependability—making sure drivers, routes, and customers stay aligned so service happens safely, efficiently, and on time. Your decisions directly impact customer trust and day‑to‑day operational reliability across multiple states.

#### **What You’ll Do**

You’ll coordinate propane deliveries for residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers, translating demand into clear, executable routes for drivers. This role works closely with drivers, customer service, sales, and operations to keep deliveries moving smoothly—even when weather, demand spikes, or last‑minute changes arise.

Success in this role means drivers leave each morning with optimized routes, customers know when to expect service, and operational data is accurate enough to spot issues before they become problems.

#### **What You’ll Actually Do in Your First 30 Days**

* Learn the dispatch software, delivery workflows, and safety protocols while shadowing experienced dispatchers
* Begin scheduling and adjusting delivery routes for a defined territory with oversight
* Communicate directly with drivers to handle routine updates, delays, and route changes
* Work with customer service to resolve delivery questions and document outcomes accurately

#### **What Success Looks Like in 90 Days**

* Independently manage daily dispatch for assigned routes with minimal escalations
* Optimize delivery schedules to reduce missed stops, re-routes, and overtime
* Maintain real-time delivery visibility and accurate dispatch records
* Consistently follow safety and regulatory requirements without reminders

#### **Must Have**

* Prior experience dispatching deliveries or coordinating routes in a regulated logistics or fuel environment
* Working knowledge of fuel distribution safety requirements and compliance standards
* Ability to manage multiple delivery priorities at once without losing accuracy
* Comfort working daily with dispatch software and Microsoft Office tools
* Clear, direct communication skills with drivers and internal teams

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in propane, fuel, or energy distribution
* Familiarity with optimizing routes using delivery performance data
* Prior collaboration with customer service or operations teams
* Experience supporting both rural and metropolitan delivery areas

**Pay:** $25-30 per hour (based on experience)

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) with company match

* Company-paid $50,000 life/AD&D insurance

We believe people do their best work when they’re supported, respected, and trusted to do the job right. Our teams value safety, accountability, and showing up for one another because that’s how we show up for our customers.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.desc:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Bookkeeper to join our dynamic finance team. In this vital role, you will manage day-to-day financial transactions, maintain accurate records, and ensure compliance with accounting standards. Your expertise will help support our organization’s financial health, providing clarity through precise bookkeeping and financial reporting. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to both corporate and non-profit accounting environments, utilizing leading accounting software and systems to streamline processes and enhance accuracy.

**Responsibilities**

* Record all financial transactions using Quickbooks.
* Perform bank reconciliations regularly to ensure consistency between bank statements and ledger entries.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, including invoice processing and payment tracking.
* Prepare journal entries for various financial activities, ensuring accuracy in debits & credits in accordance with GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles).
* Reconcile general ledger accounts and perform balance sheet reconciliations to maintain precise financial records.
* Process payroll accurately, including tax calculations and deductions, while ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
* Assist in financial report writing, budgeting, and analyzing account activity for internal review or external audits.
* Support governmental accounting requirements and non-profit accounting standards when applicable.
* Conduct account analysis and account reconciliation tasks to identify discrepancies or errors promptly.
* Maintain meticulous records of all bookkeeping activities, ensuring data integrity across all platforms.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience as a Bookkeeper or in a similar accounting role with a strong understanding of double entry bookkeeping principles.
* Proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks (including QuickBooks Online), Xero, Sage, or similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of GAAP standards, governmental accounting practices (if applicable), and non-profit accounting procedures.
* Experience with payroll processing, account reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and journal entries.
* Familiarity with financial concepts including debits & credits, general ledger accounting, account analysis, and balance sheet reconciliation.
* Excellent skills in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) for data analysis and reporting purposes.
* Ability to handle high-volume data entry with 10-key typing skills while maintaining accuracy.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail; ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.
* Knowledge of technical accounting practices related to governmental or nonprofit sectors is a plus.

Join us if you’re passionate about maintaining precise financial records that drive organizational success! Your expertise will be instrumental in supporting our mission through diligent bookkeeping practices that uphold the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About the Role**

We're looking for a detail-oriented professional who takes pride in accurate work, enjoys supporting employees, and thrives in a role where no two days are exactly the same.

As our HR & Payroll Administrator, you'll support employee onboarding, payroll processing, and a variety of human resources functions. You'll play an important role in helping ensure our HR and payroll processes are accurate, efficient, and responsive to employee needs.

The ideal candidate enjoys balancing a variety of responsibilities, stays organized, catches the details others may miss, and takes pride in providing exceptional service to employees and managers. You'll be successful in this role if you're comfortable managing multiple priorities, handling confidential information with discretion, and building strong working relationships across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Human Resources Administration**

* Coordinate new hire onboarding activities and ensure required documentation is completed.
* Enter and maintain employee information within HR, payroll, benefits, and related systems.
* Process employee status changes, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, and terminations.
* Maintain employee personnel records and electronic files.
* Assist employees with HR and payroll related questions.
* Support benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, and open enrollment activities.
* Assist with employment verifications, audits, reporting, and compliance-related activities.
* Provide administrative support for HR projects, training programs, and department initiatives.
* Perform other payroll and HR duties as assigned.

**Payroll Administration**

* Process weekly and semi-monthly payrolls accurately and on time.
* Review and audit timecards, payroll records, deductions, and other payroll data for accuracy.
* Enter and maintain employee payroll information, including pay rate changes, tax elections, direct deposits, and deductions.
* Research and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee inquiries.
* Assist with payroll audits, reconciliations, reporting, and year-end payroll activities.
* Maintain union wage rates, fringe benefit rates, deductions, and other collectively bargained payroll requirements.
* Support compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations.
* Assist with payroll system maintenance and process improvements.

**What Will Help You Succeed?**

Successful candidates will bring a combination of the following skills, experience, and attributes:

* Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Two to five years of payroll, HR administration, or related experience preferred.
* Experience processing payroll and maintaining employee records.
* Multi-state and/or union payroll experience preferred.
* Experience with ADP Workforce Now, Spectrum, COINS, or similar HR/payroll systems preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with discretion.

**About Us**

We are a growing organization serving the construction and mechanical contracting industries, with operations across multiple locations and business units. Our HR and Payroll team plays an important role in supporting employees and helping the business operate effectively. We value responsiveness, accuracy, collaboration, and a practical approach to solving problems.

jobs.title: Sales and Administrative Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**The Role**

We’re looking for an organized, detail-oriented Sales and Administrative Coordinator to support our sales efforts and keep daily operations running smoothly. You’ll work directly with our Managing Partners to prepare proposals and keep deals moving, while also handling billing, the front desk, and the office tasks that keep our team on track.

This is a great fit for someone who likes variety, enjoys working with people, and wants to learn the business side of a growing technology company. No IT background is required.

**What You’ll Do**

**Sales Support**

* Support our Managing Partners with sales activities, including preparing proposals, quotes, and client
* presentations
* Gather pricing, licensing, and hardware details from our service team and vendors to build accurate proposals
* Keep our CRM up to date by logging activity, tracking opportunities, and managing follow-up tasks
* Schedule sales meetings and client appointments, and send timely follow-ups
* Prepare contracts and agreements for signature and help hand off new clients to our onboarding team
* Help create and update sales and marketing materials

**Front Desk and Communication**

* Answer and route incoming phone calls, take messages, and greet visitors
* Serve as a friendly, professional first point of contact for clients and vendors
* Check, sort, and distribute incoming mail and handle outgoing mail

**Billing and Accounts Receivable**

* Monitor the billing email inbox and respond to or route client billing questions
* Send client invoices and follow up on outstanding balances with AR reminders
* Deposit checks and record payments accurately
* Keep billing records and documentation organized

**Administrative and Office Operations**

* Assist our Managing Partners with scheduling, calendar management, correspondence, and document
* preparation
* Make purchases for the office and business, track orders, and keep receipts organized
* Monitor and restock office supplies
* Maintain organized digital files in Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
* Help document and maintain internal processes and procedures
* Assist with new hire onboarding paperwork
* Handle general office tasks and special projects as needed

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ years in sales support, administrative, or office coordination roles
* Experience preparing proposals, quotes, or other professional business documents
* Strong writing skills and attention to detail, especially with numbers, pricing, and financial records
* Organized and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
* Clear, professional communication by phone, email, and in person
* Comfortable with Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Trustworthy and discreet with confidential client, financial, and business information
* Reliable and self-directed, with the confidence to ask questions when something is unclear

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, or QuickBooks
* Experience in an IT, MSP, or B2B services company

**Schedule and Location**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
* On-site at 441 Colorado Ave, Grand Junction, CO 81501

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $18.50 per hour
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid sick leave under Colorado’s Healthy Families and Workplaces Act
* Paid family and medical leave through Colorado FAMLI

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Office Manager to lead the daily operations of our busy office environment. This role is essential in ensuring smooth administrative workflows, maintaining efficient office procedures, and providing exceptional support to staff and clients alike. The ideal candidate will possess strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and a proactive attitude to foster a productive and welcoming workplace. As Office Manager, you will oversee administrative functions, manage office supplies, coordinate schedules, and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a vibrant team dedicated to excellence and efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage front desk operations, including greeting visitors, answering multi-line phone systems, and directing calls with professional phone etiquette.
* Oversee office management tasks such as filing, data entry, maintaining spreadsheets, and organizing documents to ensure accuracy and accessibility.
* Coordinate calendar management and schedule appointments for staff members using productivity software like Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Handle bookkeeping responsibilities utilizing QuickBooks or similar accounting software to assist with invoicing, expense tracking, and basic bookkeeping tasks.
* Provide exceptional customer service by supporting client communication efforts through phone support and email correspondence.
* Maintain office supplies inventory, order necessary materials, and ensure the workspace remains organized and efficient.
* Assist with clerical duties including proofreading documents, word processing, and managing personal assistant tasks as needed.
* Support team members with technical proficiency in computer skills, spreadsheets, data entry, and office software to enhance overall productivity.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in office management or administrative roles with a strong background in clerical work and customer support.
* Familiarity with multi-line phone systems, calendar management tools, and productivity software such as Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) and Google Workspace.
* Demonstrated ability to handle bookkeeping tasks using QuickBooks or similar financial management software.
* Bilingual abilities are highly desirable to effectively communicate with diverse clients and team members.
* Excellent organizational skills with a keen eye for detail in data entry, proofreading, filing, and document management.
* Prior experience in front desk operations or personal assistant roles is preferred.
* Strong computer literacy across various platforms coupled with technical proficiency in office equipment and software solutions.

Join us as an Office Manager where your organizational prowess will keep our operations running seamlessly! Bring your enthusiasm for efficient office management combined with your technical skills to create a positive impact every day!

Pay: From $17.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Service Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**About Abode:**

When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

At Abode, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths.

**Housing Ends Homelessness**

**Our Mission:**

Abode works to end homelessness by assisting low-income, unhoused people, including those with special needs, to secure stable, supportive housing; and to be advocates for the removal of the causes of homelessness.

**Our Values:**

* Start with Dignity
* Take Smart Risks
* Be transparent
* Solve for today and tomorrow
* Spark each other’s strengths

**About The Role**:

The Service Coordinator is responsible for the provision of housing services to individuals who are homeless. The Services Coordinator provides a variety of services to increase housing stability including counseling, referral to financial/credit counseling, referral to legal services, and developing an individualized housing plan that includes a path to permanent housing stability, subsequent to financial assistance. This position is also responsible for service coordination to ensure that participants are connected to other necessary supportive services.

**How You Make An Impact**:

* Provision of comprehensive housing services to participants, which may include working directly with landlords
* Working closely with other social service partners referring and providing services to participants.
* Coordination of services for program participants to ensure that participants are receiving essential services to increase health and housing outcomes.
* Assist residents in retaining housing and maximizing their independence and self-sufficiency by providing linkages to appropriate community services such as crisis intervention, rehab, income support and benefits acquisition, employment assistance, primary physical and mental health, substance recovery and family involvement.
* Provide referrals for further assessment/treatment services for any areas of concern, such as developmental, learning disabilities, behavioral/healthcare needs, school readiness and exposure to drug, alcohol abuse and family violence within the household.
* Create and maintain an Individual service plan and needs assessment for each household.
* Meet with the household in person, either in the community or within the home as frequently as needed.
* Attend program meetings with internal and external partners to coordinate services and ensure quality services.
* Maintain client files, including all necessary documentation.
* Communicate closely and frequently with all members of the team to improve systems, solve problems, share resources, and coordinate work.
* Must be able to document services in a timely manner, using BIRP format.
* Attend staff meetings and other agency functions as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field or equivalent field experience.
* 2 years case management experience providing services to homeless or low-income individuals and/or families.
* Driving and transportation of participants when required.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of valid California Driver's License and current auto insurance, along with a clean DMV record, is required.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.

COMPETENCIES:

* Excellent verbal & written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaborative

jobs.desc:

**RESPONSIBLE TO:** Manager, Home Delivered Meals (HDM) Client Waitlist & Communications

**STATUS:** Non-exempt, Full Time, M-F 8:00am-4:30pm

**PROGRAM ADDRESS:** 2142 Jerrold Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94124

**MISSION:**

Meals on Wheels of San Francisco provides a network of services that allows seniors to live in their homes with dignity and independence as long as possible.

**ABOUT MOWSF:**

MOWSF is committed to the belief that all seniors have the right to live independently with dignity and respect in their own homes, for as long as safely possible. It is our mission to provide isolated homebound seniors in San Francisco with nutritious meals, daily human contact, and supportive services to prevent their premature institutionalization.

**Position Summary:**

The Client Services Administrative Coordinator provides client communication, administrative, and operational support across assigned MOWSF programs, supporting Home-Delivered Meals (HDM). This position serves as a point of contact for clients, caregivers, drivers, staff, and community partners; coordinates service inquiries, provides timely follow-up; and maintains accurate client information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

The coordinator assists with service changes, delivery questions, documentation, and cross-department communication and issues Drivers encounter during deliveries. Depending on program needs, assignments may include client intake, Safety Board support, driver communications and delivery coordination, spreadsheets, and other administrative activities. The position requires dependability, sound judgment, creative problem-solving, calm demeanor, attention to detail, and the ability to balance phone coverage with deadline-driven work. The coordinator must demonstrate initiative, independently assess situations, identify solutions, and effectively utilize available resources and team collaboration to resolve issues.

* Provide accurate information about program services, meal deliveries, estimated delivery arrival times (ETAs), delivery schedules, and applicable procedures.
* Document and help resolve delivery complaints, missed deliveries, service questions, and client requests; driver issues, follow established scripts and escalation protocols.
* Route time-sensitive or specialized concerns to the Social Worker of the Day, operations, other program staff, or appropriate internal departments, including Human Resources for staff-related matters.
* Use respectful communication and de-escalation skills when assisting individuals with complex or sensitive concerns.

***Client Records & Administrative Coordination***

* Enter, review, and update client information and service requests in Salesforce and other approved systems, maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.
* Process or coordinate temporary suspensions, restarts, cancellations, disenrollments, delivery schedule changes, and other authorized service updates.
* Monitor assigned email inboxes and task queues, track follow-up needs, and complete assigned work within established timelines. Prepare, save, organize, and send professional emails, client notices, letters, spreadsheets, reports, and electronic documents.
* Maintain data logs and spreadsheets, support data entry and quality checks, and assist with reporting or special projects.

***Delivery & Safety Operations Support***

* Communicate with delivery drivers and operations staff to relay client instructions, clarify delivery concerns, and coordinate follow-up.

jobs.title: Clinical Office Assistant (Temporary full time)
jobs.desc:
**Who we are****:** La Clínica de La Raza is a community-based health center committed to providing culturally appropriate, high-quality, and accessible health care to the diverse communities of the San Francisco Bay Area. We have spent over 40 years advocating for and creating a health-home for the many that have been denied access to care. As health care activists, we are dedicated to ensuring that individuals who do not have healthcare coverage receive the same quality healthcare as those who do. From our genesis as a community health center in 1971, we understood that we cannot heal our communities without also addressing the economic and social factors that affect health. Many times, this requires that we go outside and provide services in other settings that link individuals to our health center for preventive and primary care. Over 90,000 individuals come to La Clínica because it is a welcoming place that addresses the whole person, coordinating and connecting them to a broad network of services to improve and maintain their health and well-being. While we are still known for our activism and spirit of social justice, we are also proud to have grown into a sophisticated provider of primary health care services with 35 sites across Alameda, Contra Costa and Solano counties.

  

**Who you are****:** We are looking for Clinical Office Assistants who are inspired to deliver a great experience to our patients and who want to play an important role in patient-centered care. Clinical Office Assistants are the first face and point of contact with our patients. You will be challenged to be an efficient task-master while at the same time providing a human touch and an excellent overall patient experience. Many people excel in one of these areas, but it takes someone with a special combination of skills and character to do both. To be successful, you need to enjoy interacting with people from diverse backgrounds, to feel energized by a fast-paced clinic environment, and remain cool under pressure even when serving a person who is upset, disrespectful, or impatient. You should have a successful history of being responsible, reliable and capable of solving problems while being friendly and helpful in seeking ways to support other care team members.

  

**Major Areas of Responsibility include but are not limited to:**

**Customer Service**

* Greet visitors, ascertain purpose of visit, and register patients in the appropriate electronic system.
* Determine source of payment by verifying program eligibility in government or insurance plans.
* Collect payment for services rendered, operate cash register, and maintain an accurate till.
* Hear and resolve patient complaints or escalate appropriately.
* Participate in problem-solving to assure targets for revenue and customer satisfaction are met.
* Answer telephone inquiries and provide information or route incoming telephone calls to the appropriate person or department.
* Schedule, confirm, and process appointments.

  

**General Office Duties**

* Perform general office duties such as sorting mail, filing and photocopying.
* Receive and route messages or documents, such as laboratory results, to appropriate staff.
* Retrieve and enter data into medical records system.
* Assist patients in completing forms.
* Operate standard office equipment including computer, calculator, fax and copy machines.
* Screen and monitor requests, completing or routing as assigned.
* Inventory stock, order, and verify receipt of medical, lab, or office supplies or equipment.
* Perform record keeping duties as required.
  

**Commitment to Quality**

* Contribute to a welcoming clinical space and healthy work environment through proactive relationship building, direct communication, and practicing sound judgment.
* Communicate and work effectively with all members of the care team to best serve patients.

jobs.desc:
\*\*Job Overview:\*\*

We are seeking a dedicated **Front Desk and Back Office Receptionist** to join our healthcare team. The ideal candidate will provide crucial administrative support in a medical setting, ensuring smooth operations and excellent patient care.

\*\*Responsibilities:\*\*

- Reviewing and correctly verifying the patient to get their vital signs, escorting and prepping before seeing the Physician.

- Directly working with the patient to update any changes to their charts.

- Do EKGs, hook-up Holter Monitors, and prep Treadmill Stress Test

- Fax note charts to their PCPs and other offices, fax prescription refill requests to pharmacies.

- Manage and organize the chart room.

- Manage front desk activities including patient check-in, check-out, and appointment scheduling.

- Utilize medical scheduling software to coordinate patient appointments efficiently.

- Answer phones, respond to inquiries, and direct calls to appropriate personnel.

- Maintain patient records and ensure accuracy and confidentiality of information.

- Assist with insurance verification and billing processes.

- Collaborate with medical staff to facilitate patient care and administrative tasks.

\*\*Qualifications:\*\*

- Previous experience in medical administrative support or similar roles preferred.

- Proficiency in using medical software systems for EHR

- Strong knowledge of medical terminology and procedures.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to interact professionally with patients and staff.

- Familiarity with urgent care operations is a plus.

Join our team as a Medical Administrative Assistant and contribute to providing exceptional healthcare services.

\*\*Tổng quan công việc:\*\*

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Nhân viên Lễ tân kiêm Hỗ trợ Hành chính tận tâm để gia nhập đội ngũ y tế của mình. Ứng viên phù hợp sẽ đảm nhận vai trò hỗ trợ hành chính quan trọng trong môi trường y tế, góp phần đảm bảo quy trình vận hành trơn tru và chất lượng chăm sóc bệnh nhân xuất sắc.

\*\*Trách nhiệm:\*\*

- Kiểm tra và xác minh thông tin bệnh nhân, đo các chỉ số sinh tồn, cũng như hướng dẫn và chuẩn bị cho bệnh nhân trước khi gặp bác sĩ.

- Làm việc trực tiếp với bệnh nhân để cập nhật các thay đổi trong hồ sơ bệnh án.

- Thực hiện đo điện tâm đồ (EKG), gắn thiết bị theo dõi Holter và chuẩn bị cho quy trình kiểm tra gắng sức trên máy chạy bộ (Treadmill Stress Test).

- Gửi fax hồ sơ/ghi chú cho bác sĩ chăm sóc chính (PCP) và các cơ sở y tế khác; gửi fax yêu cầu cấp lại thuốc cho nhà thuốc.

- Quản lý và sắp xếp phòng lưu trữ hồ sơ bệnh án.

- Quản lý các hoạt động tại quầy lễ tân, bao gồm thủ tục tiếp nhận (check-in), hoàn tất thủ tục ra về (check-out) và đặt lịch hẹn cho bệnh nhân.

- Sử dụng phần mềm quản lý lịch hẹn y tế để sắp xếp lịch trình cho bệnh nhân một cách hiệu quả.

- Trả lời điện thoại, giải đáp thắc mắc và chuyển cuộc gọi đến đúng bộ phận hoặc nhân sự phụ trách.

- Quản lý hồ sơ bệnh nhân, đảm bảo tính chính xác và bảo mật thông tin.

- Hỗ trợ quy trình xác minh bảo hiểm và thanh toán viện phí.

- Phối hợp với đội ngũ y tế để hỗ trợ công tác chăm sóc bệnh nhân và các nhiệm vụ hành chính.

\*\*Yêu cầu:\*\*

- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực hỗ trợ hành chính y tế hoặc các vị trí tương đương.

- Thành thạo sử dụng các hệ thống phần mềm y tế phục vụ hồ sơ sức khỏe điện tử (EHR)

- Có kiến ​​thức vững chắc về thuật ngữ và quy trình y tế.

- Kỹ năng giao tiếp xuất sắc; có khả năng tương tác chuyên nghiệp với bệnh nhân và đồng nghiệp.

- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc tại các cơ sở chăm sóc y tế khẩn cấp (urgent care) là một lợi thế.

Hãy gia nhập đội ngũ của chúng tôi với tư cách là Trợ lý Hành chính Y tế và cùng đóng góp vào việc cung cấp dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe chất lượng cao.

Loại hình công việc: Toàn thời gian

Mục lương: $20,00 - $25,00 một giờ

Địa điểm việc làm: Làm việc trực tiếp

Flynt Management Group LLC is seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to support our corporate finance team.

jobs.desc:
Bring your talent. Build your career. Make an impact. At All For Kids, you'll join a mission-driven team where your skills matter, your growth is encouraged, and your work helps create brighter futures for children and families.

**Position:** Regional Office Manager  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** $70,304

**Work Location:** Palmdale

**Benefits and Perks:**

* Comprehensive benefits, Medical, Dental, Vision and 401K.
* Generous PTO, holidays, and wellness days for work-life balance.
* Growth-focused culture with Elevate University.
* Recognized as "DEI Non-Profit of the Year" by the LA Business Journal.
* Bi-weekly and semi-annual monetary bonuses for Behavioral Health Service Providers that meet specific qualifying criteria. (Clinical Roles Only)

**Learn more about the Job:**

As the Regional Office Manager, you will provide hands-on leadership and operational oversight across multiple All For Kids locations, ensuring a welcoming, professional, and efficient office environment. You will lead and develop reception staff, establish high standards for customer service, and ensure consistency in daily office operations. This highly visible role requires a flexible, solutions-oriented leader who can adapt quickly, support multiple locations, and create a positive experience for employees, families, and visitors.

This position will be primarily based at the Palmdale office, with frequent travel to the Lancaster and Valencia locations. The Regional Office Manager will be responsible for maintaining consistent operational standards and providing direct leadership to reception staff across all three locations. Flexibility to adjust work schedules, travel between offices, and provide hands-on reception coverage is essential to the success of this role.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Supervise, coach, train, and support reception staff across Palmdale, Lancaster, and Valencia, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and consistently high standards of professionalism and customer service.
* Oversee daily front-office operations across assigned locations, ensuring offices remain organized, welcoming, fully functional, and aligned with organizational standards and procedures.
* Provide direct reception and administrative coverage as needed, including during staffing shortages, absences, and periods of increased operational demand.
* Monitor office supply inventory, coordinate purchasing and replenishment, and partner closely with the Director of Facilities to identify, communicate, and resolve maintenance, safety, and operational concerns.
* Travel regularly between Palmdale, Lancaster, and Valencia to assess operational needs, support staff, implement consistent processes, and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service delivery.

**Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of prior management or supervisory experience required, preferably overseeing administrative, reception, or multi-site office operations.
* Bilingual English/Spanish required, with strong verbal communication skills in both languages.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold team members accountable to high-performance standards.
* Exceptional flexibility and adaptability, with the ability to adjust schedules, priorities, and work locations based on organizational needs.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 75% of the time between All For Kids locations, including travel to multiple locations within the same workday.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, multitasking, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills, with a professional, approachable, and solutions-focused leadership style.

**JOB SUMMARY**

**The First Voice Our Clients Hear**

Every kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home remodel we build starts with a phone call, and in this job you’re the one picking up. Internally, we call this role our **Director of First Impressions**. You’ll be the warm, organized person who turns a homeowner’s first question into a booked design consultation. You’ll also help keep our marketing, our office, and our company culture running smoothly.

If you love people, get a kick out of a well-organized system, and are always looking for ways to make things 1% better, we’d love to meet you.

**About Sea Pointe**

Sea Pointe Design & Remodel is an award-winning residential design-build firm that has served Orange County homeowners for 40 years. We specialize in whole-home renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, and additions. We’re a close-knit team that takes both our craft and our culture seriously.

**What You’ll Do**

*Client Experience*

* Answer and route incoming calls so every caller feels taken care of
* Schedule complimentary in-home design consultations for our Design Consultants
* Follow up promptly on every new inquiry by phone, text, and email
* Guide past clients through our handyman and warranty process, coordinating with our Production team
* Own our CRM and keep client and project information accurate and complete
* Scan completed job files and organize them on the company server

  

*Marketing*

* Track lead status and deliver weekly lead reports and the monthly Sales Report
* Manage our Client Referral Program
* Represent Sea Pointe in local community groups and on social media
* Help plan, book, and host our educational client workshops

  

*Office & Leadership Support*

* Set up quarterly All-Staff meetings, including food, tables, and chairs
* Organize employee gifts and company apparel, and keep inventory
* Coordinate supply ordering with our admin team
* Support the President and sales leadership team as needed

  

*Company Culture*

* Lead our Fun Committee and plan the events that make Sea Pointe a great place to work

  

**Who You Are**

* **Warm and upbeat.** People trust you right away, and you make everyone feel welcome, whether it’s a client or a coworker.
* **Detail-oriented.** You love a clean calendar, an accurate database, and a process that works.
* **Proactive.** You spot what could run better and fix it without being asked.
* **A clear, friendly communicator** by phone, email, and text.
* **Excited to grow your marketing skills** and see how your work drives real results.
* **Comfortable with CRM software and Microsoft 365.** Experience with JobTread, Canva, social media, or the construction and design industry is a plus but not required.
* **2+ years** in hospitality, customer service, reception, office administration, or a similar role, or equivalent experience.

  

**What We Offer**

* 75% company-paid health insurance
* 2–4 weeks PTO based on years of service, plus 7 paid holidays
* 401(k) with 3% company contribution after one year
* A beautiful design showroom to work in and a team that genuinely enjoys working together

We are looking for a highly organized and tech-savvy Customer Success & Operations Specialist to join our team. You aren't just answering emails—you are actively processing orders, generating and reconciling invoices, and ensuring our operations run smoothly from purchase to delivery.

* **Highly Tech-Savvy:** You pick up new software quickly and are comfortable navigating multiple digital tools at once.

* Strong computer literacy and proficiency in spreadsheet software (Excel/Google Sheets).

jobs.title: Front Office Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**Front Office Coordinator – Anderson Family Dentistry**

**Location:** Anderson, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

About the Position

Anderson Family Dentistry is a growing dental practice seeking a dependable, organized, and motivated **Front Office Coordinator** to join our team.

We are looking for someone who can manage multiple responsibilities, communicate professionally, and contribute to an efficient, productive office. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, takes initiative, follows through on responsibilities, and understands the importance of accuracy and accountability.

This position requires someone who can work independently while supporting the needs of the entire team.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage patient check-in, check-out, and daily front office operations.
* Answer incoming calls, respond to patient inquiries, and maintain professional communication.
* Schedule, confirm, and coordinate appointments to maintain productive provider schedules.
* Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage limitations.
* Prepare and review treatment estimates and discuss financial arrangements with patients.
* Submit and track insurance claims, resolve outstanding claims, and post payments accurately.
* Assist with patient billing, accounts receivable, and outstanding balance follow-up.
* Maintain accurate patient records, insurance information, and documentation.
* Coordinate patient referrals and correspondence as needed.
* Monitor schedules, identify openings, and proactively assist with filling appointments.
* Work collaboratively with clinical and administrative team members to maintain efficient patient flow.
* Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
* Dependability, professionalism, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and follow established procedures.
* Comfortable working with computers and learning new software.
* Willingness to accept feedback, adapt, and take accountability for assigned work.

**Preferred:**

* Previous dental front office or administrative experience.
* Familiarity with dental terminology and treatment procedures.
* Experience with dental insurance verification, claims, and billing.
* Experience with dental practice management software, preferably Dentrix Ascend.
* Knowledge of patient scheduling and accounts receivable.

**Dental experience is preferred but not required.** We will consider candidates with strong administrative, customer service, scheduling, or billing backgrounds who demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn.

What We Expect

We value employees who are proactive, accountable, and committed to maintaining a productive workplace.

Successful team members:

* Recognize what needs to be done and take action without constant direction.
* Manage their responsibilities and follow through on outstanding tasks.
* Maintain accuracy while working efficiently.
* Communicate concerns and resolve issues appropriately.
* Remain flexible and assist wherever needed.
* Contribute to the overall performance and success of the practice.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive hourly pay based on experience.
* Paid holidays.
* Paid time off.
* Retirement benefits.
* Additional benefits following the introductory period.
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement as our practice grows.

**A 90-day introductory assessment period applies to this position.**

Apply Today

If you are reliable, detail-oriented, and looking for a long-term opportunity with a growing dental practice, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your resume outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

Job Type: Full-t

jobs.desc:
**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Under the supervision of the Human Resources Generalist and in accordance with Salina Family YMCA policies and procedures, the Human Resources Assistant provides administrative and operational support for human resources functions, including recruitment, onboarding, personnel records, background checks, employee documentation, training coordination, and HR systems administration.

This position helps ensure that HR processes are completed accurately, consistently, confidentially, and within established timelines. The Human Resources Assistant supports the day-to-day operations of the HR department while referring employee relations matters, policy questions, sensitive issues, and decisions requiring HR approval to the Human Resources Generalist.

The following is not an all-inclusive list but highlights the general responsibilities of the position.

* **Recruitment and Hiring**

* Provide administrative support throughout the recruitment and hiring process.
* Manage candidate information and recruitment activities within Paycor and other designated systems.
* Post job openings, monitor applications, communicate with candidates, and coordinate interviews as directed.
* Initiate, process, and track reference checks and background checks in accordance with established procedures.
* Review background check results for completeness, document status, and identify items requiring HR review or approval.
* Ensure required hiring documentation, including Personnel Action Forms (PAFs), is received and approved before processing new hires or employment changes.
* Communicate with department heads and supervisors regarding the status of candidates and outstanding hiring requirements.
* Assist with closing job postings and completing recruitment-related administrative tasks.

* **Onboarding and Employee Records**

* Initiate and monitor new-hire onboarding through Paycor after receiving the required authorization and documentation.
* Track completion of onboarding forms, employment documentation, required certifications, and assigned training.
* Coordinate new employee orientation and assist with the preparation of orientation materials and packets.

* Maintain accurate and organized electronic and physical personnel records.
* Ensure employee documentation is filed appropriately and updated when changes occur.
* Assist with employee status changes, transfers, pay rate changes, position changes, and separations after receiving the required PAF and approvals.
* Follow up with employees and supervisors regarding incomplete documentation and outstanding onboarding requirements.

* **HR Systems and Administrative Support**

* Maintain and update employee information in Paycor and other designated HR systems, within assigned access and authorization.
* Assist with routine HR data entry, reports, employee lists, statistics, and record reconciliation.
* Monitor onboarding, recruitment, training, and other HR task completion to help ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify discrepancies or incomplete information and bring them to the attention of the Human Resources Generalist.
* Assist with maintaining HR process documentation, forms, checklists, and administrative procedures.
* Provide administrative support for employee communications and HR department projects.

* **Training and Compliance Coordination**

* Coordinate and track required employee training, including safety training, annual courses, and other assigned compliance-related training.
* Monitor training completion and follow up with employees and supervisors regarding outstanding requirements.
* Maintain records of completed training, certifications, and related documentation.
* Assist with organizing training sessions, orientations, and other employee development activities.
* Help maintain accurate documentation related to workplace incidents and accident reports, referring sensitive matters and follow-up decisions to the Human Resources Genera

**Job Summary**

Kenaitze's Yinihugheltani Project is a five-year grant award under SAMHSA's (Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration) Native Connections grant. The priority of the national grant program is to reduce suicidal behavior and substance use among Native youth. The Yinihugheltani Project pursues that goal through the facilitation of one or more clubs for Native youth who plan and implement an annual calendar of activities and events built on a foundation of traditional Alaska Native and American Indian culture. The Project Coordinator leads the Youth Club as a mentor, adult supervisor, and coach, with a goal of fostering and developing youth leadership. The Project Coordinator supervises the Youth Outreach and Support Specialist in order to accomplish all Youth Club objectives. The Project Coordinator keeps the Behavioral Health Manager informed of all Yinihugheltani activities. This position will also work to gather, review, and analyze data relevant to the full development of the grant.

* Have lead responsibility for the day-to-day activities associated with the Dena'ina Yinihugheltani Project
* Sole responsibility for all grant reporting and project evaluation requirements. Specifically, this includes: quarterly, mid-year and annual reporting to funder's requirements; and development, execution, analysis, and dissemination of quantitative and qualitative data for grant evaluation needs

* Design, plan, implement and facilitate grant programmatic efforts including Yinihugheltani Club meetings, activities, public events, and outreach efforts
* Plan, conduct and facilitate regional and local community outreach across multiple systems and organizations
* Complete annual trainings as required

We are seeking an energetic and highly organized Office Manager to lead the daily operations of our office environment. This vital role involves overseeing administrative functions, managing vendor relationships, coordinating events, and ensuring a smooth workflow across departments. The ideal candidate will bring a proactive attitude, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for creating an efficient, welcoming workplace. Your leadership will help foster a productive atmosphere where team members can thrive and focus on their core responsibilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of office operations, including administrative support, clerical tasks, and front desk duties to ensure seamless daily functioning.
* Coordinate and plan company events, meetings, and team-building activities to promote engagement and collaboration.
* Supervise administrative staff and provide training & development opportunities to enhance team performance.

* Handle vendor management by negotiating contracts, maintaining relationships, and ensuring timely delivery of supplies and services.
* Maintain accurate bookkeeping records using QuickBooks or similar accounting software; oversee payroll processing in collaboration with HR.
* Support human resources functions such as onboarding new employees, managing filing systems, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Manage office budgets, monitor expenses, and implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or efficiency.
* Oversee office equipment maintenance, multi-line phone systems, filing systems, and general clerical support to keep the office organized.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.desc:
The Office Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the daily administrative, financial, technical, and operational functions of the company. This position ensures that office operations run efficiently, financial records remain accurate, technology systems function properly, and administrative responsibilities are completed accurately and on time.

The Office Manager serves as a central point of coordination between ownership, employees, consultants, vendors, clients, and construction teams. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful individual who can independently manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize deadlines, resolve operational issues, and support the overall success of the company.

Key Responsibilities

1. Office & Business Management

* Oversee daily office operations and administrative functions.
* Develop and maintain office procedures, policies, and organizational systems.
* Coordinate communication between ownership, employees, clients, consultants, and vendors.
* Manage business documentation, administrative correspondence, and company records.
* Coordinate office maintenance, supplies, equipment, and vendor services.
* Assist ownership with business planning and operational improvements.
* Address day-to-day office needs and resolve administrative issues.

2. Accounting & Financial Administration

* Manage accounts payable (AP), including processing, coding, and scheduling vendor invoices.
* Manage accounts receivable (AR), including preparing invoices, tracking payments, and following up on outstanding balances.
* Prepare and issue invoices for architectural services, construction projects, and additional services.
* Monitor project budgets, expenses, consultant fees, and client payments.
* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions.
* Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
* Prepare financial reports, expense summaries, and cash flow information for ownership.
* Track intercompany transactions, reimbursements, and transfers.
* Assist with month-end and year-end accounting procedures.

3. Payroll, Employee Administration & Time Tracking

* Process employee payroll accurately and on schedule.
* Review employee timesheets, work hours, overtime, leave, and payroll adjustments.
* Manage employee time-tracking systems and ensure hours are assigned to the correct projects.
* Maintain employee payroll records and confidential personnel documentation.
* Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Coordinate employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, and other benefits.
* Track employee leave balances and time-off records.
* Prepare labor cost and employee utilization reports.

4. Tax Filing & Business Compliance

* Prepare and file applicable sales and use tax returns.
* Track taxable and non-taxable transactions.
* Coordinate payroll tax reporting and verify required payments.
* Maintain company registrations, business licenses, and renewal schedules.
* Monitor filing deadlines and maintain compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with accountants and tax professionals as needed.

jobs.desc:
**About the Community Economic Defense Project (CEDP) & CED Law**

**Our Mission**

  

We partner with low-income and working people to build economic and racial equity. We do this by confronting economic abuse and investing in community wealth. We use an ever-evolving set of legal, economic and advocacy tools to challenge and dismantle unjust systems, building quickly towards a world where all people have what they need to live and thrive.

**Our Organization**

  

The Community Economic Defense Project (CEDP) is a Colorado-based nonprofit. Launched in 2020 as the COVID-19 Eviction Defense Project, our organization was formed to keep our neighbors housed during the pandemic. Working with clients, we built a deeply integrative approach to eviction, foreclosure, and homelessness prevention that centers the legal and financial needs of housing-insecure families and uses a variety of tools to keep them housed. Our team now serves more than 1,000 people per month, bringing together housing lawyers, economists, data analysts, policy-experts, organizers, and technologists to serve our clients.

We have served more than 68,000 low-income Coloradans across 54 counties, distributing more than $280 million in emergency assistance. We have also contributed to the passage of major legislation to prevent eviction, stop economic abuse, and make credit and life-saving medication cheaper. CEDP’s model has been cited as a best practice by the White House and HUD in 2022-2023, think tanks like the Urban Institute, and in the media.

Building on our work to stop evictions, CEDP has further expanded its integrated services model to include disaster response, predatory towing, debt collection, benefit access & navigation, long-term rental assistance, and homelessness response. Similar to CEDP’s work on rental housing, these efforts offer a continuum of care that includes navigation and advisory services, targeted payments, legal support, and the ability to participate in advocacy.

**More about the Bilingual Front Desk Coordinator position:**

In this role, you will provide full-day coverage at CEDP’s Colorado Springs office. This position serves as the first point of contact for clients accessing CEDP services and plays an essential role in creating a welcoming, safe, and trauma-informed experience for everyone who enters our office. This is an in-person, client-facing position with approximately 75% of the role focused on direct client interaction and about 25% focused on front office operations and administrative support.

Clients come to CEDP from a wide range of backgrounds and lived experiences and may be navigating significant stress, crisis, or trauma. The Front Desk Coordinator approaches each person with empathy and respect while also maintaining appropriate boundaries, following safety protocols, and applying de-escalation intervention for challenging situations.

**In this role you will:**

**Provide Client Experience & Front Desk Support**

  

* Serve as the first point of contact for clients, visitors, and community members entering the office.
* Warmly greet clients and visitors and help create a welcoming, respectful, and trauma-informed environment.
* Conduct and log initial client intakes at CEDP’s Colorado Springs office, and refer clients to the correct programs
* Conduct and accurately document in-person client intakes using tools such as the office tracker, sign-in sheets, HubSpot, and other internal systems.
* Use Slack and email for shift handoffs, updates, and internal communication.
* Stay informed on CEDP services to support accurate client referrals.
* Coordinate check disbursements following internal protocols.
* Use trauma-informed communication, active listening, boundary-setting, and de-escalation techniques to support clients while maintaining a safe environment
* Recognize situations that require additional support and appropriately escalate concerns to supervisors, safety personnel, other staff, or the Family

If you are proactive, tech savvy, outgoing, and love keeping things running smoothly, this could be your perfect fit.

You will coordinate office operations and employee activities across two California offices in Sunnyvale and Sacramento.

jobs.desc:
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our accounts receivable processes, ensuring timely collection of outstanding payments, and supporting our overall cash flow objectives. **Core Competencies:**

* **Negotiation Skills**: Ability to professionally negotiate payment terms and resolve client disputes effectively.
