jobs.title: Sales Operations Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT HEAVISIDE INDUSTRIES**

Heaviside Industries builds multi-domain autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. While modern warfare has rapidly evolved with the proliferation of unmanned systems, hyper-precise munitions in contested environments are the future of the battlefield. Economical precision strike capabilities are critical to U.S. and allied war efforts, enabling successful defeat of enemy military assets and infrastructure. Heaviside builds precision munitions designed to operate in GPS-denied and spectrum-jammed battlefields—where traditional systems degrade or fail—without inflated prices or sacrifice to performance.

All engineering and manufacturing is conducted in-house in Heaviside's Los Angeles, CA headquarters and Oslo, Norway office.

Heaviside is backed by Interlagos, Menlo Ventures, Flume Ventures, Cantos, Anorak Ventures, and Ravelin Ventures.

The Role

As Sales Operations Coordinator, you will keep our quoting process accurate and our records clean, so that every order moves smoothly from Business Development to Accounting. You'll prepare and track customer quotes, check incoming purchase orders against what we quoted, and make sure Accounting has complete, organized documentation for invoicing and reconciliation.

This is an early-career role with real responsibility. You'll work closely with our Business Development and Finance teams, correspond directly with customers on quotes and order details, and learn how a fast-growing defense manufacturer turns a customer request into a delivered order.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

**Quoting**

* Prepare price quotes using standard templates, based on input from the Business Development team and company pricing guidelines.
* Revise quotes as customers or BD request changes, and keep version history clear and easy to follow.
* Route quotes for internal review and approval before they go to customers.

**Customer Correspondence**

* Send quotes to customers and serve as a point of contact for questions about pricing, terms, and quote revisions.
* Confirm order details with customers when a purchase order arrives, and follow up on missing or unclear information.
* Keep communication professional, accurate, and timely, and loop in BD when a question needs their input.

**Purchase Orders & Accounting Handoff**

* Check every incoming purchase order (PO) against the quoted price, quantities, and terms, and flag any differences before it moves forward.
* Enter approved POs into our ERP / order management system.
* Package quote, PO, and order documentation for Accounting so invoicing and reconciliation go smoothly.
* Answer Accounting's questions about quotes and orders, and resolve discrepancies with BD and customers.

**Records & Reporting**

* Maintain an organized, audit-ready record of all quotes, revisions, POs, and customer correspondence.
* Track open quotes and pending orders, and share regular status updates with BD and Finance.
* Help improve quoting templates and processes as the business scales.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
---------------------------

* 0–2 years of experience in sales support, sales operations, customer service, administrative, or accounting support roles. Internships and part-time roles count.
* A bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail. Accuracy in quotes, POs, and records is the heart of this job.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication, and confidence corresponding directly with customers.
* Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets), including basic formulas, sorting, and filtering.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to keep several open quotes and orders on track at once.
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow with a fast-moving team.
* U.S. Person as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62).

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Expo

* Maintain organized electronic documentation and accounting records.

* Experience with vendor insurance compliance preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling payments and banking

jobs.title: Billing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Billing Specialist**  
*Puretec Industrial Water | Full-Time*

Puretec Industrial Water is a family-owned leader in water treatment solutions, converting municipal water into highly purified deionized water for industrial applications across the Southwestern United States. Our systems support customers in industries ranging from solar energy to aerospace research. We are committed to providing high-quality products and services, and to fostering a culture that values both our customers and our employees.

We are seeking a Billing Specialist to keep our delivery and service billing accurate and on schedule. This role reconciles and audits orders, resolves discrepancies, and coordinates closely with drivers, service technicians, and customers to keep daily operations running smoothly.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Process and bill service orders
* Audit and bill delivery orders for all branches to ensure accuracy and compliance
* Reconcile delivery and service orders daily to support accurate, timely invoicing
* Identify, communicate, and resolve billing discrepancies promptly
* Notify customers in advance of upcoming deliveries and service visits, and provide real-time updates on changes or delays
* Follow up after service or delivery to ensure customer satisfaction
* Respond to customer emails and phone inquiries professionally and promptly
* Identify and recommend improvements to billing, routing, and field processes

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Plan and route drivers and service technicians to ensure efficient daily coverage
* Manage daily schedules for service technicians across all locations
* Coordinate emergency service requests and routine MMA visits
* Evaluate and improve route structure to increase productivity and reduce delays
* Conduct ride-alongs to reinforce safety, compliance, and best practices
* Serve as an after-hours contact for customers and drivers as assigned
* Provide administrative and operational support and cross-training to colleagues as needed

**Skills and Knowledge**

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and time management skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize
* Ability to manage schedules and shift priorities as the day changes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Familiarity with route planning and delivery coordination
* Effective communication with internal teams and external customers
* Proactive, customer-first mindset with a positive, professional attitude
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

**Education and Experience**

* 5+ years of billing experience preferred
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a customer service role
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off
* Paid Wellness Day, plus $100
* Paid Birthday Day off
* Paid Family Day, plus $100

**Ready to Join the Puretec Team?**

If you’re looking for more than just a job, if you want a career with growth, hands-on work, and a company that truly cares, **apply today** and help us **Make Water Better!**

https://puretecwater.com/careers/

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
**About PeerBuddies**

PeerBuddies provides **Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA)-based social skills intervention** for individuals who experience social difficulties. We pair participants with same-age Peer Buddy volunteers to create an inclusive, supportive environment where both individuals can learn and practice essential social skills, including compromising, asking before acting, active listening, sharing, coping with frustration, and self-advocacy.

We are a small, passionate team of clinicians and professionals who value collaboration, empathy, continuous learning, and making a meaningful difference in our community.

**Join PeerBuddies as Our Next Operations Manager!**

We’re looking for a **proactive, organized, and compassionate Operations Manager** to help our organization thrive behind the scenes.

In this dynamic role, you’ll support administrative operations, insurance billing, accounting, program and camp coordination, social media, and community outreach. You’ll help keep systems organized, payments on track, communications flowing, and programs running smoothly, all while identifying new ways to improve our processes and expand our community impact.

**About the Role:**

* **Administrative Operations:** Manage daily communications, monitor applications and inquiries, coordinate scheduling, maintain organized digital records, and support general office operations.
* **Insurance Billing & Claims:** Submit insurance claims, track outstanding payments, obtain benefit information, monitor authorizations, and follow up with insurance companies to resolve billing issues.
* **Accounting & Payment Tracking:** Maintain payment records, prepare and send invoices, track incoming payments and donations, and support financial recordkeeping.
* **Camp & Program Coordination:** Assist with camp administration, family communications, rosters, applications, payments, and special program logistics.
* **Community Outreach & Social Media**: Help recruit Participants and Peer Buddy volunteers, maintain social media accounts, and identify opportunities to strengthen community partnerships and expand our reach.
* **Process Improvement & Team Support:** Identify ways to improve workflows, maintain clear documentation, communicate challenges, and collaborate with the Director and clinical team to keep operations running smoothly.

**Position Details:**

**Compensation**: $26-$33 per hour, depending on experience.

**Schedule**: Monday-Friday. Part-time to start as soon as possible, with paid training during November and December. Our goal is to gradually ramp up to full-time hours in January. If you’re interested in starting full-time right away, we’re absolutely open to discussing that during the interview process.

**You may be a great fit if you:**

* Love organization, problem-solving, and managing multiple priorities.
* Communicate effectively and build positive professional relationships.
* Take initiative, embrace accountability, and welcome constructive feedback.
* Enjoy improving systems and finding creative solutions.
* Value empathy, teamwork, and continuous learning.

**Experience with insurance billing, bookkeeping, healthcare administration, or similar work is preferred.**

**Why PeerBuddies?**

* Contribute to a meaningful, mission-driven organization.
* Support Participants, Buddy volunteers, families, and a passionate clinical team.
* Work in a collaborative environment where empathy, feedback, and new ideas are valued.
* Help shape and improve the systems that support our growing organization.
* Develop your administrative, financial, and program coordination skills.

Interested in helping us make a difference? We’d love to hear from you!

Pay: $26.00 - $33.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Job Description: Financial Bookkeeper (Manufacturing)**

**Job Title:** Financial Bookkeeper

**Company: US Paper Mill Company, LLC**

**Industry:** Manufacturing / Operations

**Position Type:** Full-Time

**Software Requirements:** QuickBooks Desktop / QuickBooks Online Advanced (specifically Enterprise/Manufacturing module preferred)

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented **Financial Bookkeeper** with extensive experience in the **manufacturing industry** to oversee daily financial transactions, manage cost accounting records, and ensure seamless inventory tracking. The ideal candidate will have advanced proficiency in **QuickBooks**, a strong understanding of job costing, raw materials accounting, vendor management, and routine financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Daily Bookkeeping & General Ledger**

* Maintain accurate financial records using **QuickBooks**, ensuring proper categorization of all revenues and operational expenses.
* Reconcile bank statements, credit card accounts, and line of credit balances on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Prepare, record, and post standard journal entries for routine accruals, prepaid expenses, and asset depreciation.

**2. Manufacturing & Inventory Accounting**

* Manage inventory tracking within QuickBooks, including **Raw Materials**, **Work-in-Process (WIP)**, and **Finished Goods**.
* Perform **Job Costing** analysis: allocate labor, freight, direct materials, and overhead costs to specific production runs or customer orders.
* Conduct monthly physical inventory counts/audits and reconcile discrepancies against QuickBooks balances.
* Process bill of materials (BOM) entries, assembly builds, and inventory adjustments.

**3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Management**

* Process vendor invoices, match purchase orders (POs) with receiving documents, and resolve price/quantity variances.
* Schedule and execute vendor payments via check, ACH, or credit card while taking advantage of early-payment discounts.
* Maintain vendor records and manage year-end 1099 issuance.

**4. Accounts Receivable (AR) & Billing**

* Generate and send customer invoices based on shipment confirmations or completion of milestone deliverables.
* Monitor accounts receivable aging reports, conduct collections follow-ups, and post incoming payments (ACH, checks, credit cards).
* Process customer credit memos and resolve billing inquiries promptly.

**5. Financial Reporting**

* Generate monthly financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement) for executive management review.
* Assist outside CPA/accounting firms during tax season and year-end audits.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 3–5+ years of full-charge bookkeeping experience in a **manufacturing, assembly, or industrial** setting.
* **Software Mastery:** Advanced proficiency in **QuickBooks** (QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise / Manufacturing edition preferred).
* **Cost Accounting:** Direct experience with Job Costing, Bill of Materials (BOM), WIP, and inventory valuation methods (FIFO, LIFO, or Standard Costing).
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong skills in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, financial formulas).
* **Education:** Associate’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* **Certifications:** QuickBooks Certified User or Certified Bookkeeper (AIPB) is a plus.

**Key Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and high level of numerical accuracy.
* Ability to collaborate closely with production management, shipping/receiving, and purchasing teams.
* Strong understanding of GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) as applied to manufacturing environment workflows.

About this Role:

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of weekly, multi-state payroll for a large employee population. This role ensures compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations, manages employee deductions and garnishments, supports tax reporting and filings, and serves as a key resource for payroll-related inquiries. The Payroll Specialist works closely with HR and Finance teams to ensure payroll integrity, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do:

* Process weekly and/or bi-weekly payroll for approximately 1,700+ employees across multiple states.
* Import, verify, audit, and adjust timecard and payroll data to ensure accuracy.
* Review and reconcile wages, overtime, PTO, and other pay types in compliance with payroll regulations.
* Perform payroll audits and reconcile payroll registers prior to transmission.
* Ensure timely and accurate distribution of employee pay.
* Verify employee setup and timecard accuracy within timekeeping systems (e.g., JD Edwards).
* Track and maintain PTO accruals within the timekeeping system.
* Perform QA/QC reviews of payroll submissions, charge codes, and control totals.
* Manage federal, state, and local tax withholdings, deposits, and multi-state reporting.
* Conduct tax analysis to ensure proper withholding and compliance.
* Support quarterly filings and year-end reporting, including W-2 processing.
* Process employee deductions, garnishments, and other withholdings in accordance with regulations.
* Maintain compliance with SOX standards, internal controls, and company policies.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for employee payroll questions and issue resolution.
* Partner with HR teams to ensure accurate benefit and deduction processing.
* Maintain the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee data.
* Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and assist with payroll system upgrades or enhancements.
* Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned by leadership.
* Work independently under minimal supervision while escalating complex issues as needed.

What You'll Bring:

* High School Diploma required; Associate degree preferred (Accounting, Finance, HR, or related field).
* 2+ years of payroll processing experience; multi-state payroll experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of payroll laws, regulations, and reporting requirements.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and perform well under pressure.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Dependable, reliable, and professional demeanor.

**Preferred**  

* Experience processing payroll for large employee populations.

**Position:** Payroll Coordinator

**Reports to:** Payroll Supervisor

**Department:** Finance

**Location:** Holland, MI (On-Site)

There has never been a more exciting time to join Request Foods. We’ve been selling products to many of the world’s leading food companies, retailers and restaurants for over 35 years. A privately owned and financially sound company, we do our best to run our business based on Christian values. Whether it’s cooking up great tasting food, assisting in customer support, providing quality and production leadership, or supporting administrative or technical activities, a career at Request Foods is a great opportunity. At Request, we’ve achieved success by treating our employees with integrity, trust and respect. If you’re passionate about food, and the people who help produce it, then Request Foods might just be for you.

The Payroll Coordinator is responsible for ensuring weekly hourly payroll is processed accurately and timely. This position supports payroll-related accounting, reporting, month-end activities, and 401(k) administration. The Payroll Coordinator is a member of the Finance department, but works closely with People Services, department leaders, and payroll and retirement vendors to research and resolve payroll-related matters. This role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, analytical and organizational skills, and strict confidentiality regarding employee and company information.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and process weekly hourly payroll for nearly 900 employees, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted within established deadlines.
* Review timekeeping records, payroll changes, deductions, and supporting documentation; research and resolve discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
* Review payroll registers, exception reports, and other payroll outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Process special payrolls and other off-cycle payments as needed.
* Process and maintain garnishments, Friend of the Court orders, and other payroll-related withholdings.
* Prepare and process payroll-related journal entries and accruals.
* Perform payroll-related account reconciliations and month-end tasks.
* Prepare and submit weekly 401(k) contribution files accurately and within required timeframes.
* Validate employee 401(k) deferrals, employer-matching contributions, and file totals; research and resolve discrepancies.
* Prepare and maintain payroll reports and assist with special reporting requests.
* Respond to employee and team leader payroll questions promptly, professionally, and confidentially; research issues and coordinate resolution as needed.
* Assist with year-end and quarter-end payroll activities, including payroll reconciliations, W-2 processing, employee data validation, and required payroll reporting.
* Support payroll-related internal controls and provide documentation for audits.
* Process and report unclaimed payroll checks in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Maintain the confidentiality and security of employee payroll, banking, tax, and company information.
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, reporting and system utilization.
* Other duties as assigned. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant payroll experience will be considered.

* Two or more years of payroll processing experience.
* Working knowledge of payroll practices, payroll taxes, timekeeping, deductions, garnishments, and payroll reconciliations.
* Experience with payroll, human resources information, and timekeeping systems required; experience with Paycor preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, reconcile, and analyze payroll data using formulas, lookups, filters, and pivot tables.

jobs.desc:
About Us:

Quanta Power Solutions brings together the industry-leading capabilities and resources of Quanta's operating companies to deliver complete EPC solutions. Our integrated approach spans power generation, battery energy storage, renewables, transmission, substation, and underground infrastructure — from concept to commissioning, we execute complex power infrastructure projects with the speed, certainty, and operational excellence our customers depend on.

At Quanta Power Solutions, we are driven by a culture of safety, integrity, and disciplined execution — and we're building a team that shares that commitment.

About this Role:

Quanta Power Solutions is seeking an **Project Coordinator** to support the Site Manager in the successful execution of **large-scale Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) and power generation projects**. This role assists in coordinating all phases of field construction, including civil, structural, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation & controls (I&C), and commissioning activities associated with utility-scale power plants.

The **Project Coordinator** plays a key role in daily site operations, helping ensure safe, quality-driven execution while supporting schedule, budget, and productivity goals across the project lifecycle.

What You'll Do:

* Assist in coordinating site construction activities across all power plant disciplines, including civil, structural steel, mechanical equipment, piping, electrical, and I&C systems.
* Support the Site Manager in overseeing construction of major power generation assets such as **gas turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs (Heat Recovery Steam Generators), balance-of-plant systems, cooling systems, and associated infrastructure**.
* Coordinate subcontractors, craft labor, vendors, and field engineering teams to ensure work is executed safely and efficiently.
* Help manage project schedules, work sequencing, and turnover milestones to support successful startup and commissioning activities.
* Monitor construction progress and ensure compliance with project specifications, quality requirements, environmental regulations, and safety standards.
* Assist in identifying and resolving field issues related to constructability, interfaces between disciplines, productivity, and schedule impacts.
* Participate in site inspections, progress meetings, turnover walks, punch list development, and commissioning readiness reviews.
* Support system completion, testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and plant startup activities.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, including daily reports, change management records, turnover packages, and as-built documentation.
* Assist with workforce planning, site logistics, material management, and equipment coordination.
* Promote a strong safety culture that aligns with Quanta Power Solutions' commitment to incident-free project execution.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring:

* High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* 5+ years of construction experience with at least 3+ years supporting **utility-scale power generation, industrial construction, energy infrastructure, or EPC projects**.
* Experience supporting construction of large industrial facilities with multiple disciplines and subcontractors.
* Working knowledge of mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation systems commonly found in power generation facilities.
* Familiarity with **combined cycle power plants, gas turbine systems, steam turbine systems, HRSGs, balance-of-plant equipment, or related energy infrastructure projects preferred**.
* Experience using project management and construction software such as Procore, Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of construction safety regulations, quality control processes, and commissioning practices.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership potential with a desire to grow

jobs.title: Regional Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
**Regional Operations Manager, California**

FBFK Law | Irvine, CA, with travel to Century City and (San Diego) Del Mar | Full-time, exempt | $165,000 to $195,000 base plus 15% target bonus

**About FBFK**

For more than 20 years, FBFK Law has been a people-first, entrepreneurial business law firm. With a 150 people across Texas and California, we are growing deliberately under FBFK 2.0, and that growth has been recognized: 18 regional rankings in the 2026 Best Law Firms® guide, #1 Overall Leading Law Firm among Small Firms in Bloomberg Law's 2026 rankings, and a place on Fortune's 2026 America's Most Innovative Companies list. Our Orange County office was named one of the Orange County Business Journal's 2026 Best Places to Work.

Our California offices have grown quickly. Irvine, Century City, and San Diego (Del Mar) now form a real region that needs an operations leader on the ground. This is the senior non-attorney operations role in California. You will report to our Director of Operations in Plano, Texas, which means most days the call is yours. We want someone who wants it that way.

The job is to run California well and build how it runs. You will take the firm’s operating standards and make them work in three offices, and where a standard doesn’t fit, you will make the case for a better one. You will lead the support staff, keep the region compliant, and give our managing partners their time back for clients.

**Why this role**

* **Authority.** You decide operational and support staff matters within the approved budget.
* **Something to build.** Much of the California playbook is yours to write: the staff assignment model, lateral onboarding, the compliance calendar, coverage plans.
* **Work people see.** You will be in front of partners, staff, and firm leadership every week, and your results will show up fast.

**What you will own**

* **Operations in three offices.** Staffing, coverage, office services, facilities, vendors, and landlord relationships in Irvine, Century City, and Del Mar.
* **Support staff and capacity.** Supervise legal assistants, office assistants, and reception. Own the staff-to-attorney assignment roster, track workload and utilization, and plan coverage for leave and turnover.
* **Lateral onboarding.** Work with HR, Talent, Finance, and Marketing so incoming partners and their teams have systems, space, support, and billing ready on day one.
* **On-site HR.** Partner with the Director of HR on recruiting, onboarding, reviews, and discipline for California staff. Harassment, safety, leave, and accommodation matters go to HR right away.
* **California compliance.** Run the compliance calendar (meal and rest periods, timekeeping, postings, harassment prevention training, leave notices, exempt classification) and lead the Workplace Violence Prevention Plan, IIPP, and emergency planning.
* **Budget and billing.** Build and manage the California budget with the CFO, review variances monthly, approve spending within your authority, and monitor time entry and billing deadlines.
* **Systems.** Keep Paycom data and payroll inputs accurate each pay cycle, and lead Aderant adoption among California staff after the December 1 go-live.
* **Your plan.** Within 60 days, assess each office and give the Director of Operations a written operating plan with priorities, owners, and dates. From there, run weekly check-ins with each office managing partner and a monthly California operating review.

**Who you are**

You do your best work with a clear standard and room to meet it your way. You set priorities, check your own work, and don’t need someone down the hall telling you what comes next. You care about getting the details right, whether that is a coverage schedule, a compliance deadline, or a budget line, and when the same problem keeps coming back, you fix the cause.

You also like people, and they tend to trust you. You can walk into a partner’s office, explain a decision with the facts behind it, and leave

This role ensures fresh, properly rotated products, maintains clean and presentable displays, and supports department operations while following Vallarta’s standards for food safety, sanitation, and honesty.

**What You’ll Do**

* Smile, greet, and assist customers with outstanding service.

* Ensure all products are fresh and rotated according to company guidelines.

* Promote sales through suggestive selling.

* Use slicers, knives, and other tools safely following department safety policies.

* Maintain clean, organized, and presentable display cases and counters.

* Stock and fill cremeria display cases and coolers as required.

* Transport products to coolers, storage areas, and worktables.

* Notify Cremeria Lead when supplies or products are needed.

* Monitor case temperatures and report discrepancies.

* Gain complete knowledge of all cremeria, seafood, and meat products and their uses.

* Apply meticulous cleaning and sanitation practices; assist in department sanitation.

* Respond to customer requests, ensuring honesty in packaging, weighing, and pricing.

* Use correct codes for packages to comply with state laws of weights and measures.

* Work safely, being aware of coworkers’ and customers’ safety.

* Treat coworkers and customers with respect; avoid profanity or offensive behavior.

* Follow food safety and health code regulations, personal hygiene, and dress code.

* Abide by company policies and the Employee Handbook.

* Contact Cremeria Lead, Meat Manager, or Store Director with questions or concerns.

* Report equipment failures promptly.

* Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stand and walk constantly (6–8+ hours/day).

* Frequently bend neck/waist, squat, twist, and reach above/below shoulders.

* Frequent repetitive use of hands (grasping, pushing, pulling, fine manipulation).

* Lift and carry up to 25 lbs. frequently and up to 50 lbs. occasionally.

* Heaviest item required to carry: 65 lbs. (one box), up to 100 feet.

* Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other moving equipment.

* Work near equipment and machinery; exposure to noise, temperature, and humidity changes.

* No work at heights; no walking on uneven ground.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Knowledge of products sold in the cremeria department.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, crowded environment.

* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.

* Team-oriented, respectful, and professional attitude.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

**Work Environment**

* Fast-paced cremeria, seafood, and meat department with direct customer interaction.

* Exposure to perishable products, refrigerated coolers, and changing conditions.

* Collaborative, team-focused workplace.

* Must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

jobs.desc:
Description:

**Run the Morning. Own the Road.**

While the city sleeps, you launch the fleet. Every morning at Adventure Tours, our motorcoaches roll out on charter trips, shuttle routes and line runs. Before the first wheel turns, one person has already lined it all up: the AM Dispatcher. If you love being the calm voice in a fast-moving operation, this seat is yours.

**Accokeek, MD | Full-time | Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM | Pay: $22–$25 per hour, based on experience**

**Who We Are**  
Adventure Tours has moved people since 1999. We started in Clinton, MD with a few buses and grew into a motorcoach operator running charter, line run and shuttle service from five markets: Accokeek MD, Philadelphia PA, Long Island NY, Richmond VA and Charlotte NC. We run 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and government agencies, universities and groups across the East Coast count on us every day.

**What Your Morning Looks Like**

* **Own the pull-out.** Arrive before the first report time, confirm every driver is checked in and fit for duty, and get every bus out of the yard on time.
* **Fill the gaps fast.** A driver calls out or a bus won’t start? You find coverage, swap equipment with maintenance, and keep the client whole.
* **Watch the board.** Track buses live by GPS, stay in constant contact with drivers, and catch late runs before the customer notices.
* **Protect the clock.** Build assignments that keep every driver inside federal hours-of-service limits.
* **Be the first call.** Handle breakdowns, delays, detours and accidents calmly, and notify clients and managers by the book.
* **Keep the paper clean.** Trip sheets, driver logs, vehicle inspection reports and dispatch notes, done right every shift.
* **Hand off strong.** Brief the PM dispatcher on open issues so nothing falls through the cracks.

**Why You’ll Like It Here**

* Competitive pay: $22–$25 per hour
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Done by noon: your afternoons are yours
* A family-founded company where your ideas reach leadership
* Room to grow into operations supervisor and manager roles across five markets

**Ready to run the morning? Click Apply to join the team.**

*Adventure Tours is an equal opportunity employer.*

Requirements:

* 1+ year of dispatch, scheduling or operations experience in motorcoach, transit, school bus or trucking
* Working knowledge of FMCSA/DOT rules, especially hours of service for passenger carriers
* Comfort with dispatch software, GPS tracking, Outlook and Excel
* Clear, steady communication on the phone and radio, even at 4 AM with three things going wrong
* Strong organization and sound judgment under pressure
* Reliability: we operate 24/7/365, including holidays, and the fleet can’t roll if dispatch isn’t there
* Flexibility: days and hours may change based on the needs of the company, and participation in the on-call rotation is required
* No CDL required
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screen

jobs.desc:
Print Estimating & Customer Service Manager

Cardwell Printing | Newport News, Virginia

About Us

Cardwell Printing is a family-owned printing, signage, apparel, and promotional products company with nearly 50 years in business. We continue to grow and are building a strong team to support our customers and our next chapter.We're looking for an experienced, motivated professional who understands the printing business, enjoys working with customers, can lead a team, and has the initiative to help grow sales.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on leadership position combining print estimating, customer relationships, front-counter team supervision, and inside sales. The right person will help keep daily operations organized, ensure customers receive excellent service, support and develop team members, and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and bring in new business.

Responsibilities

* Print Estimating: Review customer requests, specifications, quantities, and files to prepare accurate, competitive estimates for commercial printing projects.
* Customer Relationships: Work directly with customers to understand their needs, recommend solutions, answer questions, and resolve issues.
* Team Leadership: Oversee and support front-counter and customer service employees, establish clear expectations, and help ensure consistent follow-through.
* Inside Sales: Proactively contact customers, follow up on estimates, develop existing accounts, identify additional sales opportunities, and pursue new business.
* Order Management: Help ensure orders are entered accurately, details are communicated clearly, and jobs move smoothly from estimate through production.
* Workflow Coordination: Work closely with production and other departments to ensure estimates are realistic, deadlines are achievable, and customer expectations are met.
* Process Improvement: Help streamline procedures, improve accountability, and build a more organized, efficient customer service operation.

What We're Looking For

* Experience in commercial printing, print estimating, or a closely related print-production environment.
* Strong understanding of printing processes, materials, specifications, and production costs.
* Previous experience leading, supervising, or mentoring employees.
* Strong customer service, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* A sales mindset and the confidence to initiate conversations, follow up, and pursue opportunities.
* Someone who takes ownership, shows initiative, and can keep multiple priorities moving in a busy environment.
* Dependability, integrity, and a strong work ethic.

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications. We are willing to pay for the right person with the knowledge, leadership ability, and initiative to make a meaningful impact.

Why Join Cardwell Printing?

* Join an established, growing, family-owned business approaching its 50th anniversary.
* Make a meaningful contribution to how the business operates and serves its customers.
* Work with a diverse range of products, including commercial printing, signs, decorated apparel, and promotional merchandise.
* Be part of a team focused on growth, customer relationships, and long-term success.

How to Apply

Please email your resume and a brief introduction outlining your relevant experience to cgibson@cardwellprinting.com.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Billing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**About Professional Diversified Flooring, Inc.**

Professional Diversified Flooring was established in 1981 and is a leading provider of commercial flooring solutions. With a workforce exceeding 70 office employees and over 400 field labor, the company specializes in comprehensive flooring services for commercial spaces throughout Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, and surrounding areas. Leveraging proprietary technology and a distinctive project management methodology, Professional Diversified Flooring ensures meticulous attention to detail in every undertaking. Our portfolio encompasses a wide range of projects, from corporate offices to casinos and from healthcare to hospitality, positioning us not merely as flooring specialists, but as strategic partners in design and construction adding maximum value to our clients and their clients.

**THE ROLE**
------------

Billing at PDF does two things: it bills, and it collects. The Billing Specialist owns both, end to end, for the projects assigned to them — from verifying the contract, through progress billing, pay applications, portal submission, lien releases and retention, to collecting the money and closing the job.

Roughly 60% of your time is billing, 30% is collecting, and 10% is the compliance paperwork that gates payment in construction. You are the customer-facing voice of our accounting department to General Contractor project accountants and End User AP teams, and the person our Project Managers rely on to turn finished work into cash.

This is not a data-entry job. The volume is real — a proficient specialist produces 150–200 billings and around $3 million a month — but the work is judgment: reading a subcontract's billing terms, knowing how much can reasonably be billed on a job, catching an over-billing before the GC does, and knowing how far to push a collection before escalating.

You will report to our Billing Manager and work alongside a small, tight team in our Irvine office. Billing is centralized here and serves all five of our markets.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**
-------------------

### **Project Billing**

* Verify every contract, PO and change order against our system before the first bill goes out.
* Prepare and submit accurate, timely progress billings in the format each customer requires — AIA G702/G703 applications, GC-specific forms, PO-based invoices and system-generated invoices.
* Build and maintain schedules of values; apply startup, change order and retention rules correctly.
* Submit through the customer's billing portal — Textura, GCPay, Procore Pay, Coupa and others — and hit every GC's cutoff.
* Track retention balances and bill retention on time.
* Review Project Manager and customer billing requests daily, and review underbilled jobs weekly to find what can be billed.

### **Lien Waivers & Compliance**

* Prepare conditional and unconditional lien waivers with every billing, using the correct statutory form for California, Nevada or Arizona.
* Manage portal escrow protocols and the release exchange that unlocks payment.
* Identify when a payment is being held for a compliance item — a missing release, certificate of insurance, preliminary notice or certified payroll — and route it to the right person fast.
* Serve as a Notary Public to authenticate billing and waiver documents (company will sponsor certification if you are not currently a notary).

### **Collections & Reconciliation**

* Monitor AR aging for your projects and follow up proactively with GC accounts payable departments.
* Research and resolve billing discrepancies, short-payments and rejected invoices quickly.
* Maintain accurate, current collection notes in the system on every contact.
* Know the thresholds — when a receivable is normal, when it needs a call, and when it needs your manager.

### **Communication & System Discipline**

* Handle all customer billing correspondence through our Salesforce case system — every project and every billing has a cas

jobs.title: Dispatcher Assistant
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Dispatcher Assistant and be a vital part of our transportation and logistics operations! In this energetic role, you will support the coordination of vehicle dispatching, manage communication channels, and assist in streamlining supply chain activities. Your proactive approach will ensure smooth road transportation operations, enhance customer service experiences, and uphold compliance with DOT (Department of Transportation) regulations. This position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your organizational and analysis skills while contributing to efficient freight movement and fleet management.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in scheduling and dispatching vehicles using transportation management systems and vehicle dispatch software to optimize routes and delivery times
* Manage multi-line phone systems to handle inquiries from drivers, clients, and internal teams with professionalism and clear communication
* Support GPS and GIS (Geographic Information Systems) tools to monitor vehicle locations, improve routing accuracy, and enhance transportation planning
* Enter data accurately into logistics databases such as Oracle Transportation Management, ensuring all shipment details are up-to-date
* Coordinate shipping & receiving activities, including freight documentation, vehicle loading/unloading schedules, and tracking shipments in real-time
* Communicate effectively with drivers, customers, and internal departments via phone calls and internal messaging platforms to relay updates or resolve issues promptly
* Assist in maintaining compliance with DOT regulations by monitoring driver hours, vehicle inspections, and safety protocols

**Experience**

* Prior experience or familiarity with road transportation operations, logistics, or supply chain management is preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) for data entry, reporting, and analysis tasks
* Knowledge of transportation management systems such as Oracle Transportation Management or similar platforms is advantageous
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills—both verbal and written—and phone etiquette to foster positive interactions with drivers and clients
* Ability to analyze logistical data to identify opportunities for process improvements or route optimization
* Experience working within fleet management or vehicle dispatching environments is a plus

This role is paid and ideal for motivated individuals eager to grow their expertise in transportation planning, logistics coordination, and customer service. If you thrive in a lively environment where your organizational skills make a real impact, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $25.24 - $30.39 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Parental leave
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Dispatcher
jobs.desc:
**Position Summary / General Scope:**

Emergency Medical Dispatcher (EMD) acts as the vital first point of contact for 911 medical emergencies, gathering critical information, determining response levels, and dispatching ambulances while providing pre-arrival instructions to callers. They are responsible for effective communications, call entry, and dispatching for all 911 emergency and non-emergency medical transportation requests. Operating within our 911 Emergency Communications Call Center, this unique telecommunicator position will not only act as a 911 operator, but also as a liaison between healthcare facilities and our medical transportation team to effectively communicate available resources and expected arrival times, schedule non-emergency medical transportation, and ensure timelines are being met or new arrival expectations are set.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Answering and processing emergency and non-emergency calls, rapidly assessing the nature and location of medical emergencies.
* Rapidly gather relevant information
* Dispatch appropriate non-emergency and emergency medical transportation including ALS, BLS, and Wheelchair Van resources
* Provides crucial, step by step medical instructions to callers while responders are en route.
* Review available resources and communicate expected arrival times with healthcare facilities
* Maintain communication and expectations with healthcare facilities
* Monitors field personnel locations, track status, and manage logistics using GPS and CAD systems.
* Maintains accurate, real time records of calls and incident times.
* Multitask data entry 20-30 words per minute with active listening during call processing.
* Maintains knowledge of and complies with all company policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times.
* Must maintain a reliable attendance record
* Completes other duties as requested and assigned

**Education:**

* High school diploma or GED equivalent.

**Licensure, Certification, Registration:**

* EMD Certification
* CPR Certification
* 911 Certification
* Telecommunicator Certification

**Experience:**

* Must have minimal medical training or telecommunications experience, or at least one year of experience as an EMS or Public Safety Dispatcher.
* Experience with computer systems required, including web-based applications and some Microsoft Office applications preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent verbal communication, communicates effectively, both verbally and in writing; ability to understand and carry out verbal and written instructions.
* Ability to speak clearly and concisely, providing detailed information under stressful circumstances.
* Ability to record, transmit and report information accurately.
* Analytical skills to gather and interpret data
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion at all times
* Knowledge of medical terminology preferred, not required.
* Ability to work in fast-paced environment and multi-task
* Ability to work well independently and within a team setting

**Requirements:**

* Day, Evening, Overnight, Weekends and Holidays may be required.
* Ability to meet the essential duties and physical, mental and sensory requirements of the position at all times.
* Comply with UDS drug screening at any and all times

* Satisfactory background check and MA CORI (Criminal Offender Record Information), verification required annually.

**Physical, Mental and Sensory Requirements**

* Ability to hear various frequencies, distinguish sounds and work in environment with consistent background noise.

* Consistent close eye work and clear vision for screens, color/depth perception, and peripheral vision for data analysis and monitoring.
* Clear, concise verbal communication, potentially shouting or speaking loudly over noise, and active listening.
* Fine finger dexterity, repetitive wrist motion regarding computers and dispatch terminal work for prolonged time periods. (fingering, pushing, pulling).

jobs.title: CTM: Project Coordinator
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**

Founded in 2014, CT Mechanical is the commercial mechanical contracting division of Comfort Temp Company. We design, install and service mechanical, plumbing and process piping systems for clients across Florida, with offices in Gainesville, Jacksonville, Orlando and Tampa. We’re known for doing quality work the right way, investing in our people, and staying involved in the communities we build in.

**The Opportunity**

We’re hiring a Project Engineer to be the technical and administrative backbone behind our Project Managers. You’ll own the paperwork, procurement and coordination that keep a mechanical job moving, from the day it’s handed off by estimating to the day the owner signs off at closeout. If you’re early in your career and want real responsibility on commercial projects, with a defined path into project management, this role is built for you.

**What You’ll Do**

*Getting projects started*

* Gather estimate files and scope details from our Estimators, review assumptions, and run turnover meetings for Jacksonville and Gainesville mechanical projects
* Study the plans and specs to confirm scope, spot conflicts or coordination problems, and raise them with the PM before they become field issues

*Submittals, RFIs and documents*

* Create the submittal log directly from the contract documents, chase submittals from suppliers and subs, check them against project requirements, send them for approval, and get approved copies to everyone who needs them
* Catch gaps and discrepancies in the design, write and track RFIs, and push answers out to the field and affected subcontractors
* Keep plan revisions current for our team and our subs, and maintain the project tracking log covering submittals, material releases, POs, subcontracts, signed documents and approved changes

*Buying and tracking*

* Confirm and record lead times for equipment and materials, monitor release and delivery dates, and work with vendors to protect the schedule
* Write and issue purchase orders and subcontracts, with full records of each one and any changes to it
* Handle Owner-Direct Purchase requests from submission through approval and invoicing for owner payment
* Collect project-specific insurance certificates from mechanical subcontractors on Jacksonville and Gainesville jobs

*Changes, schedule and field*

* Help PMs evaluate scope changes by pulling pricing from vendors and subs, building change order proposals, and tracking them to approval
* Make sure subs and field crews always have the latest schedule, and help coordinate with the GC and other trades
* Get out to jobsites as needed to check progress, answer technical questions for the crews, and document field conditions

*Closing it out*

* Assemble O&M manuals: vendor data, start-up reports, as-builts, TAB reports and warranties
* Support commissioning and set up owner training sessions when required

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline (preferred)
* 0–3 years in project engineering, project coordination or similar work in construction or mechanical contracting; internships count
* Able to read and understand mechanical and plumbing drawings and specs; working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing and piping systems is a bonus
* Solid with Excel, Word and Outlook; experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Revit or project management software is a plus
* Organized, detail-focused and comfortable juggling multiple priorities
* A problem-solver who communicates clearly in writing and in person and doesn’t wait to be told what’s next

**How We Work**

Our team runs on four core values: *Do what you say. Do what it takes. Walk with purpose. Do the right thing.* We back those up with a collaborative culture, real investment in your professional growth, and a commitment to the communities we serve.

jobs.desc:
Blue Star Benefits is hiring a part-time Marketing Coordinator to own how clients and prospects hear from us, and fill our calendar with qualified leads.

**About Blue Star Benefits**

Blue Star Benefits is a Kansas City–area health insurance and benefits agency. For years we have helped families, individuals and employers find the right health, dental, life and Medicare coverage. Our clients stay because we know them and pick up the phone. We are a small team, so your work will be seen and will matter.

**Why this role exists**

Our service is strong, but our voice has gone quiet. We need one person who wakes up owning marketing: keeping current clients engaged, telling our story in the community and online, and turning that attention into conversations for our sales lead. You will build this function largely from scratch, with real support and the room to try things.

**What you'll do**

Your job is to generate qualified leads and hand them to Colin, who meets with prospects and closes. You own the marketing; you do not carry a sales quota.

* **Client touchpoints:** Run seasonal check-ins with existing clients and accounts, such as fall and new-year outreach.
* **Campaigns:** Plan and run targeted campaigns, including employer group renewal reminders, policy upsell outreach and a direct-mail postcard campaign with a QR-code call to action.
* **Content:** Create short-form video and social content (YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook) and a quarterly newsletter on what's changing in health insurance.
* **CRM:** Help stand up and maintain HubSpot. Keep contacts, campaigns and lead handoffs clean and tracked.
* **Website:** Partner with our web designer to refresh the site and keep it current.
* **Community:** Represent Blue Star at local events and in the community.
* **Listening:** Survey clients to uncover needs they haven't voiced, and feed what you learn back to the team.
* **Reporting:** Report monthly on what you ran, what it cost and which leads it produced.

**What you bring**

***Must-haves***

* Experience in health, life or dental insurance. A license is not required.
* Hands-on modern marketing experience, including HubSpot or a similar CRM, plus short-form video and social content.
* A track record of marketing goals you set and the results you drove, with numbers you can share.
* A personable, presentable style; you're comfortable as the friendly face of the company in the community.
* A proactive streak: you see the next step, propose it and check in before acting.

***Nice-to-haves***

* Experience with Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas City.
* Experience running client surveys or interviews.
* Direct-mail or email campaign experience.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note about one marketing campaign you ran: the goal, what you did and what happened. A link to content you've created is a plus.

**Company Description**

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace! We are a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you!

 **Job Description**

The College of Arts & Letters Office for Undergraduate Studies and Advising is seeking a highly organized, collaborative, and service-oriented **Administrative Coordinator** to support undergraduate advising and academic administration. This role serves as a welcoming first point of contact for students, faculty, staff, and visitors and helps foster a responsive, student-centered office environment.

As one of three Administrative Coordinators, this position works closely with fellow coordinators, the director, assistant deans, and collegiate academic advisors to support the day-to-day operations of the office. The Administrative Coordinator supports advising operations, student records and academic processes, transfer student administration, faculty processes, and special projects, helping ensure the office runs smoothly and students receive timely and effective support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reception & Advising Support**

* Serve as a welcoming first point of contact for students, faculty, staff, and visitors
* Assist students with scheduling and connecting with deans, advisors, departments, and other campus resources
* Manage calendars and scheduling for undergraduate deans and collegiate academic advisors
* Collaborate with fellow Administrative Coordinators to provide consistent front-office coverage and support

**Academic & Student Administration**

* Support administrative processes for transfer and readmitted students, including verification of transfer course information
* Maintain student records, route academic forms, and monitor advising assignments
* Use University systems, including OnBase, Banner, Google Workspace, Business Objects, eForms, and the Advising Kiosk, to support academic administration

**Office Operations & Administrative Support**

* Provide administrative support for office communications, records, data collection, and reporting
* Monitor the office operational budget and provide regular updates to the director
* Assist with faculty and staff hiring, office events, College and University events, and special projects

**Faculty & Personnel Support**

* Coordinate timelines, scheduling, and documentation for faculty reappointment and promotion processes
* Work with the Dean’s Office, Provost’s Office, and other campus partners to ensure required materials and processes are completed accurately and on time
* Maintain confidential student, faculty, and personnel information with discretion

  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED with 1–2 years of administrative or related professional experience
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent interpersonal, customer service, and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, establish priorities, and respond effectively to interruptions
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and campus partners
* Demonstrated discretion and professionalism when handling confidential student, faculty, and personnel information
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Google Workspace app

jobs.desc:
**Payroll & Certified Payroll Specialist**

**About the Company**

Our client is an established, growing contractor serving public and private projects. They’re looking for a detail-oriented payroll professional to own certified payroll and prevailing wage reporting, keep their people paid accurately, and keep their tax obligations current.

**The Role**

You’ll be the go-to person for certified payroll and prevailing wage compliance on public works projects, while also running weekly payroll and managing payroll tax liabilities. Accuracy, deadline discipline, and clear communication with project teams are essential.

Certified Payroll & Prevailing Wage

* Prepare, review, and submit weekly certified payroll reports for multiple active public works projects, using California DIR systems (such as eCPR) and compliance platforms like LCP Tracker.
* Apply prevailing wage determinations, worker classifications, and fringe benefit requirements correctly to each project, including Davis-Bacon where federal funds apply.
* Track DIR registration and project registration requirements, apprenticeship requirements, and training contributions.
* Reconcile timecards with project managers and field supervisors, and make sure certified payroll matches actual payroll before it’s submitted.
* Respond to audits, agency inquiries, and requests from general contractors and labor compliance programs.
* Keep project files and records complete and audit-ready.

**Payroll Processing**

* Process weekly payroll for field and office staff, including hours, overtime, bonuses, deductions, and garnishments.
* Verify timecards, resolve discrepancies before payroll closes, and answer employee wage questions.
* Maintain compliance with California wage and hour law, including meal and rest breaks, overtime, and final pay requirements.
* Partner with HR and accounting on onboarding, offboarding, and benefits deductions.

**Payroll Tax Liabilities**

* Calculate, deposit, and reconcile federal and state payroll taxes, and file quarterly and annual returns on time.
* Reconcile payroll tax liabilities and payroll accounts to the general ledger, and resolve discrepancies.
* Handle year-end reporting, including W-2s and annual tax reconciliations.
* Respond to tax agency notices and correct filings as needed.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of payroll experience, ideally in construction or another prevailing wage environment.
* Hands-on experience with California certified payroll reporting and prevailing wage requirements, or a strong willingness to learn them quickly with training.
* Working knowledge of federal and California payroll tax requirements, deposits, and filings.
* Working knowledge of California wage and hour law.
* Strong accuracy and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
* Comfort with payroll and accounting software and strong Excel skills.
* Clear, professional communication with field staff, managers, and agencies.

**Nice to have:** DIR and LCP Tracker experience, Davis-Bacon experience, FPC or CPP certification, construction accounting software experience.

**Schedule and Pay**

* On-site, Monday through Friday, with flexible start and end times.
* $32 to $40 per hour, based on experience.

We're a small, independent company building accessibility software that people rely on every day. Founded in 2020, we're profitable and funded entirely by our customers.

Our flagship app, Live Transcribe, turns speech into accurate, real-time captions, even in noisy places like restaurants. It helps people who are d/Deaf and hard of hearing participate in conversations with family, friends, colleagues, and healthcare providers. It supports more than 50 languages, works offline, and lets users save and export transcripts.

You're a completionist at heart: you take ownership, close every loop, and make sure the important things get finished without someone chasing you. You instinctively simplify and automate repetitive work, starting with what actually matters.

* Assist with welcoming new staff and acclimating them to the office culture.

***2. Safety Support***

* Monitor clients entering and exiting the space for weapons, and maintain bike tracking and storage.
* Supervise clients, staff, and the general public who may be waiting in lobby or front desk areas.

***3. Administrative Support***

* Organize and manage the front desk, documents, and relevant paperwork while removing any clutter.
* Answer front desk phone calls while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
* Answer and forward general inquiries sent to the inbox.

jobs.title: Legal Billing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Legal Billing Specialist**
============================

**Hybrid | Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Irvine, CA**

Tucker Ellis LLP is seeking an experienced Legal Billing Specialist to join our Billing team. This position may be based out of our Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Irvine office locations and offers a hybrid work schedule.

The Legal Billing Specialist will be responsible for managing the billing lifecycle for the firm's Litigation and Corporate practice groups, including complex commercial litigation, labor and employment matters, real estate, mergers and acquisitions, corporate governance, finance, and other transactional matters. This position requires a strong understanding of legal billing requirements, client guidelines, matter structures, timekeeping, electronic billing, and invoice submission processes. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of two years of hands-on law firm billing experience and be comfortable working directly with attorneys, clients, and accounting personnel.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage the end-to-end billing process for Litigation and Corporate matters, including complex commercial litigation, labor and employment, real estate, finance, mergers and acquisitions, and general corporate matters
* Prepare, review, finalize, and submit monthly invoices in accordance with client-specific billing arrangements and deadlines
* Review attorney, paralegal, and other timekeeper entries for accuracy, appropriate billing descriptions, task/activity codes, and compliance with client requirements
* Review invoices for compliance with client-specific billing guidelines and outside counsel billing requirements
* Review and process matter-related costs and disbursements, including court filing fees, deposition expenses, expert witness charges, travel expenses, research charges, and transaction-related costs
* Ensure appropriate billing treatment of retainers, advances, flat fees, success fees, alternative fee arrangements, and other client-specific billing structures
* Monitor electronic invoices submitted through client billing platforms and resolve rejected, short-paid, or disputed invoices
* Research and correct billing rejections related to LEDES formatting, UTBMS codes, task/activity codes, time entries, expense classifications, invoice narratives, and client billing guidelines
* Establish working relationships with eBilling vendors; ensure all timekeepers and rates are current within billing platforms and submit updates for client approval as needed
* Track invoice status and follow up on outstanding invoices to ensure timely payment
* Work closely with attorneys, legal assistants, paralegals, and accounting staff to identify and resolve billing discrepancies
* Review client billing guidelines for changes that may impact billing practices and ensure invoices remain compliant with current requirements
* Assist with matter billing transfers, write-offs, adjustments, credit memos, and invoice revisions as needed
* Maintain accurate billing records, client billing profiles, matter information, and supporting documentation
* Assist with month-end and year-end billing processes, including reporting, reconciliation, and outstanding billing review
* Assist billing attorneys with special reporting and various client-specific reports
* Prepare and submit client accruals and other financial reports
* Communicate with clients regarding invoice questions, billing discrepancies, rejected invoices, and payment issues
* Identify recurring billing issues and recommend improvements to billing procedures and workflows
* Maintain a working knowledge of electronic billing systems, client-specific billing requirements, and law firm accounting procedures
* Assist with other administrative tasks and special projects as needed

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of two years of direct legal billing experience within a law firm is required
* High School Diploma or GED required

jobs.title: Deployment Operations Coordinator
jobs.desc:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric aircraft. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org builds consumer software for the general aviation industry. There's a lot we're not ready to talk about publicly yet, so this posting stays vague on purpose. What we can say: the products are real, they ship, and people use them every day.  
  
As the Deployment Operations Coordinator, you'll identify, research, and secure host locations near airports for Vantage receiver installations. You'll be the first point of contact with prospective host businesses — researching candidate sites, cold-calling and emailing property owners and operators, and negotiating hosting agreements — then handing off clean, well-documented sites to the Deployment Engineering team for installation. You'll also assist with the backend administrative work that keeps the pipeline moving: tracking outreach, processing agreements and paperwork, and coordinating scheduling between hosts and the field team.

This role involves equal parts research, phone/email outreach, and the follow-through to keep every site moving from first contact to signed agreement to install-ready.

### **Research & Outreach:**

* Identify candidate businesses near target airports suitable for hosting Vantage receivers (rooftop access, line-of-sight, power availability, etc.)
* Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective host sites, researching ownership, decision-makers, and site suitability before outreach
* Cold-call and email property/business owners to pitch hosting the equipment, answer questions, and move interested parties toward an agreement
* Track outreach activity, responses, and pipeline status in a CRM or tracking system

### **Site Agreements & Backend Operations:**

* Draft, send, and track hosting agreements and related paperwork through signature
* Maintain accurate records for each site: contact info, agreement status, site specs, and any special access/logistics notes
* Coordinate scheduling and handoff of signed, install-ready sites to the Deployment Engineering team
* Support general program administration — reporting on pipeline metrics, maintaining site databases, and flagging bottlenecks

### **Coordination:**

* Act as liaison between host businesses and Archer's field team before and after install (initial site walk questions, access coordination, follow-up)
* Communicate professionally and persistently with businesses that may be unfamiliar with the technology or hesitant to host equipment

  

About The Team:  
AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the products themselves are early. If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. Apply, and we'll tell you plenty.

Signarama Montco is hiring a Bookkeeper to keep our books accurate and current, with additional work supporting a group of outside small-business clients.

You will also support bookkeeping for a select group of other small-business clients, most of whom run on QuickBooks Online (QBO).

* **Reports to:** Owner

Key responsibilities

**Signarama Montco bookkeeping**

* Record and categorize bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Create customer invoices for sign and graphics projects, including deposits and progress billing.
* Apply customer payments and follow up on open receivables.
* Reconcile bank, credit card and loan accounts each month and support month-end close.
* Record payroll journal entries and assist with sales tax tracking and filings.

**Outside client bookkeeping**

* Maintain the books for a select group of other small-business clients in QBO.

* Request missing receipts and statements and answer routine client questions.
* Assist with cleanup and catch-up projects for new clients.

**Recordkeeping and year-end**

* Keep financial documents organized and audit- and tax-ready.
* Track W-9s and prepare information for year-end 1099s.
* Coordinate with the outside CPA on year-end packages.

Qualifications

**Required**

* 2–3+ years of bookkeeping experience.
* Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience with bank feeds, reconciliations, AP and AR.
* Solid understanding of debits, credits and basic accounting principles.
* High attention to detail and accuracy with numbers.
* Ability to juggle several client files and deadlines at once.
* Clear, professional written and phone communication with clients.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field.
* QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.
* Experience at an accounting firm or managing multiple client books.
* Familiarity with Bill.com, Gusto, Expensify, Dext or similar tools.
* Experience with job-based billing, customer deposits or cleanup bookkeeping projects.

Compensation and benefits

**Pay range: $24 – $31 per hour (about $50,000 – $65,000 per year)**, commensurate with experience. Candidates with QBO ProAdvisor certification and multi-client firm experience may be considered up to about $68,000.

* Health, dental and vision insurance
* 10 days paid time off
* Paid holidays

Work environment and how to apply

This is a hands-on role on a small, close-knit team. You will see the full financial side of a busy sign and graphics business while gaining experience across other industries through our outside clients. Busy periods include month-end and January–April year-end season.

To apply, submit your resume and a short note on your QuickBooks Online experience through this posting.

Signarama Montco is an equal opportunity employer.

Flexible work from home options available.

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchise. All inquiries about employment at this franchise should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to Signarama Corporate.

**Background:**

Since 1993, SEPA Mujer has been a vital grassroots non-profit organization dedicated to social change, women’s rights, immigrant rights, and other crucial issues. As the only Latina Rights Organization of its kind, we provide safe spaces for empowerment, leadership development, civic engagement, and legal assistance. Our impactful work is achieved through unique training, workshops, monthly meetings, presentations, tabling, press work, and action-oriented engagement.

We are a small, dedicated team, yet our impact in the community is profound. We pride ourselves on bridging essential services and resources to the community we serve, having built a deep foundation of trust over the decades.

**Job Description: About the Role**

The Thriving Latinas Project Coordinator will be responsible for all aspects of program coordination for our Thriving Latinas Program. This program is part of the Culturally Specific Services Program (CSSP), funded through the Department of Justice - Office for Violence Against Women. The CSSP's primary goal is to support victims of domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking in obtaining and maintaining stability in their lives. Our goal is to serve a client base composed of 50% survivors of sexual assault (SA) and 50% survivors of other victimizations.

To provide this critical support, SEPA Mujer offers to clients:

* Case management
* Financial literacy classes
* Housing search, education, and housing rights
* English as a Second Language (ESL) instruction
* Arte para la sanación y la unión

We are looking for **empathetic individuals who are passionate about helping and truly committed to public service** within our community. This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to make a tangible difference in the lives of those we serve.

* Recruit new participants for the Thriving Latinas Program and complete intakes.
* Maintain relationships and participation of current Thriving Latinas participants.
* Coordinate with instructors and schedule program classes/workshops such as ESL, Art Class, etc.
* Promote the classes within the community and create flyers and other materials to effectively market them.
* Work with women individually and in groups to build positive self-esteem and confidence.
* Support participants in identifying and setting goals for their future.
