* Help participants achieve financial stability through financial literacy training.
* Guide participants through the job search process, including resume preparation for various roles.
* Provide comprehensive guidance for interview preparedness, covering language, appropriate attire, and practicing communication skills.
* Facilitate computer literacy workshops with the assistance of interns/volunteers.
* Work collaboratively with the project team, SEPA Mujer staff, and program partners.
* Provide referrals to existing SEPA Mujer services (e.g., AYUDA Latina hotline, legal immigration case relief services, counseling, cash assistance, housing services) as well as external referrals to partner agencies and other resources.
* Plan and coordinate the yearly Thriving Latinas Expo in collaboration with cultural partners.

**Job Title: Office Manager**

**Reports to: Regional Manager/Operations Manager**

PCC Medical Holding, LLC (Physician Care Centers) is a dynamic and fast-growing company of primary medical offices throughout the country. Specializing in family medicine and the Medicare population, we have grown to more than 50 clinics, 90 providers, and 500 employees spanning Florida, Georgia, South Carolina and Texas. Our goal is to guide our patients to healthy and enjoyable lives.

Our culture is to be intentionally kind to one another by treating each other with respect and empathy. The most impactful leadership lessons are taught by example. In leading, teaching, and coaching our organization to demonstrate the care, tolerance, and respect we want to see, we lead by example throughout our organization.

**Job Summary:**

Office Managers oversee the completion of various administrative tasks with the practice concentrating on staff supervision, training, evaluating staff performance, scheduling staff for workflow, hiring/maintaining administrative team, maintain office budget, backing up all administrative positions in the office, coordination of all staff activity as well as the maximization of patient flow, productivity, and teamwork.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Manage a team of administrative office staff including Medical Assistants, Front Desk associates, Scribes, Phlebotomists, etc.
* Manage day-to-day operations of the practice by planning, organizing, and managing time effectively to facilitate patient flow, billings, and scheduling.
* Ensure steady workflows and uninterrupted service to our patients.
* Ensure compliance with current healthcare regulations, medical laws, and high ethical standards.
* Work closely with our EHR and RCM departments to identify and resolve patient account discrepancies, inconsistencies, and specific individual requirements.
* Review insurance EOBs and action, as necessary.
* Oversee hiring process.
* Represent our business in a professional manner and demonstrate exemplary customer service.
* Ensure a professional work culture; always demonstrate respect for all.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Medical coding for office procedures
* Knowledge of medical terminology.
* Healthcare technology aptitude.
* Ability to manage medical records discreetly and professionally.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical and data management skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks.
* Diagnostic and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software, EMR software applications, applicable medical codes.
* Emotional intelligence.

**Education and Experience:**

High school diploma or equivalent.

Previous Medical Office Management experience required; degree preferred.

Additional certification is useful such as Professional Association of Health Care Office Management (PAHCOM), Medical Assistant certification, RN, CNA, etc.

At least three years of Medical Office Management experience required.

**Physical Requirements:**

Prolonged periods of standing and/or sitting.

Frequently required to walk, sit, use hands and finger, stoop, kneel, crouch.

Required to talk and hear clearly.

English is required, secondary language is a plus.

Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

Vision requirements include close and distance vision, color, peripheral, depth perception, and ability to adjust your focus.

**Available Benefits**

Medical, dental, vision, GAP, short-term disability, life insurance, spouse and/or child life insurance, hospital indemnity, accident, etc.

Paid holiday and PTO for all full-time employees.

**Coordination & Business Execution**

**Office Manager**

**EFP Industrial Automation – Dayton, OH**  
**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary**

EFP Industrial Automation, a leading automation solutions distributor is seeking a detail-oriented Office Manager. This position plays a key role in maintaining accurate financial and operational records, resolving transaction discrepancies, supporting employee processes, and keeping essential work moving across departments in a growth focused industrial distribution environment.

The ideal candidate will bring strong accounting and ERP knowledge, sound judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to coordinate priorities and provide practical support across Accounting, Shipping/Receiving, and general office operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Process payroll, accounts receivable, and accounts payable, including monthly bank reconciliations and sales tax reporting.
* Process returns and RMAs as needed.
* Verify invoicing and resolve billing exceptions and transaction discrepancies.
* Confirm direct shipped orders from our manufacturers to our customers ensuring pricing, order, and shipping details are accurately followed.
* Oversee shipping and receiving personnel, review discrepancies, and provide guidance on resolutions.
* Monitor and maintain necessary office supply stock for all in-office departments.
* Spot check inventory cycle counts and update ERP for confirmed discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department leads during unexpected employee absences to ensure essential tasks are covered.
* Support recruiting, employee onboarding, and PTO recordkeeping.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organization, attention to detail, discretion, and follow-through.
* Working knowledge of accounting transactions, payroll support, collections, reconciliations, and basic financial controls.
* Ability to review pricing, freight, and order details and make informed processing decisions.
* Clear, professional communication with customers, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Solid understanding of ERP processes, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, Direct Ship Confirmations, Convert to Voucher, and RMAs. (Epicor Prophet 21 preferred)
* Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to delegate duties as needed to maintain efficient office operations.

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Retirement Plan
* Vacation & Sick Time (PTO)

**Work Environment**

* Collaborative Office environment with light warehouse interaction (supporting shipping/receiving as needed)

· Collaborative environment that values communication, reliability, and quality work

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

**Company:** CABS HeatingAir Conditioning

**Location:** West Sacramento, CA (in office 4 days, 1 day from home)

**Type:** Full-time, hourly

* This is mostly in the office: four days a week in West Sacramento and one day from home. Learning happens fastest side by side.
* Starting pay is $22 per hour while you train. It climbs to $26 per hour as you take on more, and we spell out below exactly what earns each raise.

**Now the good news**

1. No phone duty. You are not on the customer phone line. Your time goes to projects, start to finish.

2. Flexible hours. Full-time, Monday through Friday. You and your lead set your daily schedule within our business hours.

3. You inherit a full AI team on day one. The agents, their instructions, and the systems are already built. You learn to run them, not build them from scratch.

4. We teach you. You do not need a degree. One year of work experience is enough, and you do not need to be a programmer. If you can explain a task clearly in plain English and check the result, we will teach you the rest.5. Your raises are tied to skills, not to waiting. Three clear steps, from $22 to $26 per hour, each one unlocked by work you can show.

6. You learn how a real business runs from the inside: operations, marketing, payroll, and accounting.

8. Variety. No two weeks look the same.

9. Health, vision, and dental insurance after 60 days. Paid sick leave, birthday pay, and paid vacation.

**Your first 90 days**

* Days 1 to 30: you work side by side with our operations lead, learn the AI agents, and take over two recurring weekly tasks.
* Days 31 to 60: you run those on your own and start picking up projects in marketing and office operations.
* Days 61 to 90: you carry projects from start to finish and begin learning payroll prep and accounting workflows.

* Step 2, Independent: $24 per hour once you run at least three recurring workflows on your own.

The Department of Pathology, Microbiology and Immunology is one of six academic departments in the School of Veterinary Medicine; it provides a unique and critical linkage between the basic and clinical sciences. jobs.title: Full Charge Bookkeeper (Controller Track)
jobs.desc:
Every great celebration has a number behind it. We're looking for the person who knows them all.

It's Saturday night in San Carlos. In one room, 250 guests are raising a glass at a wedding our team has spent nine months planning. Across the property, every one of the Osteria's 100 seats is full: handmade pizza is coming off the line, the bar is pouring wine made a few steps away, and the tasting room is still buzzing.

By Monday morning, all of it turns into numbers. There's a client deposit to apply, a Toast batch to tie out, tips to pay correctly, and a gala invoice to send. That's where you come in.

Who we are

Domenico is a family-owned hospitality company with an award-winning urban winery at its heart. **Domenico Catering & Events** produces about 300 events a year: weddings, galas, corporate dinners, and some of the Bay Area's best-known company celebrations, at our venue and off-site. On the same property we have **T****he Osteria at Domenico Winery**, our 100-seat Italian restaurant, tasting room and bar. This is a big chapter for us as two businesses become one team, and we're bringing our accounting back in-house. We want someone to build that function with us from day one.

We run on **GRAPES**: Gratitude, Respect, Accountability, Positivity, Excellence and Synergy. In accounting, that comes down to something simple: the numbers tie out, and everyone trusts them.

The role

You'll be our **Full-Charge Bookkeeper**, the person who owns the books for both businesses end to end. This is not a back-office data-entry job. You'll sit at the center of the company, working directly with our CEO and COO and sitting in on our monthly P&L review.

We've also built a real path for you. Over 12–24 months, we'll train you into **controller-level work**: budgets, cash flow forecasting, and P&L analysis for each business line. As you show you're ready, your title and pay grow with you.

What your week looks like

* **Restaurant and bar:** Tie out each day's Toast sales, including card batches, merchant fees, cash, gift cards and tips. Every dollar should land where it belongs.
* **Catering:** Track client deposits from the day a contract is signed to the day the last guest leaves. Then move them to revenue, send final invoices, and keep receivables healthy.
* **Payables:** Code vendor invoices in MarginEdge, set up new vendors, and run the weekly payment batch. That includes the florist who needs a check on the day of the event.
* **Payroll:** Own semi-monthly payroll across our entities in BambooHR. That means getting tips, service charges and California wage and hour rules right, every time.
* **Month-end:** Close the books by the 10th business day. That includes reconciliations, accruals, and a P&L for each business line that ownership actually uses to make decisions.
* **Compliance:** Sales tax filings, 1099s, year-end schedules for our CPA, and the internal controls that keep everyone honest.

In your first 90 days, you'll also take over our QuickBooks file from our outside accounting firm and set up the Osteria's books. It's a rare chance to build things the right way from the start.

You might be our person if you…

jobs.title: HR Service Center Customer Service Manager
jobs.desc:
Stanford University is one of the world’s premier academic and research institutions, devoting tremendous intellectual and physical resources toward the betterment of humanity. As a major Silicon Valley employer, Stanford seeks people committed to excellence and to improving our world. In turn, the university is committed to supporting its employees as they develop their careers and enrich their lives.

University Human Resources (UHR) is seeking a  
 **Customer Service Manager**  
to lead two teams within Stanford’s Human Resources Service Center (HRSC). The HRSC provides timely, accurate, and effective support to employees across the university, including academic staff, non-academic staff, postdoctoral scholars, and student employees.

You’ll also help the teams strengthen service delivery and support employees as Stanford continues to adopt and optimize Sequoia, its new Oracle HCM system. This position offers an opportunity to shape a growing service organization, develop team capabilities, and establish practices that support consistent, high-quality service.

Reporting to the HRSC Senior Director, the Customer Service Manager oversees the daily operations and performance of the Tier 1 HR inquiry and I-9 service teams. These teams serve as the first point of contact for HR questions and provide university-wide I-9 processing and compliance support. The manager will supervise approximately five direct reports and provide operational leadership, strategic direction, and staff development oversight for approximately 15–20 employees across both teams.

The successful candidate will bring a strong customer service orientation, experience leading teams through organizational and technology changes, and the ability to translate service needs into practical improvements. A background in HR operations and benefits is preferred.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement with a minimum of 2 days/week, based at Stanford’s Redwood City campus, with occasional travel to the Palo Alto campus to oversee and support I-9 service delivery and team performance.

**In this role you will:**

* Lead the daily operations of the Tier 1 HR inquiry and I-9 service teams, ensuring timely, accurate, consistent, and responsive support for the Stanford community.
  
* Supervise approximately five direct reports and guide performance management, coaching, and professional development for a broader organization of approximately 15–20 staff.
  
* Guide teams through the implementation of Sequoia and ongoing changes to HR systems, processes, and service expectations, translating organizational priorities into clear actions and responsibilities.
  
* Build team credibility and strong working relationships with campus partners through reliable service, clear communication, and effective resolution of escalated inquiries.
  
* Establish and monitor service expectations, performance measures, and reporting practices to assess workload, identify trends, and improve service quality and operational efficiency.
  
* Oversee I-9 processing and related compliance activities, partnering with appropriate university stakeholders to address complex issues and maintain consistent practices.
  
* Identify and lead process improvement initiatives that streamline HR inquiry handling, I-9 services, and the employee experience.
  
* Develop team capabilities through training, knowledge sharing, and cross-training to strengthen HR expertise and prepare for future service expansion.
  
* Partner with HR subject matter experts and technology teams to maintain accurate service resources, clarify escalation pathways, and support effective use of HCM, case management, and telephony systems.
  
* Foster a collaborative team environment that supports accountability, open communication, adaptability, and continuous learning.
  
* Travel occasionally to the Palo Alto campus to support I-9 operations, staff development, and service performance.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Tenant Improvement Project Coordinator to join our Commercial Property Management team in Los Angeles, CA.

You'll help oversee project schedules, bid packages, change orders, and budgets while identifying value engineering opportunities to keep projects on time and on spec. The ideal candidate brings 2–3 years of project experience, knowledge of construction and building codes, and strong communication and leadership skills.

The Project Coordinator works in a team environment with Leasing, Design, and Project Managers. The primary responsibilities of this role are to estimate and manage tenant or capital improvement projects from the earliest conceptual phase up to and through final completion and closeout. This may include running multiple projects simultaneously, performing responsibilities such as planning, schedules, executing contracts, acquiring resources, and third-party contractors or consultants to deliver projects according to schedule. This position provides the planning, organization, direction, coordination, and control to successfully deliver on projects assigned.

**Perks & Benefits:**

When you feel good, you do good. At Onni we put your health at the forefront and give you the choice to select a benefits package that best represents you. From no cost to $19, $45, or $118 per pay our PPO, HSA, and HMO have you covered. In addition, we offer:

---------------------

* Responsible for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and overall closure of assigned tenant improvement projects as well as assist with other projects

* Coordinates tenant improvement construction projects, and in collaboration with site staff, subcontractors, architects, and engineers

We provide swim instruction to our community that builds confidence and develops safety skills in a student-centered environment. Every day is different, with opportunities to make lasting impressions engaging children and families. This is a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace.

* It's a fun, creative, flip flop friendly environment

===========================================

**City of Industry, California | On-site | Full-Time | Direct Hire | 3+ Years**

You will run full-cycle, bi-weekly payroll for multiple locations across different states and support the accounting team with general ledger, reconciliations and month-end close.

**THE CHALLENGE**
-----------------

Payroll across several states means different wage-and-hour rules, tax filings and deductions every cycle. The company needs a specialist who processes payroll independently and accurately, keeps payroll, HRIS and ERP data aligned, and closes the loop with accounting.

It is a hands-on, on-site role that combines payroll ownership with day-to-day accounting support for Finance and HR.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* Manage **full-cycle, bi-weekly payroll** for multiple locations across different states.
* Review and validate timecards, attendance records, payroll adjustments and employee information.
* Process payroll adjustments, manual checks, off-cycle payments and deductions.
* Reconcile payroll reports, maintain accurate records and prepare payroll-related **journal entries**.
* Ensure compliance with **federal, state and local payroll laws**, including wage and hour regulations.
* Process garnishments, tax levies, child support orders and benefit deductions.
* Coordinate payroll tax filings, **W-2 processing** and year-end reconciliations.
* Maintain accurate payroll data within payroll, HRIS and ERP systems.
* Assist with **general ledger** maintenance, account reconciliations and journal entries.
* Support accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) activities.
* Assist with month-end closing, financial reporting and the preparation and review of P&L statements.
* Support management with financial reviews, budgeting and financial analysis, and resolve accounting discrepancies.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
---------------------------

* Minimum **3 years of hands-on payroll processing** experience.
* Minimum **3 years of multi-state payroll** experience.
* Experience **independently managing full-cycle payroll**.
* Hands-on experience with **general ledger accounting, journal entries and account reconciliations**.
* Strong understanding of federal, state and local payroll laws and regulations.
* Proficiency with **payroll software, HRIS systems and Microsoft Excel**.
* High school diploma or GED.

**POSITION DETAILS**

Work arrangement: On-site  
Schedule: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years in payroll, including multi-state payroll  
Start date: As soon as possible  
Location: City of Industry, California, United States

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; company-paid life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; a 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution; paid vacation, sick time and holidays; an annual bonus; flexible spending accounts (FSA); an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and voluntary supplemental insurance options. Relocation: limited assistance.

The part-time Office Assistant will play an important role in the Development Services Department’s Master File Project, a major initiative to organize, preserve, and modernize decades of Planning and Engineering records. Working as part of the project team, this position will help review and organize historical files, prepare and scan records, identify and categorize documents, enter and verify project information, and apply established naming, indexing, and records-management standards. Because the accuracy and consistency of this work will directly affect how easily records can be located and used in the future, the Office Assistant will be a key contributor to the overall quality and success of the project—not simply providing clerical support but helping create the foundation for a reliable and searchable electronic records system.
  
  
This assignment also provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with a large-scale municipal records modernization project. The Office Assistant will develop skills in records management, document digitization, electronic filing systems, data entry, quality control, metadata and indexing, and the organization of Planning and Engineering records, while gaining exposure to how local government projects and development records are maintained throughout their lifecycle. At a broader level, the position will contribute to preserving the City’s institutional history and transforming thousands of legacy paper records into an organized digital resource that will improve access to information, support more efficient City operations, and make these records easier for staff and future generations to find and use.

The ideal candidate is dependable, highly organized, comfortable working with both paper and electronic records, and able to consistently follow established file structures, naming conventions, and document-handling procedures.

* Solving the occasional mystery of a missing, duplicate, or misplaced document.
* Working independently on focused projects while still being part of a collaborative team.
* Using scanners, spreadsheets, and electronic folders to make information easier to find.
* Knowing that your careful work will help preserve important planning and engineering records for years to come.

You do not need prior experience with planning or engineering records to be successful. We are looking for someone who is dependable, organized, comfortable learning new filing systems, and genuinely enjoys detailed work done well.

**Willow Creek Health Care Center**

**Be the Welcoming Face of Our Community**
------------------------------------------

Willow Creek Health Care Center is seeking a friendly, professional, and dependable **Part-Time Receptionist** to join our administrative team. As the first point of contact for residents, families, visitors, and community partners, the Receptionist plays an important role in creating a warm and positive experience.

**This is a clerical position located in the Reception/Administrative area and has no clinical responsibilities or resident-care duties.**

-----------------------------------------

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Previous receptionist, administrative, clerical, or customer-service experience preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, standard clerical functions, and multiline telephone systems.
* Excellent customer-service and interpersonal skills.
* Professional telephone etiquette and a friendly demeanor.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
* Strong organization, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage interruptions and multiple responsibilities calmly.
* Dependable attendance and a cooperative, team-oriented attitude.
* Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

This position requires regular sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, reading, and prolonged computer use. Frequent use of telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines, calculators, and other office equipment is required. The employee may occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds. No travel is required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

---------------------------------------------

* Competitive pay of **$17.50–$18.00 per hour**
* Part-time scheduling

* Training and professional-development opportunities
* Welcoming and resident-centered work environment
* Opportunity to make a positive first impression for residents and families

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Mendoza Companies is a multi-entity ecosystem of construction, services, and investment businesses operating under The Mendoza Way. The platform includes High-Light Electric, Inc. (HLE) — a California-based union electrical infrastructure contractor founded in 1996 delivering public works and complex electrical construction across California — along with Mendoza Trust and an international independent contractor workforce.

When you join Mendoza, you are not just taking a job. You are joining a mission and embracing a purpose.

**THE ROLE**

The Payroll Clerk plays an essential role in maintaining accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations, with a particular focus on **Certified Payroll, California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) requirements, and union-related payroll compliance.**

This position is responsible for preparing and uploading Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs), validating employee classifications and pay rates, reconciling timecards, maintaining payroll records, and supporting compliance with applicable wage and hour regulations.

Working closely with Human Resources, Finance, Field Operations, and other internal teams, the Payroll Clerk helps ensure payroll information is accurate, properly documented, and ready for audits or compliance reviews.

This opportunity is well suited for someone with experience in payroll and Certified Payroll requirements who enjoys working with numbers, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining organized, reliable processes.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong attention to detail, confidentiality, accountability, and follow-through while reflecting The Mendoza Way: professionalism, respect, and service.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Prepare and upload payroll certifications (CPRs) in compliance with DIR and union rules, ensuring backups for audits, labor audits, or internal validation/testing.
* Validate job classifications and collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) by employee and project, coordinating responses with Compliance and Management.
* Process salary adjustments, garnishments, and retroactive payments in a timely and accurate manner, aligning rates according to union updates and HR guidelines.
* Monitor benefits, fringes, and payment dates, supporting internal audits and preventative corrections.
* Reconcile timecards and work records weekly with systems such as Vista and Procore, verifying overtime and special classifications.
* Resolve anomalies in records with the Office and Projects teams, keeping union and administrative documentation up to date.
* Prepare union and government reports, including fringe summaries, and maintain systems ready for audits.
* Assist in compliance with CA Prevailing Wage requirements as applicable.
* Access time & attendance and payroll records, and compile reports as requested.
* Utilize and maintain systems, procedures and policies for payroll/HR/accounting functions to ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Track and report key functional metrics to reduce waste and improve payroll effectiveness.
* Collaborate with key people to ensure payroll accuracy, integrity, and responsiveness.
* Maintain immaculate and accurate records relating to payroll, expense reimbursements, and benefits.
* Recommend and enforce policies and procedures for payroll activities.
* Create monthly reports to management as needed.
* Assist with, and/or run special projects as directed by the Office Manager and/or Director of HR, or help with any payroll or HR projects or activities as needed subject to availability.

jobs.desc:
The Portsmouth Humane Society (PHS) is a private, non-profit organization that is contracted by the City of Portsmouth to provide animal sheltering services. Annually, we intake around 3,000 animals, most of which are cats/kittens or dogs/puppies. Our mission is to create a safe, compassionate, inclusive community for people and animals through education and resource programs that elevate animal welfare standards and champion the human-animal bond. PHS daily operations are supported by a small staff of animal welfare professionals. Additionally, we rely on the support of our Board of Directors, volunteers, foster caregivers, sponsors, donors, and the community.

**Administrative Coordinator**

The Administrative Coordinator oversees the daily operations of the Portsmouth Humane Society front desk and supervises front-desk and administrative staff. This position ensures that administrative functions are performed accurately, professionally, and in accordance with Portsmouth Humane Society policies, applicable Virginia law, local ordinances, and organizational procedures.

The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for animal-related records, customer service, intake and disposition documentation, staff scheduling and training, and collaboration with Animal Control, the Police Department, adopters, fosters, volunteers, and members of the public.

The position requires excellent organizational skills, sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and the ability to appropriately handle confidential, restricted, and legally sensitive information.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Front Desk and Staff Management**

* Oversee daily front-desk operations and ensure appropriate staffing and coverage.
* Supervise, train, schedule, and evaluate front-desk and administrative employees.
* Establish and maintain consistent administrative procedures.
* Monitor completion and accuracy of staff assignments.
* Provide professional and compassionate customer service to the public, adopters, fosters, volunteers, and community partners.
* Handle escalated customer-service issues and refer matters outside the position's authority to appropriate leadership.

**Animal Records and Administrative Compliance**

* Oversee accurate animal intake, reclaim, adoption, transfer, foster, return, and disposition records.
* Ensure required animal custody information is accurately entered and maintained.
* Monitor applicable stray-hold and notification requirements.
* Maintain accurate and organized electronic and physical records.
* Conduct periodic record reviews and correct errors or missing information.
* Ensure records are retained in accordance with applicable law and organizational policy.
* Maintain accurate information in the shelter's animal-management database.

Virginia law requires certain animal custody records to contain specified information and be maintained for at least five years. The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for ensuring front-desk staff follow applicable recordkeeping requirements.

**FOIA & Public Records**

* · Maintain a working knowledge of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and public-records requirements as it relates to Portsmouth Humane.
* Ensure that staff is trained for appropriate record keeping and communications that keep FOIA and other public records requests at front of mind, including emails, texts, and other similar communications.

**Animal Control & Police Department Communications**

* Serve as an administrative liaison with Animal Control and Police Department personnel as directed by leadership.
* Ensure communications with governmental agencies are professional, factual, accurate, and relevant to the matter at hand.
* Ensure staff understand that electronic communications with governmental agencies may be subject to applicable records-retention or disclosure requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of relevant communications.

Overview:

The Neighborhood in Rio Rancho is a welcoming senior living community dedicated to providing exceptional service and care. We are seeking an experienced Business Office Manager to oversee accounting, payroll, billing, and business office operations while supporting residents, department leaders, and the Executive Director.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Oversee daily Business Office operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, resident billing, and payroll support.
* Manage resident billing, collections, census changes, deposits, and financial transactions while ensuring accuracy and exceptional customer service.
* Serve as the primary resource for Workday timekeeping, payroll audits, troubleshooting, and manager training.
* Assist community leadership with budgeting, variance reporting, financial reviews, audits, and vendor management.
* Maintain compliance, financial controls, documentation, and confidentiality while supporting residents, families, vendors, and team members.

**Pay:** $55,000 - $75,000 / annually DOE

**About You**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in full-cycle accounting, accounts payable, business office administration, or a related field preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of accounting principles, internal controls, and financial best practices.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, accounting software, and business applications.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining professionalism, accuracy, and confidentiality.

At our community, your work makes a difference and we want your benefits to make a difference for you, too. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing and life outside of work.

  

* Medical insurance with multiple plan options
* Dental and vision coverage
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid Time Off
* HSA with employer contribution
* Company-paid life and AD&D insurance
* Virtual care medical plan benefits

Additional perks include early wage access through PayActiv, pet insurance, employee appreciation programs and an annual resident appreciation bonus.

Apply Today

If you are a detail-oriented accounting professional who enjoys supporting operations, solving problems, and providing outstanding customer service, we encourage you to apply. Apply today and join The Neighborhood in Rio Rancho team!

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Office Manager to oversee daily administrative operations and ensure the smooth functioning of our office environment. This role is vital in coordinating administrative tasks, managing office systems, and supporting staff to foster an efficient and welcoming workplace. The ideal candidate will bring strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and excellent communication abilities to drive productivity and maintain a positive office atmosphere.

* Handle collections and working Dentrix ascend

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and familiarity with spreadsheets for data organization.

Benefits:

* 401(k)

**Job Overview**

Twin Lakes RV & Tiny Home is seeking an organized, service-focused Office Manager to lead front desk operations and help keep the resort running smoothly. This position combines guest services, staff scheduling, timekeeping and payroll administration, housekeeping coordination, resort-store operations, and purchasing support.

The ideal candidate communicates clearly, maintains accurate records, and follows through on details while working closely with resort leadership and department leads.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily office operations, front desk coverage, guest check-in support, check-out coordination, and shift communication.
* Answer guest questions, address routine concerns within company guidelines, and document issues requiring follow-up.
* Coordinate reservation questions, site moves, and booking exceptions with the corporate reservations team.
* Prepare and update resort staff schedules, coordinate coverage, and communicate schedule changes promptly.
* Review time records, obtain corrections and approvals, and submit accurate payroll information by established deadlines.

* Track purchase requests, quotes, approvals, deliveries, invoices, and vendor follow-up.

**Experience**

* Experience in office administration, hospitality, guest services, or a related role.
* Strong organization, customer service, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate staff assignments and manage competing priorities.
* Accuracy with schedules, time records, cash handling, and confidential information.
* Comfort using computers, spreadsheets, point-of-sale tools, and reservation or work-order systems.
* Experience coordinating housekeeping or retail operations is helpful.

**Schedule and work expectations**

This is an on-site position. Weekend, holiday, and assigned emergency coverage may be required. The Office Manager follows company procedures and works within established approval limits for reservations, purchasing, payroll, and personnel matters.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a brief description of your relevant office, hospitality, or supervisory experience.

Pay: $35,000.00 - $43,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Dynamic Wellness & Red Light Therapy is a growing wellness and body contouring clinic. As the Senior Manager of Facilities at Socure, you will play a key role in building and managing the workplace operations that support our growing organization. You will oversee the San Francisco office buildout, lead its day-to-day operations, and support our satellite offices, partnering closely with People, IT, Security, and Procurement to create welcoming, well-run spaces that enable collaboration and productivity.

jobs.desc:
**About Kol Emeth**

Congregation Kol Emeth is a 600+ member traditional, egalitarian Conservative synagogue located in the heart of Silicon Valley. We are a close-knit community served by a collaborative staff, and we’re looking for someone who finds meaning in supporting the congregation.

**The Role**

The Membership and Office Administrator brings both technology skills and relationship skills to be the first point of contact for our members. You will manage our ShulCloud membership database, handle regular financial transactions, and coordinate office administration. This frees our part-time Controller to focus on financial oversight and our Executive Director to focus on strategic planning, fundraising, and community engagement. You will report to the Executive Director and receive guidance from the Controller on financial matters.

**What You'll Do**

* **Membership database:** Administer ShulCloud, keep member records accurate, run reports for the Executive Director, clergy, and committees, and manage new members, resignations, and user access.
* **Dues and donations:** Manage dues billing, pledges, payment plans, refunds, and failed payments. Set up donation funds and send acknowledgment letters and year-end tax statements.
* **Events and programs:** Build and manage online registration for events such as the High Holidays, religious school, and fundraisers.
* **Member support:** Answer congregant questions about billing, donations, and payments, work with ShulCloud's vendor support, and train staff and volunteers on the system.
* **Transactions:** With guidance from the Controller, process accounts payable in Bill.com and accounts receivable, make bank deposits, and prepare routine reports.
* **Office administration:** Be the welcoming first contact for phones and the front desk, coordinate scheduling and coverage with our part-time Administrative Assistant, handle HR paperwork with the Controller, manage supplies and facility requests, and support the Executive Director and clergy.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years of experience in CRM data management, transaction processing, and/or office administration. Nonprofit or synagogue experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with ShulCloud or a comparable membership/CRM and billing platform is strongly preferred.
* Bookkeeping, QuickBooks, and Bill.com experience is a plus, though not required.
* High attention to detail and discretion with confidential financial and personal information.
* Strong organizational skills and a warm, professional style suited to a congregational community.
* Familiarity with Jewish communal life is a plus, not required.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week, non-exempt position, primarily on-site during regular office hours. Limited remote work may be arranged for select tasks. Some schedule flexibility around the High Holidays and major events may be required. Overtime must be pre-approved and is paid in accordance with California law.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $80,000 - $90,000 per year (about $38.50 - $43.25 per hour), depending on experience. Non-exempt; overtime eligible.
* Health, dental, and vision benefits.
* 403(b) retirement plan with employer matching.
* Paid time off.

**How To Apply**

Please send your resume and a brief cover letter to jobs@kolemeth.org. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Target start date: early December 2026.

Congregation Kol Emeth is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the application process and to enable them to perform the essential functions of this position, consistent with applicable law.

Agility's commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

**About The Role**
==================

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of payroll-related activities, including biweekly payroll processing, payroll data validation, employee support, tax notice resolution, relocation processing, and future RSU payroll processing.

This role requires a high level of attention to detail, a strong sense of urgency, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines. The Payroll Specialist will collaborate closely with People Operations, Accounting, employees, and other internal partners to research and resolve payroll questions and discrepancies and ensure a positive employee experience.

The role will also support payroll-related audits, nondiscrimination testing, annual reporting requirements, and process improvement initiatives as needed.

**About The Work**
==================

### **Payroll Processing & Compliance**

* Process biweekly payroll accurately and on schedule
* Validate payroll data, including hours worked, earnings, deductions, and payroll adjustments
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour laws, garnishments and other mandates
* Respond to tax notices and coordinate resolutions with agencies as needed
* Review payroll inputs for accuracy and completeness and identify potential issues prior to payroll submission
* Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Research and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee questions in a timely manner
* Partner with People Operations on miscellaneous payroll-related requests, questions, and issue resolution
* Monitor automated payroll tax remittance for issues, research and resolve issues as necessary
* Support payroll-related compliance requirements and ensure payroll activities are completed accurately and within required deadlines

### **Relocation & Special Payroll Processing**

* Review and process employee relocation-related payroll items
* Validate relocation information and supporting documentation for payroll processing
* Research and resolve relocation payroll questions or discrepancies in partnership with relevant internal teams
* Support special payroll calculations and adjustments as needed

### **Payroll Taxes & Tax Notices**

* Research payroll tax notices and determine appropriate resolution or escalation
* Coordinate with internal teams and external tax partners as needed to resolve tax-related issues
* Monitor payroll tax-related items for accuracy and timely resolution
* Support payroll tax compliance activities and annual reporting requirements

### **RSU Payroll Processing**

* Support the payroll processing of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Additional details, requirements, and processing frequency to be determined

### **Audits & Reporting**

* Assist with payroll audits and requests for supporting documentation
* Support nondiscrimination testing and annual reporting requirements
* Assist with year-end payroll activities and related reporting as needed
* Research and provide payroll data and documentation for internal and external stakeholders

### **Cross-Functional Support & Process Improvement**

* Collaborate with People Operations, Accounting, employees, and external partners to resolve payroll-related questions and issues
* Communicate payroll information clearly and professionally while maintaining confidentiality
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, and efficiency
* Support special projects and other payroll-related

**About the Company**  
A fast-growing freight forwarder in South San Francisco, part of a family-owned European logistics group with 60+ offices worldwide. The SFO office is close-knit, operationally hands-on and expanding quickly, with a domestic department that is growing fast.

**About the Role**  
A full-time domestic operations role covering a later shift, working alongside the domestic manager. About 80% of the role is domestic freight operations and about 20% supports a growing warehouse operation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Book and manage domestic shipments across LTL, FTL and domestic air
* Coordinate domestic ocean moves to Miami and Alaska
* Track shipments, resolve exceptions and keep customers updated
* Work with carriers on rates, capacity and service issues
* Support warehouse operations: pulling inventory, managing stock for a key customer, and operating a forklift (certification provided)
* Cover the afternoon and evening workload so the team has full-day coverage

**Candidate Requirements**

* 2+ years of domestic freight operations experience with a forwarder, 3PL or carrier
* Hands-on experience booking LTL, FTL and/or domestic air
* Comfortable with a mix of desk work and light warehouse work
* Organised, proactive and customer-focused
* Able to work 10am–7pm, fully onsite in South San Francisco
* Domestic ocean or warehouse experience is a plus

**What You Can Expect**

* $75,000–$85,000 base, depending on experience
* 401(k) with company match
* 3–4 weeks PTO plus sick time
* Forklift certification provided
* A growing team with real room to develop as domestic and warehouse operations expand

jobs.title: Assistant Front Office Manager
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT L’ERMITAGE BEVERLY HILLS**  
L’Ermitage Beverly Hills has been a sanctuary of elegance and discretion since 1975. An exclusive Five-Star, AAA Five Diamond, Two Michelin Keys property, we are committed to delivering world-class hospitality in an intimate and refined environment. Every team member contributes to the timeless experience that defines L’Ermitage and is committed to offering travelers excellence in hospitality.

As the **Assistant Front Office Manager**, you will oversee the Front Office and Guest Services team, ensuring an exceptional experience for all guests. Reporting directly to the Director of Rooms, this leadership role requires a dynamic individual who excels in guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and team development. Your mission will be to maintain the reputation of L’Ermitage as a premier destination for hospitality and excellence.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

* Ensures that guests are greeted, checked in and out efficiently, and allocated rooms promptly and courteously to the established standards of performance.
* Readily available at all times to deal with problems or guest/staff issues or concerns, using best judgement to resolve outstanding issues empathetically and in the best interest of both the guest and the hotel.
* Circulates regularly throughout all Front of House areas, maintaining a high profile with guests and staff, while monitoring standards of performance with regard to these areas.
* Ensures that reservations are notated accurately regarding all special requests, concerns, etc.
* Ensures accuracy of all charges on guest folios and addresses and/or corrects discrepancies immediately.
* Ensures that luggage/packages are delivered to and collected from rooms accurately, in a timely manner, and to the established standards of performance.
* Assistant senior leadership managing weekly schedules based on business needs.
* Guarantees check-in procedures are strictly adhered to and that the correct address and billing details are obtained from each guest.
* Monitors trends within the industry and make suggestions how these could be implemented.
* Adheres to all internal policies regarding compliance standards.
* Ensures maximum security and adherence of safe deposit box procedures.
* Assist with monitoring inventory par levels and purchases accordingly to and in anticipation of business volumes.
* “Protects the Asset” by reporting any loss, missing or stolen items to the General Manager immediately.
* Reports any safety concerns and maintenance issues immediately.
* Trains, coaches, and supports the guest services staff to the established standards of performance.
* Carries out or ensures that regular On-the-Job training is taking place to established standards of performance.
* Ensures that all Front of House staff are stationed and dressed accordingly at all times to the established grooming and behavioral standards.
* Attends and facilitates departmental meetings and training sessions as required.
* Demonstrate a team-focused attitude and encourage collaboration.

jobs.desc:
Atlas Management supports a group of physician-led practices in Los Angeles, including pain management, outpatient surgery centers, and an anesthesia group. We are looking for an experienced, highly organized professional to manage our personal injury (PI) patient cases from referral to settlement, while supporting our front office. You will be the main point of contact between our patients, our providers, and the attorney offices and referral partners who send us PI cases.

**This role is a good fit for someone who has worked in a medical office that treats PI patients on a lien basis, or who has been a case manager at a personal injury law firm and wants to work on the provider side.**

**Responsibilities**

*Personal injury case management*

* Process new PI referrals from law firms and referral partners and respond within a timely manner

* Schedule and confirm PI appointments and procedures, and communicate locations and instructions to patients
* Request medical records and billing after each encounter and send them to the attorney office promptly
* Keep the PI case management log accurate and current, documenting every contact with the date, details, and your initials
* Follow up with attorney offices on case status for every open case on a set schedule
* Gather totals for settlement and lien reduction requests (settlement amount, outstanding liens, legal fees) and prepare case summaries for the Medical Director
* Prepare a monthly case status report and close files when cases resolve

*Front office*

* Greet and check in patients, answer phones, and manage the schedule
* Verify demographics and insurance, collect payments, and keep patient files complete
* Print and deliver daily receipts for reconciliation
* Cover reception and support the front office team as needed

**What we require**

* 2+ years of medical front office experience, or 2+ years as a case manager at a personal injury law firm
* Working knowledge of how PI cases move: liens and letters of protection, attorney communication, records and billing requests, settlements, and lien reductions
* Strong organization and follow-through: you track details without being reminded and close every loop
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with patients and attorney offices
* Comfort with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Gmail), scheduling systems, and scanning documents
* Discretion with patient information and HIPAA awareness

**Preferred**

* Experience in a medical office that treats PI patients on a lien basis (pain management, orthopedics, spine, or chiropractic)
* Experience with PI or medical billing
* Bilingual English/Spanish

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

1. **ANSWER INCOMING PHONE CALLS:** Every employee’s first responsibility is to answer

incoming phone calls; these are the source of our income and cannot be ignored. After your

initial training period, be sure to answer phone calls by the first ring, as you will be the first in

line to answer calls. Follow the company greeting guidelines exactly when answering the

phone. Obtain and enter all necessary data accurately in the ServiceDesk software.

Determine appointment availability based on company standards. Ensure you are thoroughly

familiar with the guidelines for what calls to accept, what calls to refer to the manufacturer, and what the correct service call charge is for the brand and type of appliance. This is critical so that customers are not left on hold. Also ensure you are thoroughly familiar with the screening questions to ask customers. Use the company-approved conversation guidelines so interactions remain professional, friendly, and courteous. There are no “stupid” questions. If in doubt, ask!

2. **SCHEDULE APPOINTMENTS WITH CUSTOMERS:** Schedule appointments for service calls

and for Go-Backs and Call Backs following company guidelines. Do not leave customers on

hold for more than 30 seconds. Remind customers that we will call before coming, and that we will need to speak to them to confirm they are home. Be particularly careful to get exact

spelling of customer names. Be sure that customer addresses are repeated back to them to

ensure accuracy. Ask permission of customers to put them on hold and then do not leave

them on hold for more than 30 seconds before updating them as to appointment status.

Provide excellent customer service to all customers. Transfer any customer with a complaint

to the Operations/Parts Manager by advising the customer you would like to escalate their

concern to the Manager; ask them if you may place them on hold; then advise the

Operations/Parts Manager of the nature of the call and ask if they are ready to talk to the

customer.

3. **ANSWER “TECH” CELL PHONE:** Our technicians call in on a cell phone dedicated for their

use in checking in with the office. Check the techs in and out of customer appointments on

ServiceDesk. Enter the time in ServiceDesk and update the call status immediately. Call the

next customer to advise that our tech is on the way using approved dialogue. If they do not

answer, immediately advise the tech.

4. **REVIEW TECHS’ ROUTES AND JOB STATUS TO ENSURE TIMELY SERVICE:** At least six

times per hour review the entire dispatch screen on ServiceDesk to ensure customer service

levels are being maintained, and that appointment times are being honored. Immediately

notify the Operations/Parts Manager if we are in jeopardy of compromising our service levels. Take remedial action as needed or as directed by your supervisor.

5. **PROMPTLY ADVISE OPERATIONS/PARTS MANAGER OF PARTS ORDER REQUESTS**

**FROM TECHNICIANS:** Ensure that parts order requests from techs are communicated within

five minutes to the Operations/Parts Manager, using the Parts Research Form to summarize

the request. This is critical to maintaining excellent customer service levels.

6. **CALL THE NEXT DAY’S CUSTOMERS TO CONFIRM APPOINTMENTS STARTING AT 2**

**Fleet Manager – Tampa, FL**  
**Rowland Transportation**

Rowland Transportation is seeking a **Fleet Manager** to join our growing team in Dade City, FL. As a Dispatcher, you will play a key role in coordinating refrigerated (reefer) freight across the Southeast, ensuring on-time deliveries, efficient routing, and excellent service for our customers and drivers.

Schedule

Friday-Sunday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM

Why Apply?

* Competitive wages
* Benefits available after thirty days
* Paid vacation
* 401(k) plan

About the Role

**Responsibilities:**

* Dispatch and manage drivers hauling refrigerated freight throughout the Southeast, making real-time adjustments to meet delivery schedules
* Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments while maintaining temperature-sensitive load requirements
* Communicate professionally via phone, ELD systems, and dispatch software
* Remain calm and decisive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and drivers
* Assist drivers with routing, directions, and delivery site information
* Calculate transit times and ensure compliance with hours-of-service (HOS) regulations
* Accurately enter and manage load details, including temperature settings and customer specifications
* Monitor shipments in transit to ensure on-time performance and product integrity
* Handle high call volumes while multitasking across drivers, customers, and internal team members
* Coordinate driver schedules, time-off requests, and availability
* Review driver logs, timecards, and load documentation daily

About You

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 3 years of customer service experience preferred
* Able to work weekends
* Minimum 1 year of fleet manager experience preferred
* High school diploma or GED required
* Familiarity with Southeast regional routes is highly desirable
* Bilingual (Spanish/English) is a plus
* Strong computer skills, including typing, dispatch software, and internet navigation
* Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and stay organized in a fast-paced environment

About Us

At Rowland Transportation, no two days are the same. We specialize in refrigerated freight and take pride in delivering time-sensitive loads safely and efficiently across the Southeast. Our team is committed to professionalism, reliability, and continuous improvement.

We offer:

* A supportive, team-oriented work environment
* Hands-on training and opportunities for advancement
* A company culture focused on growth and operational excellence

Ready to Apply?

The process is simple—click “Apply Now” to get started. We look forward to hearing from you!

Rowland Transportation is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug-free workplace. Pre-employment screening may be required as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.desc:
**Lead your office team to success!** As our Office Manager, we will depend on you to coordinate general office activities, assist with billing and payroll, maintain physical and electronic files, and support other departments as needed.

**Why Work for Senior Helpers of Tyler?**

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**
* **Autonomy**—We encourage our team members’ independence and believe in our team to complete their job duties without micromanaging.
* **Task Variety**—We provide an engaging workday that uses your various skill sets to avoid monotony.

**Job Duties:**

***Customer Service***

* Ensure all communication is sent in a timely manner according to policy.
* Answer and screen incoming phone calls in a pleasant, courteous manner.
* Input client leads into home care software and create and send client welcome packets and prospect information.

***Billing – Accounts Receivable & Payable***

* Ensure invoices are completed accurately, timely, and according to company policy.
* Maintain all necessary records related to Long Term Care (LTC) and/or Governmental programs.
* Monitor employee pay rates and hours to ensure accuracy. Comply with garnishments as required.
* Record incoming checks and monitor outstanding receivables on a continual basis to make sure accounts receivable are current. Follow up on receivables per company policy.
* Record incoming bills and invoices and allocate to the correct month. Pay invoices according to the due date.

***Payroll & Recruitment***

* Collect and organize timesheets and verify/reconcile against scheduling calendar in home care software; track late, missing, and incorrect timesheets.
* Assist with billing and payroll functions to meet company deadlines.
* Review timesheets for any significant change in client status and indicate them in the caregiver notes section and properly document the information.
* Complete caregiver reference checks and criminal background checks.
* Assist with new hire packets and employee handbooks.
* Verify complete caregiver information in the file after hiring.
* Input caregiver information into home care software.

***Clerical***

* Prepare client and caregiver files including Care Plan Binders, Client Welcome Packets, Employment Paperwork, and other documentation.
* Perform general office functions such as sorting mail, data input, and file maintenance, ensuring all information is properly filed, organized, and easily accessible.
* Complete other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of two years in an office managerial setting.
* Ability to communicate pleasantly and effectively with callers and internal staff.
* Experience with a variety of the field’s concepts, practices, and procedures.
* Team player, excellent verbal and written communication skills, adaptable in different situations, must possess excellent client interaction skills.

**Job Benefits:**

* Paid Time Off
* Holiday Pay
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Short-term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Pet Wellness Plan
* Employee Discount Program

**About Senior Helpers of Tyler:**

We are a brand new independently owned and operated franchisee of SH Franchising, LLC dba Senior Helpers®. Senior Helpers® has been the nation's premier franchisor of in-home senior care franchisees since 2005, with locations across the country. Our services range from specialized care for those with chronic diseases to companion services for seniors looking for assistance with daily activities. Our mission is to provide compassionate care and improve the quality of life for our clients, their families, and our employees.

jobs.title: Business Office Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Description: Business Office Manager**
============================================

**Department:** Administration / Business Office  
**Setting:** Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Business Office Manager is responsible for overseeing the financial and administrative operations of the skilled nursing facility, including resident billing, insurance verification, accounts receivable, collections, and financial recordkeeping. This role ensures accurate billing, timely reimbursement, compliance with facility policies, and effective communication with residents, families, insurance providers, and government agencies.

The ideal candidate will have **at least one year of experience in a skilled nursing facility or a similar healthcare setting** and a strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, managed care plans, private insurance, copayments, coinsurance, deductibles, private-pay accounts, and insurance coverage requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Manage daily business office operations, including resident accounts, billing, payment posting, and financial recordkeeping.
* Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage limits, authorization requirements, and payer guidelines for Medicare, Medicaid, managed care, and private insurance plans.
* Maintain a working knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid coverage, resident financial responsibility, copayments, deductibles, coinsurance, and private-pay obligations.
* Prepare, review, and submit accurate resident bills and insurance claims in a timely manner.
* Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, follow up on unpaid claims, and resolve billing discrepancies or denials.
* Manage private-pay collections and resident responsibility balances while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and sensitivity when communicating with residents and families.
* Communicate with insurance companies, Medicaid agencies, residents, family members, and other responsible parties regarding coverage, billing questions, payment arrangements, and outstanding balances.
* Maintain accurate financial records, resident account documentation, insurance information, and supporting billing documentation.
* Review insurance policies and benefit details to determine coverage, exclusions, limitations, and potential out-of-pocket expenses.
* Coordinate with admissions, social services, clinical staff, and facility leadership to obtain required financial information and support accurate payer classification and billing.
* Assist with Medicaid applications, eligibility reviews, renewals, and follow-up on pending determinations, as applicable.
* Identify billing errors, investigate payment discrepancies, and work toward timely resolution of outstanding accounts.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, payer requirements, facility policies, and confidentiality standards.

**POSITION Overview:**

The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has awarded Finger Lakes ReUse a Solid Waste Management Grant to implement community-driven waste reduction and reuse-focused solutions, in rural New York State communities.

The ReUse Technical Assistance Program (ReTAP) seeks to create a more circular economy in which reusable materials and products are kept in local circulation through collection, sorting, maintenance, repair, reuse, refurbishment, remanufacturing, upcycling, and recycling. The technical assistance program will deliver strategies, processes, and tools to local government officials, community organizations, businesses, residents, and/or entrepreneurs in five to eight rural communities in Central New York. Solutions developed will fit each community’s unique needs and material diversion goals.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

jobs.desc:
Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi-million-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real-time applications.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Office Manager on our team, you will be the backbone of our office operations, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and efficiently. You'll create a welcoming and organized environment, supporting both employees and visitors while handling a variety of administrative and operational tasks. Your role will be integral in maintaining a positive workplace culture and keeping our office space optimized for productivity.

You'll own the physical and day-to-day operating environment of the company: the office, the vendors, the equipment, and the first-day experience of every new hire. In this role, you'll take the recurring office work and build the systems that help us as we scale.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

If it's about the office, it's yours.

* **Office and workplace:** daily upkeep (plants, meeting rooms reset, kitchen clean), maintenance requests logged and chased with building management until fixed, the cleaning service, keys and badge access, and safety basics like fire extinguishers and first-aid kits.
* **Supplies and inventory:** keep office, kitchen and other areas supplies stocked, own stocking requests from the team, and run an inventory tracker with reorder points and a monthly count.
* **Furniture, seating and contractors:** seating plans as headcount grows; hire and manage contractors to assemble and install desks, chairs, monitor arms and shelving, from quotes and insurance to scheduling and sign-off.
* **Vendors:** single point of contact for our snack and water vendor (Office Libations), cleaning, catering, plants, furniture, IT and AV, and couriers: ordering, deliveries, invoices and renewals. Source and negotiate new vendors and keep the vendor list current.
* **Meeting rooms and AV:** AV requests for the conference rooms and the CEO's office (TV screens, video conferencing, mics, cables), first-line troubleshooting with spares on hand, and escalation to our IT or AV vendor.
* **New hire setup:** Badges, desks and day-one logistics, so every new hire is productive from their first hour.

**About Us**

At INFINITI Of Ontario, we believe that taking great care of our customers starts with taking great care of our team. We are a tight-knit, community-focused automotive dealership where everyone pitches in, supports one another, and takes pride in doing things the right way. If you are looking for a welcoming, steady-paced environment where your organizational talents will truly be valued and appreciated, you’ll fit right in here. Our Mission statement: "We are a values-driven automotive retailing company, committed to doing Right Things Right, while caring for our employees and our customers."

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a warm, detail-oriented, and dependable Business Office Manager to keep our daily office operations running smoothly and harmoniously. In this role, you will be the friendly heartbeat of our back-office, partnering closely with our management team to handle bookkeeping, vehicle deals, title processing, and everyday administrative needs. We are looking for someone who loves bringing order to chaos, enjoys helping others, and wants to be a trusted cornerstone of our dealership family.

**Key Responsibilities1. Office Coordination & Team Support**

* Keep our office running like clockwork by managing daily administrative workflows, office supplies, and equipment needs.
* Serve as a supportive, approachable point of contact for our sales, service, and management teams.
* Foster a welcoming, organized, and positive office atmosphere for both staff and visitors.
* Help coordinate vendor relationships, facility maintenance, and general office correspondence.

**2. Accounting & Financial Administration**

* Handle day-to-day accounting tasks with care, including accounts payable/receivable, basic ledger maintenance, schedules reconciliation, and daily deposits.
* Review completed vehicle sales files for accuracy and ensure smooth processing before finalization.
* Assist with payroll coordination, timesheet tracking, and communicating with our payroll providers.
* Prepare routine financial summaries and reports to help leadership keep track of business goals.
* Submit financial statement to the manufacturer.

**3. Titling, Registration & Compliance**

* Oversee vehicle titling, registration paperwork, and state DMV processing to ensure everything is filed correctly and on time.
* Keep customer documents, tax forms, and lien records meticulously organized and compliant.

**4. Onboarding & Employee Care**

* Welcome new team members by guiding them through the onboarding process and making sure they have everything they need to feel at home.
* Maintain confidential employee records and assist with human resources and benefits coordination.

**Qualifications & Skills**

jobs.desc:
The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Every repair, vendor visit, permit renewal, and vehicle inspection at HTM begins as a request that someone has to receive, route, and follow through on until it is closed. The Operations Coordinator is that person.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Coordinator - Operations serves as the intake, dispatch, and coordination point for the Operations Department across Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, IT, Fleet Management, and Warehouse and Delivery Logistics. This role monitors and triages the MaintainX queue and assigns work to the appropriate staff member or approved vendor; maintains the departmental compliance calendar for licenses, permits, inspections, and fleet records; solicits quotes and issues purchase requests within assigned thresholds; reconciles vendor invoices; and compiles the reporting that department and senior leadership rely on. The Operations Coordinator supports both the Director of Operations and the Operations Manager.

Operations is a department where the cost of a dropped request is measured in a shelter without hot water or a van that cannot make a food run. The Operations Coordinator exists so that requests are not dropped, deadlines are not missed, and no repair, renewal, or inspection depends on someone remembering it. This is not clerical work performed in service of a department. It is the mechanism by which the department keeps its commitments.

**Responsibilities**

***Request Intake and Dispatch***

* Monitor the MaintainX queue and all Operations request channels throughout the workday. Log, categorize, and assign priority to every incoming request.
* Dispatch requests to the appropriate Facilities, Maintenance, Safety, IT, or Fleet staff member, or to an approved vendor, based on trade, site location, and urgency.
* Acknowledge every incoming request within the departmental 24-hour response standard. Confirm receipt to the requesting site and communicate an estimated response time.
* Redistribute open work when a staff member is unavailable or a site escalates. Notify the Director of Operations or Operations Leadership of any request that cannot be assigned within standard.
* Track open tickets through to closure. Follow up on aging work orders and escalate any request that exceeds the established resolution window.
* Recognize matters that require management judgment rather than routine routing, and escalate them promptly rather than resolving them independently.

***Vendor and Purchasing Coordination***

* Solicit and collect quotes from approved vendors. Assemble comparison documentation for the Director of Operations or Operations Manager where multiple quotes are required.
* Issue purchase requests and work orders to approved vendors within assigned dollar thresholds. Route any request exceeding the assigned threshold, or involving a vendor not on the approved list, to the Director of Operations for approval before any commitment is made.
* Schedule vendor site visits, service calls, and preventive maintenance appointments. Confirm site access and notify site leadership in advance.
* Maintain the vendor file including W-9s, certificates of insurance, business licenses, signed agreements, and contact records. Track expiration dates and request renewals before coverage or credentials lapse.
* Reconcile vendor invoices against work performed and approved quotes. Flag discrepancies to the Director of Operations before invoices are submitted for payment.

***Compliance Documentation and Tracking***

* Maintain the Operations compliance calendar covering facility licenses, permits, regulatory inspections, fire and life safety certifications, and DPH requirements. Issue advance notice of upcoming renewals and expirations.

Founded and rooted in the Gospel values of the Catholic Church and the charism of the Sisters of St. Joseph of Carondelet, the Academy of Our Lady of Peace (OLP) empowers young women in an innovative learning environment that honors the individual while fostering community, and develops faith-filled leaders dedicated to the “love of God and the dear neighbor without distinction.”

Working in close partnership with the Director of Facilities, Senior Maintenance Technician, and School Safety and Security Coordinator, and coordinating regularly with outside service partners — including the Food Service Manager and outsourced janitorial vendor — this role ensures that campus operations, events, and facilities systems reflect the excellence, hospitality, and mission of OLP.

The Campus Operations Coordinator owns the department's scheduling systems and calendars, coordinates vendor and service delivery for events, and leads the planning and execution of campus events from concept through completion. This role also consolidates the records, data, and regular reporting maintained across the department — including maintenance, security, transportation, events, and vendor services — into a unified view for the Director of Facilities, and works continuously to streamline department systems, workflows, and reporting.

program management.

records, and supporting documentation using VVSD procedures.
