jobs.title: Transportation Dispatcher
jobs.desc:
GENERAL PURPOSE
  
  
Work under a moderate degree of supervision to coordinate the scheduling and dispatching of truck drivers to ensure timely and efficient delivery of product shipments. Perform routine job duties independently and resolve issues in straightforward situations, assessing each using standard procedures. Seek assistance for uncommon, new, or complicated situations.
  
  
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
. Schedule and dispatch daily loads/shipments (raw milk, products/goods) to meet customer needs and optimize routes to reduce costs and elevate overall efficiency
  
  
. Dispatch approved drivers to appropriate loads based on availability, capacity, and delivery deadlines; confirm load date/time and delivery date/time
  
  
. Audit driver compliance with schedules
  
  
. Serve as the primary point of contact between drivers, customers, and internal contacts. Communicate delivery instructions, customer changes, address issues, and provide updates on shipment status
  
  
. Develop and maintain relationships with carriers and drivers to understand their needs, operating schedules, and physical limitations while working to inform them of the needs of our customers and distribution system
  
  
. Be familiar with contracts established with each customer regarding volumes and quantities, plant operating schedules, warehouse schedules, and all special requirements or circumstances
  
  
. Monitor milk movements to ensure all producers remain qualified during qualifying months and between Federal Orders. Maximize diversions and transportation credits where applicable (applicable to raw milk)
  
  
. Assemble orders that make up outgoing loads. Maximize carrier load weights and volume by coordinating orders with other company depots, plants, warehouses, etc.
  
  
. Monitor secondary freight costs and work to minimize those costs when scheduling deliveries
  
  
. Monitor the progress of deliveries from start/load assembly to delivery to the customer. Use tracking systems to monitor the location and status of trucks and shipments. Address any delays or issues promptly
  
  
. Handle emergencies and unforeseen events such as accidents, traffic delays, or equipment malfunctions. Coordinate with drivers and others to find quick and effective solutions
  
  
. Ensure all dispatch activities comply with federal and state transportation regulations. Keep up-to-date with changes in laws and regulations affecting the trucking and/or dairy industry
  
  
. Address customer inquiries and concerns regarding delivery times, delays, and other related issues. Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem resolution
  
  
. Provide drivers with necessary information and support to perform their duties effectively. Assist with directions, load information, and other logistical details
  
  
. Match proof of deliveries and approval of carrier invoices. Validate all charges
  
  
. Work with other groups to resolve issues that arise with the incoming manifests matching the dispatch schedule
  
  
. Input and maintain accurate records and data in systems, spreadsheets, etc. (customer proof of delivery, bills of lading files, receiving credits, customer receipts, delivery schedules carrier/hauler info, costs, and other relevant data). Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports
  
  
. Seek and negotiate the lowest carrier costs per set authority limit
  
  
. May handle the sale/disposal of distressed loads and track on the rejected load database. Communicate and maintain accurate and timely records of distressed loads including quality results, disposition, and/or sale price
  
  
. The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required
  
  
**Requirements:**  
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  
  
. High school diploma or equivale

### **Why Work Here**

At SMG ABA LLC, we take pride in being more than just an accounting firm. We foster a unique team spirit that sets us apart from our competitors. Guided by a set of core values, we have established ourselves as a seven-time Inc. 5000 company, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to success and continuous growth. As a Bookkeeper, you’ll help keep multiple client books accurate, current, and decision-ready. This role exists to ensure clean general ledgers, timely reporting, and dependable support for payroll and tax-related items.  
  
Key responsibilities include:  

* QuickBooks bookkeeping, including journal entries and general ledger management

You’ll start onsite in Islandia by reviewing priorities for the day and checking in on open client questions. In the afternoon, you’ll focus on preparing clear weekly or month-end outputs and flagging anything unusual so it can be addressed promptly. You’ll wrap up by organizing notes for the next day and ensuring nothing critical is left hanging before you head out. Schedule is Monday–Friday, 8:45am–5:30pm with a lunch break, plus half-day Fridays during the summer.

The Northwestern Band of the Shoshone Nation (NWBSN) is seeking a highly organized and motivated Grant Project Coordinator to support implementation of the Rural EMS Workforce, Education & Community Paramedicine Initiative, funded through the Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP).

The Project Coordinator will oversee day-to-day implementation, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of grant-funded activities designed to strengthen rural emergency medical services (EMS) workforce capacity, expand access to EMS education, support rural high-school career pathways, and facilitate community paramedicine/mobile integrated healthcare (MIH) partnerships.

The Project Coordinator will ensure activities align with approved grant objectives, performance measures, budgets, timelines, and applicable federal and state requirements.

* Coordinate daily implementation of the BEMS SHIFT Initiative in accordance with the approved grant application, work plan, budget, and performance measures.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, implementation milestones, deliverables, and progress reports.
* Monitor project activities to ensure timely completion of objectives across all grant budget periods.

* Develop and maintain scholarship applications, eligibility procedures, review processes, and award documentation.
* Assist applicants with scholarship requirements and available education pathways.

Would you like to be part of a company that is employee owned? We invite you to consider joining NOOTER.

As a Project Coordinator, you will play a critical role in supporting construction project execution through labor timekeeping, cost coding, document control, procurement coordination, and project administration. jobs.desc:
**Trades Administrative Coordinator**

**Department:**Business Operations  
**Location:** Albuquerque, New Mexico  
**Reports To:** VP of Business Operations  
**Position Type:** Full-Time

**Position Summary**

Insight Construction is seeking an organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Trades Administrative Coordinator to provide administrative and operational support to our trade division managers. This position will serve as a key point of contact between our trade divisions and the main office, assisting with daily administrative tasks, bid coordination, purchasing requests, accounting follow-ups, and general office operations.

This position reports directly to the VP of Business Operations and is expected to follow Insight Construction's established policies, procedures, and administrative processes while supporting the day-to-day needs of our division managers.

The ideal candidate is someone who takes initiative, communicates effectively, stays organized, and is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division & Administrative Support**

* Provide daily administrative assistance to trade division managers.
* Maintain communication with the VP of Business Operations regarding administrative priorities, outstanding issues, and any matters requiring additional direction or approval.
* Help organize, track, and follow up on outstanding requests and administrative tasks.
* Assist division managers with correspondence, documentation, and other office-related needs.
* Maintain organized electronic files and records for division operations.
* Communicate with the main office to ensure requests and information are routed appropriately.

**Estimating & Bid Support**

* Assist division managers with preparing, organizing, and submitting bid proposals.
* Request and follow up on vendor and subcontractor quotes.
* Track outstanding pricing requests and communicate updates to division managers.
* Assist with compiling proposal documentation and supporting information.
* Monitor bid deadlines and help ensure required information is received on time.

**Purchasing & Office Coordination**

* Prepare and route purchase request emails with accurate job and material information.
* Follow up on outstanding purchasing requests, order confirmations, and delivery information.
* Coordinate routine office supply orders and general purchasing needs for the trades building.
* Communicate with the purchasing department regarding order status, missing information, and outstanding requests.
* Assist with maintaining office supplies and basic administrative resources.

**Accounting & Approval Follow-Ups**

* Assist the accounting department with obtaining outstanding invoice approvals from division managers.
* Follow up on missing documentation, receipts, and other information needed to process invoices.
* Communicate approval statuses and outstanding items to the appropriate accounting team members.
* Help resolve administrative discrepancies by coordinating information between division managers, purchasing, and accounting.

**Technology & General Office Support**

* Provide basic technology assistance to division managers and trades office personnel.
* Assist with software access, basic troubleshooting, printing, scanning, and electronic document management.
* Coordinate unresolved technology issues with the appropriate IT support.
* Assist with maintaining an organized and functional trades office.
* Support additional administrative projects and process improvements as needed.

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Previous experience in an administrative, office support, or coordinator position.

* Ability to confidently communicate with multiple departments, follow up on outstanding requests, and seek clarification when needed.
* Ability to follow established company procedures while adapting to the administrative needs and priorities of multiple division managers.

Are you an experienced Business Office Manager with a passion for operational excellence in skilled nursing? Vivo Healthcare is seeking a proactive and highly organized **Business Office Manager (BOM)** to oversee billing and financial operations while ensuring resident satisfaction and regulatory compliance.

Location - Vivo Healthcare Sebring / 3011 Kenilworth BLVD Sebring FL 33870

**About the Role**

As our Business Office Manager, you will lead all billing, accounts receivable, and collection activities for the facility. Your expertise in skilled nursing financial operations will be key to achieving cash collection and AR goals while supporting our mission of exceptional resident care.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee Medicaid Pending applications, collaborating with residents, families, and agencies to secure coverage efficiently.
* Maintain accurate financial records, including issuing receipts, preparing deposits, and recording payments with appropriate segregation of duties.
* Partner with the home office billing team and payers to ensure timely and accurate claims processing and payment.
* Manage census activities, balancing daily, weekly, and monthly data with nursing and admissions teams.
* Oversee Resident Trust Accounts with weekly and monthly reconciliations to ensure compliance and accuracy.
* Manage petty cash and collection processes to maintain operational integrity.
* Ensure confidentiality and privacy of all resident, employee, and operational data.
* Interact professionally with residents, families, staff, visitors, and external agencies under all circumstances.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes.

**What You Bring**

jobs.title: Executive Office Coordinator
jobs.desc:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Executive Office Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to the Executive Assistant and executive leadership team. This position coordinates schedules, prepares documents and reports, manages communications, organizes meetings and events, maintains records, and assists with special projects. The role helps ensure efficient day-to-day executive office operations while maintaining professionalism, sound judgment, and confidentiality.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Provide administrative support to the Executive Assistant and executive leadership team.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, conference calls, travel arrangements, and accommodations.
* Prepare, edit, proofread, and distribute correspondence, reports, presentations, agendas, and meeting materials.
* Organize and maintain electronic and physical records, files, and confidential documents.
* Assist with meeting preparation, minutes, follow-up items, and tracking of assigned action items.
* Monitor executive office communications and route inquiries to the appropriate individual.
* Coordinate leadership meetings, company events, employee functions, guest visits, and special projects.
* Process expense reports, invoices, purchase requests, and other administrative documentation.
* Assist with tracking departmental budgets, contracts, vendor information, and administrative deadlines.
* Maintain office supplies and administrative resources for executive offices and conference rooms.
* Support internal announcements, leadership correspondence, and other company communications.
* Provide backup support for the Executive Assistant during absences or periods of high workload.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding company, employee, customer, and vendor information.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and Experience

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Office Management, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of three years of administrative, executive support, office coordination, or related experience.
* Experience supporting senior leadership in a corporate or manufacturing environment preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Strong organizational, time management, proofreading, and follow-through skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, meet deadlines, and work with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to interact effectively with all organizational levels.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

* Primarily office-based work requiring prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
* Occasional lifting and carrying of office materials weighing up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to travel between company facilities as needed.
* Regular interaction with executives, managers, employees, customers, vendors, and visitors.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Timely and accurate completion of executive office administrative tasks.
* Quality and accuracy of reports, communications, and documentation.
* Effectiveness of meeting, event, calendar, and travel coordination.
* Responsiveness to executive leadership and organizational needs.
* Consistent maintenance of confidentiality, professionalism, and follow-through.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator
jobs.desc:
At Skin and Aesthetics Center, our Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator plays a key role in supporting executive leadership and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations across our growing network of dermatology practices in New Jersey, Illinois, Minnesota, and Pennsylvania. As part of a comprehensive healthcare management services organization, this role provides direct support to the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, managing their calendars, correspondence, meeting preparation, and follow-through, and serving as a communication link between leadership and HR, Finance, and Operations on provider recruiting and company initiatives.

Beyond executive support, the role extends into Operations by maintaining project and timeline tracking for the Operations team and Practice Managers, organizing the company’s operational reference materials, and keeping key renewal dates visible to the appropriate owners. The Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator also provides administrative support to practice leadership when additional operational assistance is needed. The ideal candidate is organized, discreet, and comfortable managing many moving parts at once, and is equally confident preparing a board-level agenda or ensuring a vendor renewal is completed on time.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
* Minimum of three years of experience as an executive assistant supporting senior leadership, or in operations or project coordination
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams, including building and maintaining trackers in Excel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle confidential business, financial, and personnel information with discretion
* Reliable home office setup with high-speed internet for remote work

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
* Experience supporting a CEO, CFO, or other C-level executive
* Experience in a multi-site medical practice, healthcare management organization, or dermatology setting
* Experience coordinating provider recruiting, credentialing, or onboarding
* Experience with HRIS or payroll platforms; Paycom experience a plus
* Familiarity with EHR and practice management systems; EMA/ModMed experience a plus

Responsibilities:

* Manage complex calendars for the CEO and CFO, including scheduling across multiple locations and time zones
* Triage incoming requests, correspondence, and inquiries; prioritize, route, and close the loop on behalf of leadership
* Prepare agendas, materials, and follow-up notes for leadership meetings, manager calls, and company events
* Track executive-level action items and ensure timely follow-through
* Coordinate travel, itineraries, expense reports, and logistics for executive site visits and meetings
* Serve as a communication link between the CEO/CFO and HR, Finance, Operations, and other departments on company initiatives
* Maintain the Operations project tracker, monitoring initiative owners, deadlines, and status updates; follow up with stakeholders and report progress to leadership
* Provide administrative and project support to Practice Managers, including scheduling, document preparation, vendor coordination, and follow-through on open items
* Support operational readiness for new locations, provider additions, and practice transitions by tracking tasks and cross-department handoffs
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, trackers, and presentations for leadership review
* Keep shared files, templates, and standard operating procedures organized and current
* Coordinate interview scheduling and communication for provider candidates in partnership with Leadership and Talent Acquisition
* Support onboarding logistics for new providers and managers by coordinating equipment, system access, and first-day readiness in part

Applicants must have **at least one year of hands-on experience billing both Medi-Cal and commercial insurance**. Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred but not required.

**Organization Overview:**

**Mission:** *To inspire and empower all young people, especially those who need us most, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring adults.*

Through accessible, holistic out-of-school enrichment programs and mentorship, Boys & Girls Clubs of Silicon Valley (BGCSV) helps close the opportunity gap and promotes economic, political, and social equity for the young people we serve and the communities they call home. We empower youth to take charge of their education, their lives, and their futures. Safety, cultural competency, inclusiveness, and belonging are top priorities. Our Clubhouses are rooted in communities of greatest need, and our staff reflects the diversity and richness of those communities. Together, we create a nurturing environment where young people can thrive.

**Position Summary:**

The Front Desk Receptionist is central to the safe, efficient daily operation of the Clubhouse. The core of the role is running the daily dismissal of 300+ members: confirming that every member is released accurately and promptly, and only to a parent, guardian, or other adult authorized in the member’s file. The Receptionist coordinates dismissal with program staff by walkie-talkie, calling members from the correct classrooms and program areas.

The Receptionist is also the first face members, families, and visitors see. The role answers phones, manages member and visitor sign-in/sign-out, and provides light administrative support. The ideal candidate stays calm, organized, friendly, and accurate in a busy, noisy front desk environment

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary front desk point of contact for the daily dismissal of 300+ Club members.

* Follow all custody orders, restraining orders, and pick-up restrictions on file; never release a member to an unauthorized person, and escalate immediately to the Unit Director if someone not authorized attempts pick-up.
* Use walkie-talkies clearly and professionally to request members from the appropriate classrooms and program areas.
* State member names and dismissal details clearly so staff identify and release the correct member.
* Track member locations and work with Clubhouse staff to keep dismissal organized.
* Handle multiple dismissal requests at once while staying accurate, courteous, and in clear communication.
* Record accurate sign-out information (time, member, and adult picking up) for every member.
* Report discrepancies, delays, or concerns immediately to the appropriate staff member or supervisor, and follow Club procedures for members not picked up by closing time.
* Keep the front desk calm, organized, and customer-service focused during peak dismissal.

**2. Child Safety and Mandated Reporting**

* Act as a mandated reporter under California law and report any known or reasonably suspected child abuse or neglect as required (see California Legal Requirements below).
* Follow BGCSV child safety policies, including no one-on-one interactions outside of sight of other staff, and restroom supervision procedures.
* Monitor the Clubhouse entrance; ensure every visitor signs in and report unknown or unauthorized individuals right away.
* Know and follow emergency, lockdown, and evacuation procedures, and keep emergency contact information accessible at the front desk.
* Protect the confidentiality of member and family information.

**3. Greeting and Assisting Members and Visitors**

* Warmly welcome every membe

jobs.title: Dispatcher
jobs.desc:
### **About Zūm:**

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (*Zūm CMX*™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – *Zūm CMX* is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 7,500 schools rely on *Zūm CMX*. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

**About the Role**

We're seeking an experienced Dispatcher to lead daily transportation operations and serve as the critical communication hub at our San Francisco, CA location. This role encompasses the complete dispatch lifecycle—from daily route assignments and driver coordination to emergency response and real-time problem-solving. You'll ensure seamless service delivery by orchestrating drivers, vehicles, and routes while maintaining constant communication with school districts, families, and internal teams. You'll be the operational heartbeat of our transportation service, ensuring every student gets to school safely and on time, every single day.

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

You're the calm in the storm, the person who can juggle ten things at once and still remember to check in on that driver who's running five minutes behind. You thrive when the phones are ringing, routes need adjusting, and a bus just broke down on Main Street. You're a quick thinker who stays cool under pressure, makes smart decisions on the fly, and somehow manages to keep everyone informed and on track. You genuinely enjoy being the go-to problem solver, whether you're helping a new driver navigate an unfamiliar route, coordinating with the shop on a repair, or reassuring a parent that their child's bus is on the way. You've got great communication skills, a knack for prioritizing what matters most, and the kind of steady, reliable presence that makes people trust you to get things handled.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Daily Operations & Route Management**

* Direct and monitor daily assignments, schedule drivers, and assign vehicles to ensure full route coverage and on-time completion of all driver activities.
* Communicate all relevant details of driving assignments to drivers to ensure proper execution, and assist with routing directions and special service assignments.
* Coordinate vehicle service and repairs with the Maintenance Manager to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.

**Communication & Emergency Response**

* Respond to emergency calls and coordinate the emergency response network.
* Notify stakeholders and location personnel of all route changes, emergencies, accidents, breakdowns, or service disruptions, and handle customer concerns promptly and professionally.
* Provide real-time operational support to drivers including assistance with traffic issues, routing questions, and emergency situations, escalating unresolved issues appropriately.

**Compliance & Administrative Operations**

We are looking for a Payroll Administrator to join our team and help drive the accuracy and timely delivery of compensation for our growing workforce. Managing payroll for over 3,000 employees across multiple states isn't just about pushing a button—it’s about data integrity, problem-solving, and delivering exceptional customer service.

If you are a numbers champion who loves a collaborative team environment, let’s talk!

**Position Summary**

As our Payroll Administrator, you will assist with the administration of our timekeeping and payroll systems. Your core mission is ensuring accurate weekly and bi-weekly multi-state payroll delivery.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Assist in preparation and processing of weekly and bi-weekly multi-state payrolls for 3000+ employees.
* Input employees pay data information and adjustments to the timekeeping system before uploading to payroll; such as training pay, sick leave, retro pay, bonuses, etc.
* Running and auditing weekly timekeeping reports to resolve any discrepancies and verify hours against the submitted hours worked reports by location.
* Issue and record adjustments to pay for previous payroll discrepancies or retroactive increases.
* Process direct deposit changes or returns and issue/assign pay cards as needed.
* Keep track and process leave time for employees; such as sick time, vacation and personal time off.
* Maintain employee profile information and process all status change forms; such as pay rates, dept changes, terminations, etc.
* May issue termination or off-cycle paychecks and mail if needed.
* Research and resolve problems promptly, perform scheduled activities related to payroll and assist employees or managers with payroll related situations that arise.
* Maintain payroll information as required to include all federal, state and local payroll compliance and other payroll tracking items.
* Prepare and maintain standard reports, queries, and conduct appropriate audits to ensure data integrity.
* Complete verifications of employment.
* Provide back-up to other payroll associates of the team as needed.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience is preferred.
* 3+ years of payroll experience supporting 1000+ employees in multiple states.
* Intermediate knowledge and experience working with HRIS systems, ADP Vantage experience strongly desired, and TCP (Time Clock Plus time keeping system) preferred.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Word, etc.
* Able to communicate professionally and effectively.
* Able to speak, read, and comprehend the English language.
* Excellent teambuilding and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrate a sense of urgency and timeliness.
* Must be open to feedback, differing opinions and other points of view.
* An uncompromised commitment to maintaining strict confidentiality regarding sensitive employee and company data.
* Top-tier attention to detail, a knack for multitasking, and the ability to juggle shifting priorities under minimal supervision.

Physical Requirements:

* Constant sitting and typing/operating a computer, phone, and mouse. Frequent talking and hearing. Occasional lifting up to 10 lbs (rarely up to 25 lbs).
* Typical office environment with moderate noise levels.

Compensation and Benefits:

* Compensation commensurate with education and experience.
* Health benefits available the first of the month after 60 days of full-time employment.
* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays and 401k
* A company culture that promotes teamwork, safety, and career growth.

jobs.desc:
**Description**

  
  

**Administrative Assistant – Access Line**
==========================================

Location: Tulare, CA

Position Type: Full-Time | Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $20.60–$21.85 per hour

Program: Tulare County Access Line

Join Our Mission

At Kings View, every role contributes to something bigger — improving lives and strengthening communities. We are committed to providing behavioral health and social services to those with limited resources, guided by compassion, excellence, and respect.

Position Overview:

The Administrative Assistant provides administrative and clerical support for the Tulare County Access Line program and its leadership. This position supports efficient daily operations through customer service, scheduling, data entry, records management, correspondence, and coordination of administrative processes while protecting confidential information.

Key Responsibilities:

* Provide administrative and office support to program staff and leadership.
* Answer and route telephone calls, emails, and visitor inquiries with professionalism and courtesy.
* Schedule appointments, meetings, trainings, and other program activities.
* Prepare, proofread, and distribute correspondence, reports, forms, spreadsheets, and documents.
* Maintain organized physical and electronic records and enter, verify, and update information in databases.
* Process incoming and outgoing mail, faxes, and other communications.
* Maintain office supplies and inventory and coordinate replenishment as needed.
* Support meeting agendas, minutes, follow-up activities, and assigned administrative functions such as onboarding, payroll, billing, or purchasing.
* Compile and organize records for audits, reporting, inspections, and special projects.
* Assist clients, employees, vendors, and community partners and direct requests to appropriate personnel.
* Protect client, employee, and organizational information in accordance with HIPAA and applicable privacy laws.

What You’ll Bring:

Required Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, maintain accurate records, and communicate professionally.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, and data entry systems.
* Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

* One year of administrative, clerical, customer service, office support, or related experience; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, nonprofit, or social services settings.
* Familiarity with electronic health records, scheduling software, HRIS, or database systems.
* Bilingual skills based on program needs.

Professional Attributes:

Dependable, organized, attentive to detail, adaptable, service-oriented, and respectful. Able to work independently and collaboratively while maintaining confidentiality and positive professional relationships.

Pre-Employment Requirements:

Applicable background screening, drug screening, and/or DOJ fingerprint clearance (Live Scan) may be required depending on program requirements. A valid California Class C driver’s license, acceptable driving record, reliable transportation, and insurability are required only if driving is an essential function of the position.

Work Environment:

Primarily office-based, using standard computer and office equipment. Duties may involve sitting, standing, walking, bending, and moving materials weighing up to 25 pounds. Occasional travel between organizational locations may be required.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Kings View is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

ADA Statement:

Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable laws.

o ampliamente

**Job Summary**

As an Office Manager, you’ll keep daily office operations organized, responsive, and running smoothly. You’ll welcome visitors, support clients and colleagues, manage schedules and records, and handle administrative tasks with care. This role suits someone with strong organizational skills, clear phone communication, and confidence using office technology. Bilingual ability is a plus.

* Use QuickBooks, Microsoft Office, and other productivity software to support routine office processes.
* Communicate with clients and colleagues, follow phone etiquette, and provide administrative and personal assistant support as needed. **Your impact:** Reliable office coordination helps clients receive timely assistance and enables colleagues to focus on their work.

**Experience**

* Office management, office experience, clerical experience, or administrative experience is helpful; relevant personal assistant experience is also valued.
* Demonstrate computer skills, computer literacy, and technical proficiency with common office tools.
* Bring strong organization, accuracy, and client communication skills, including attention to detail in data entry and proofreading.
* Experience with QuickBooks, spreadsheets, Microsoft Office, multi-line phone systems, or front desk duties is preferred.
* Bilingual communication skills are a plus.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Position: Front Office Manager**

**Reports To:** Assistant General Manager / General Manager

**Position Summary:**

The Front Office Manager leads the heart of the hotel—our front office operation—ensuring smooth, elevated guest experiences from arrival to departure. This role champions warm hospitality, operational excellence, and team leadership. Responsible for managing the front desk, guest relations, and overall lobby experience, this hands-on leader ensures that every guest interaction reflects Ivy Hospitality’s passion for service and commitment to creating memorable stays.

**Pay Range:** $50,000-$55,000 based on experience and qualifications

**Essential Functions:**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Provide direction and leadership to the front office team, setting the tone for genuine, guest-first service.
* Serve as the lead contact for escalated guest concerns, skillfully resolving issues while ensuring satisfaction and retention.
* Manage and oversee front desk operations, including check-in/check-out, room inventory, reservations, and guest services.
* Collaborate with the Assistant General Manager and General Manager on occupancy strategies, rate management, and guest satisfaction metrics.
* Train, mentor, and evaluate front desk team members to promote growth, engagement, and accountability.
* Facilitate daily stand-ups and team huddles to communicate expectations, priorities, and upcoming events.
* Ensure accurate handling of financial transactions, including billing, cash handling, and reconciliation procedures.
* Enforce front office standards, policies, and safety protocols in alignment with brand and company guidelines.
* Act as a liaison between departments, particularly housekeeping, maintenance, and food & beverage, to maintain a seamless guest experience.
* Monitor lobby cleanliness, front desk organization, and guest amenity availability to maintain an inviting arrival experience.
* Participate in the recruitment, selection, and onboarding of front office team members.
* Implement service enhancements and process improvements to increase efficiency and guest satisfaction.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:** High school diploma or equivalent required; hospitality or business management training preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum of 3-5 years of hotel front office experience, with at least 1-2 years in a supervisory or management capacity.

jobs.title: Office Coordinator II
jobs.desc:
**Office Coordinator II**

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**  
  
Unio Health Partners (UHP) is a highly differentiated physician practice management platform with the goal of transforming care delivery across the Western United States. UHP partners with leading physician practices, creating a cohesive, quality-oriented clinical culture and facilitating best practice sharing across the platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broader suite of services, providing a meaningful benefit to both physicians and patients. UHP's best-in-class clinical program covers three sub-specialties (urology, gastroenterology, and radiation oncology) and offers numerous ancillary services, including pathology lab, in-office dispensing, and chronic care management. We are led by a highly accomplished management team and provide a full suite of management services to its affiliated practices. UHP is currently affiliated with 185 providers operating out of 62 locations across Southern, Central, and Northern California.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
  
The Office Coordinator II is responsible for the implementation of front-office services and daily operations of the Physician/s practice. Communication with staff in all departments is paramount in this position, ensuring that the front office operation needs are met effectively and efficiently.

**This position is located at our clinic in Rancho Bernardo**  
  
**What you will be doing**

* Assist and support the Practice Manager in the daily management of the front office, helping to establish and maintain routine procedures specific to the practice as well as ensure that company policies are followed.
* Oversee day-to-day activities of the Front Office, serve as a resource for front office staff and as a liaison between staff and physicians and/or the Practice Manager.
* Communicate with back-office staff upon patient arrival. Ensure that instructions and other communications from the Physicians and/or the Practice Manager are conveyed to appropriate personnel.
* Maintain patient accounts by obtaining, recording, and updating personal and financial information.
* Assist with entering and/or scanning patient information into various medical record systems.
* Review patient schedule and manage appointment reminder calls to patients.
* Consistently exhibits behavior and communication skills that demonstrate commitment to superior customer service, including quality, care, and concern with each internal and external customer.
* Notify the physician if there are any schedule changes.
* Assist with prescription refills when needed.
* Adhere to safety policies and procedures and may serve as the Safety Officer at the respective work site.
* Support and uphold established policies, procedures, objectives, quality improvement, safety, environmental and infection control, and codes and requirements for regulatory agencies.
* Coordinate billing and liaison with billing service.

**What you will bring to the team**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Bilingual in Spanish is a plus
* 4-5 years of prior experience in a medical setting preferred.
* Knowledge of state and federal laws that apply to the duties of this position.
* Knowledge of medical practices, terminology, and reimbursement policies.
* Microsoft Office Skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

**Travel Requirements**

* Occasional travel to various UNIO locations may be necessary.

**What we can offer you**

* Competitive Salary
* Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Generous time off (start accruing on your first day - no waiting period)
* Paid Holidays
* 401(k)
* Company Discounts
* Collaborative work environment - we want our employees to have a say in how we run our office
* Employee Recognition

Compensation is depending on a number of factors including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, or experience that may fall outside of the range shown

The Office Manager supports site-level administrative excellence and family services operations. **QUALIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE**

**Join the Vallarta Supermarkets Family!**

At Vallarta Supermarkets, we’re more than just a grocery store, we’re a vibrant part of the communities we serve. We’re seeking friendly, service-oriented individuals who take pride in delivering extraordinary customer experiences and thrive in a fast-paced, festive environment. If you’re passionate about fresh, quality baked goods and love making people smile, we’d love to meet you!

**About the Role**

The Bakery Dispatcher ensures bakery display cases are fully stocked with a variety of breads, pastries, desserts, and cakes. This role supports the bakery team by maintaining cleanliness, assisting customers, and following Vallarta’s standards for quality, food safety, and service. The Bakery Dispatcher plays a key part in creating an inviting shopping experience while keeping the department organized, safe, and efficient.

**What You’ll Do**

* Customer Service: Smile, greet, and assist customers with bakery and cake orders, both in-store and by phone.

* Merchandising: Merchandise, rotate, and stock products to keep bakery cases fresh and appealing.

* Product Preparation: Prepare doughs, batters, and mixtures for breads, cakes, and pastries as directed. Pack, weigh, and price merchandise accurately according to company policy.

* Food Safety & Sanitation: Follow Vallarta’s Bakery Safety Program and health code regulations. Clean equipment, counters, and floors to maintain a sanitary work area.

* Team Support: Assist coworkers, train when needed, and maintain open communication with bakery management regarding inventory needs.

* Operations: Transport bakery products to and from storage areas, stock shelves, and monitor product signage and freshness.

* Compliance: Follow company rules, safety guidelines, weights and measures laws, and ensure labeling accuracy.

* Other Duties: Perform additional tasks as assigned to support bakery operations.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stand and walk for long periods (6–8 hours/day).

* Frequently bend neck/waist, squat, twist, and reach above/below shoulders.

* Frequent grasping, pushing, pulling, and fine hand manipulation.

* Lift and carry up to 25 lbs. frequently and up to 50 lbs. occasionally (e.g., flour, sugar, boxes).

* Longest distance carried: 20 feet.

* Work near bakery equipment and in environments with varying temperatures and humidity.

* May be required to perform tasks at elevated levels (placing or retrieving items).

**What We’re Looking For**

* Friendly, customer-focused attitude with leadership skills.

* Knowledge of baking methods and ingredients (Mexican, Central American, and American pastries, etc.).

* Experience using bakery equipment, ovens, and tools.

* Ability to manage in a fast-paced environment and mentor others.

* Basic computer and math skills (Excel, Word, Outlook).

* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

**Work Environment**

* Fast-paced retail setting with direct customer interaction.

* Exposure to perishable products, bakery equipment, and changing temperatures.

* Must work flexible schedule: afternoons, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

**Benefits**

**Full-Time Team Members**

* Health medical plan: $25/week, plus free dental & vision.

* Free $25,000 Basic Life and AD&D Insurance.

* 401(k) Retirement Plan.

* Paid vacation.

* Access to legal services.

**Part-Time & Full-Time Benefits**

* Paid sick time.

* Premium pay for holidays.

* Scholarship opportunities.

* Savings marketplace & credit union membership.

* Recognition programs (birthdays, years of service, spirit days, etc.).

jobs.desc:
**Position Title:** Administrative Coordinator
  
**Department:** PUMA Works
  
**Reports to:** Director of PUMA Works
  
**Compensation:** Hourly starting range $18.00 - $25.00 per hour; Commensurate to Skills and Experience
  
**Hours:** Full-time Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm, 40 hours per week
  
Benefits
  

* Three weeks of paid vacation
* Paid sick time
* Eight & a half paid holidays per year
* Two paid flexible holidays per year
* ICHRA Health Insurance Reimbursement
* 100% Employer Paid Dental & Vision Insurance
* 100% Employer Paid Life Insurance
* 100% Employer Paid Medical Clinic Membership or Cash Equivalent for employees and dependents
* Other benefits accrue over the first 3-24 months, including: additional paid vacation, 401k with company matching, and quarterly profit share.

**Place of Work:** Corporate Headquarters - 1730 South Street, Redding, CA 96001
  
Company Overview
  
Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste-to-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas renewable energy generation systems, primarily on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading.
  
Position Description
  
As a member of the PUMA Works team, the Administrator will be responsible for assisting the Technical Leads and Director with various administrative and project management tasks. A typical day is filled with billing, subscriptions, procurement, inventory, booking travel and assisting the Director with other administrative tasks. This role requires extensive communication between the other departments and external vendors. The selected candidate will have a keen attention to detail, be highly organized, have a strong ability to research and learn relevant information about the technological products we utilize and demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills. Maas Energy Works is growing quickly and has many potential opportunities for career advancement.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Invoicing of contracts during project lifecycles.
* Drafting of purchase orders and invoices with an understanding of tax requirements and exemptions.
* Manage procurement, vendor subscriptions, and department inventory.
* Coordinate and book team travel.
* Coordinate efficiently with the team and any third-party contractors or consultants.
* Responsible for effectively updating the database and files with documents pertinent to projects.
* Create SOPs and processes for administrative tasks.
* Automate administrative tasks through AI assistance.
* Proactively complete tasks assigned and estimate effort required for each task.
* Adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines with an analytical and problem-solving approach.

Qualifications & Skills
  

* High school diploma or equivalent; two or more years of administrative, procurement, or office coordination experience preferred.
* Preferred experience in ClickUp (or similar) task management software.

jobs.desc:
Job Title: Direct Billing Specialist

Job Summary

We are seeking an organized and precise Direct Billing Specialist to oversee our direct-invoice and clinical trial accounts. In this role, you will be responsible for creating, verifying, and distributing direct bills, keeping clear transactional records, and serving as the primary point of contact for billing and payment discrepancies. Your main objective will be to eliminate invoicing errors, submit timely claims and invoices, resolve payment delays, and ensure that our organization maintains an efficient and compliant cash inflow.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Invoice Generation: Prepare, review, and issue comprehensive claims and invoices to direct bill and clinical trial payers.
* Account Verification: Audit patient accounts, contracts, or insurance policies to verify billing criteria, codes, and correct pricing metrics before sending out claims and invoices.
* Payment Processing: Receive, post, and reconcile electronic bank drafts, wire transfers, and credit card payments to the appropriate patient accounts.
* Discrepancy Resolution: Promptly investigate denied claims, underpayments, or billing disputes by collaborating with internal operational teams and payers.
* Accounts Receivable Monitoring: Identify delinquent balances and initiate professional, courteous outreach (via phone, email, or mail) to establish structured payment timelines.
* System Maintenance: Maintain data integrity by routinely updating client contact information within the billing database and RIS system.

Key Skills and Qualifications

* Numerical & Analytical Skills: High aptitude for basic math and identifying patterns or errors within billing records.
* Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills needed to handle sensitive financial issues with empathy, authority, and professionalism.
* Software Proficiency: High proficiency with Microsoft Office products (specifically Excel and functions such as basic formulas, data filtering, VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) and experience navigating Electronic Health Record (EHR) or billing systems.
* Industry Compliance: Familiarity with data security rules, regulatory frameworks, and specialized protocols (such as HIPAA).
* Medical Knowledge: Working knowledge of medical terminology, CPT’s, and ICD-10 coding.

Education and Experience Requirements

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent is required; an Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Accounting, or related field is preferred.
* Experience: Minimum of 2 to 3 years of direct experience working in a medical office environment handling billing, claims processing, or accounts receivable.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a medical biller and collector in Imaging/Radiology practice.
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 4 years’ experience as a medical biller/collector.
* CPC Coder Certification preferred.
* Medisoft billing software is a plus.
* Professional references required.

* Working knowledge of Imaging/Radiology billing practice, CPT codes, and ICD10s.
* Strong knowledge of payer guidelines and reimbursement policies.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Ability to organize, multi-task, and meet deadlines.
* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* High production goals.

The Commission on POST Dispatcher Exam is a standardized test designed to measure the verbal, reasoning, memory, and perceptual abilities necessary for public safety dispatcher work. It is a requirement for candidates seeking employment in this field and is part of the POST Entry-Level Dispatcher Selection Test Battery. The exam consists of eleven brief tests that assess various abilities, including the ability to quickly and accurately compare letters and numbers presented orally and in written form, and the ability to shift back and forth between two or more sources of information. The entire test battery takes about 2.5 to 3 hours to complete, including a short break. The**POST Entry-Level Dispatcher Selection Test Battery Examinee Guide** provides information about the test. The Accounts Receivable Specialist is a critical member of the finance department. You will be responsible for managing and tracking the money owed to the company by its customers or clients. Your primary role is to ensure that payments are collected promptly and accurately, maintaining accurate records, and resolving any issues related to outstanding invoices.

The Accounts Receivable Specialist will manage and maintain the company's accounts receivable records, ensuring the timely collection of outstanding debts, and providing excellent customer service to clients regarding payment inquiries and discrepancies. * **Cash Application:** Apply payments accurately, matching payments with invoices and ensuring proper allocation.
* **Documentation:** Maintain organized and complete records of all accounts receivable transactions, including invoices, receipts, and correspondence.
* **Reporting:** Prepare regular reports on accounts receivable status and provide updates to the finance team and management.
* **Compliance:** Ensure compliance with accounting and financial regulations and company policies related to accounts receivable.
